personality.tell: checks exits in every new room before speaking
personality.speech: Uses long pauses as punctuation, sits comfortably in silence

physical.feature: ink-stained fingers
physical.clothes: work clothes patched by someone who loved them

goal.short: Convert governance instability into a restoration of prerogatives that formal governance had constrained.
goal.long: Become the person every arrival and every old family must go through

plotHooks: A child has been asking questions about a person no one has heard of, insisting this person lived here recently.

presentation.impression: Open. The impression of someone with nothing in particular to hide, or who has decided not to hide it.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

npcs.stressNote: The governing faction is caught between two constituencies that want incompatible things, and both know it.

npcs.activeConstraint: Traditional claims that would have been dismissed under stable governance invite more scrutiny under conditions where everyone is watching for illegitimate power grabs.

npcs.title: Agent

secret.stakes: Incitatus Varro would move against them immediately if they suspected

plotHooks: They buried someone last season that they refer to only as 'the traveller'. They will not say more.

presentation.impression: Quiet, neighbourly. The impression of someone with a small life and modest concerns.

relationships.description: Asgaut Haraldsson sends difficult cases to Estrid Olafsson, and Estrid Olafsson sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Asgaut Haraldsson has learned something about Estrid Olafsson's family that Estrid Olafsson does not know.

relationships.description: Estrid Olafsson brings the votes and Magnhild Svensson brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Magnhild Svensson voted against Estrid Olafsson on a small matter last week. Estrid Olafsson is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: What Uijah Balam knows, Cuauhtli Chuc taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Cuauhtli Chuc, quietly, whether Uijah Balam can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Cuauhtli Chuc took Citlali Nah in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Citlali Nah has taken on a client Cuauhtli Chuc turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Yohualli Kin owes Citlali Nah something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Citlali Nah is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Uijah Balam and Water Lily Ek are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Yohualli Kin needs Uijah Balam's seal on certain papers; Uijah Balam needs Yohualli Kin's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Uijah Balam's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Yohualli Kin holds nothing over Uijah Balam.

relationships.description: Uijah Balam wants Metztli Balam's position, and Metztli Balam wants Uijah Balam's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Metztli Balam has been telling clients that Uijah Balam's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Uijah Balam.

relationships.description: Years ago Metztli Balam did for Atl Itza the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Atl Itza has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Atl Itza has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Metztli Balam does not.

relationships.description: Atl Itza and Uijah Balam fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Uijah Balam's face.
relationships.tension: Atl Itza has learned that Uijah Balam is in debt and could be ruined by one call on a loan.

relationships.description: Water Lily Ek learned the work at Metztli Balam's side for seven years. Half of Water Lily Ek's clients first came through Metztli Balam's door.
relationships.tension: Metztli Balam has taken a new apprentice, and Water Lily Ek has heard the apprentice is being taught things Water Lily Ek never was.

relationships.description: Metztli Balam vouched for Yohualli Kin when nobody else would. Yohualli Kin's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Yohualli Kin corrected Metztli Balam in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: The alliance between Citlali Nah and Uijah Balam was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Citlali Nah has taken a precaution against Uijah Balam that Uijah Balam was not meant to discover. Uijah Balam has discovered it.

relationships.description: Citlali Nah and Water Lily Ek sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Water Lily Ek has written down what Citlali Nah owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Citlali Nah and Metztli Balam share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Metztli Balam has been dining with Citlali Nah's rivals. Citlali Nah heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Yohualli Kin still uses Water Lily Ek's methods and Water Lily Ek's ledger format. Everyone who sees Yohualli Kin's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Water Lily Ek has asked Yohualli Kin for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Between Water Lily Ek and Cuauhtli Chuc stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Dalila al-Jazari brings the votes and Lubna ibn Rushd brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Lubna ibn Rushd voted against Dalila al-Jazari on a small matter last week. Dalila al-Jazari is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Lubna ibn Rushd borrowed Zaid ibn Khalid's good name to win a post. Zaid ibn Khalid has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Zaid ibn Khalid has fallen on hard times, and the debt Lubna ibn Rushd owes is now the only asset Zaid ibn Khalid has.

relationships.description: Lubna ibn Rushd owes Yusuf al-Mawsili something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Yusuf al-Mawsili is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Years ago Dalila al-Jazari did for Zaid ibn Khalid the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Zaid ibn Khalid has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Zaid ibn Khalid has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Dalila al-Jazari does not.

relationships.description: What Ghulam al-Hakim knows, Zaid ibn Khalid taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Zaid ibn Khalid, quietly, whether Ghulam al-Hakim can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Yusuf al-Mawsili took Ghulam al-Hakim in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Ghulam al-Hakim has taken on a client Yusuf al-Mawsili turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Every client Yusuf al-Mawsili wins is one Faris ibn Jubayr lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Yusuf al-Mawsili and Faris ibn Jubayr will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Ghulam al-Hakim and Faris ibn Jubayr are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Ghulam al-Hakim lost the last contract to Faris ibn Jubayr by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Dalila al-Jazari learned the work at Ghulam al-Hakim's side for seven years. Half of Dalila al-Jazari's clients first came through Ghulam al-Hakim's door.
relationships.tension: Ghulam al-Hakim has taken a new apprentice, and Dalila al-Jazari has heard the apprentice is being taught things Dalila al-Jazari never was.

relationships.description: Faris ibn Jubayr vouched for Dalila al-Jazari when nobody else would. Dalila al-Jazari's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Dalila al-Jazari corrected Faris ibn Jubayr in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Pacuvius Salinator reports to Albinus Plancus on paper and to no one in practice. Albinus Plancus has three letters of complaint unanswered.
relationships.tension: Pacuvius Salinator arrested a councillor's son without Albinus Plancus's warrant. Albinus Plancus has demanded his release by tomorrow.

relationships.description: Albinus Plancus wants the watch under civil command; Cara Moderatus wants the council out of the barracks. They meet monthly and settle nothing.
relationships.tension: Albinus Plancus has asked the capital to replace Cara Moderatus. Cara Moderatus has asked the capital to dissolve Albinus Plancus's council.

relationships.description: Albinus Plancus sets the curfew and Flavia Severus decides whether to enforce it. The two have not agreed on a curfew in a year.
relationships.tension: A riot is expected on the next market day, and Albinus Plancus and Flavia Severus have issued opposite orders for it.

relationships.description: Cara Moderatus and Flavia Severus are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Between Cara Moderatus and Pacuvius Salinator stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Laelia Cicero paid Cara Moderatus's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Cara Moderatus mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Laelia Cicero has asked Cara Moderatus for a vote against Cara Moderatus's own interests. It is the first payment Laelia Cicero has asked for.

relationships.description: Cato Maximus owes Albinus Plancus a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Cato Maximus has started repaying the debt in coin. Albinus Plancus wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Vita Nerva learned the work at Zenobia Ursus's side for seven years. Half of Vita Nerva's clients first came through Zenobia Ursus's door.
relationships.tension: Zenobia Ursus has taken a new apprentice, and Vita Nerva has heard the apprentice is being taught things Vita Nerva never was.

relationships.description: Clodia Aurelius kept Zenobia Ursus's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Zenobia Ursus has voted with Clodia Aurelius ever since.
relationships.tension: Clodia Aurelius has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Zenobia Ursus's partners.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Flavia Severus and Pacuvius Salinator, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Laelia Cicero nursed Flavia Severus through a winter fever when no one else would come. Flavia Severus still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Flavia Severus has refused Laelia Cicero a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: What Clodia Aurelius knows would ruin Livia Ravilla; what Livia Ravilla holds would finish Clodia Aurelius. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Clodia Aurelius and Sulpicia Capito want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Clodia Aurelius borrowed Albinus Plancus's good name to win a post. Albinus Plancus has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Albinus Plancus has fallen on hard times, and the debt Clodia Aurelius owes is now the only asset Albinus Plancus has.

relationships.description: Vita Nerva vouched for Albinus Plancus when nobody else would. Albinus Plancus's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Albinus Plancus corrected Vita Nerva in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Drusus Volso is Vita Nerva's half-sibling, raised in the same house and left out of the same will.
relationships.tension: A family property must be sold, and Vita Nerva and Drusus Volso each want the money for a different purpose.

relationships.description: Pacuvius Salinator still uses Laelia Cicero's methods and Laelia Cicero's ledger format. Everyone who sees Pacuvius Salinator's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Laelia Cicero has asked Pacuvius Salinator for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Laelia Cicero sends difficult cases to Albinus Plancus, and Albinus Plancus sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Laelia Cicero has learned something about Albinus Plancus's family that Albinus Plancus does not know.

relationships.description: The alliance between Sulpicia Capito and Livia Ravilla was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Sulpicia Capito has taken a precaution against Livia Ravilla that Livia Ravilla was not meant to discover. Livia Ravilla has discovered it.

relationships.description: Sulpicia Capito and Drusus Volso are in-laws. They are polite at family dinners and avoid each other everywhere else.
relationships.tension: Sulpicia Capito's rivals have learned that Drusus Volso is family, and have started asking Drusus Volso questions.

relationships.description: Pacuvius Salinator and Cato Maximus have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Cato Maximus has been offered Pacuvius Salinator's post by people who want Pacuvius Salinator gone.

relationships.description: Pacuvius Salinator named Zenobia Ursus as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Zenobia Ursus has begun teaching Pacuvius Salinator's methods as Zenobia Ursus's own.

relationships.description: Livia Ravilla and Drusus Volso deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Drusus Volso has recently secured something that makes Livia Ravilla's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Livia Ravilla owes Zenobia Ursus something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Zenobia Ursus is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Every advance Drusus Volso makes is answered by Clodia Aurelius within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Drusus Volso and Zenobia Ursus share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Zenobia Ursus has been dining with Drusus Volso's rivals. Drusus Volso heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Hemavati Nair and Ekalavya Mukherjee share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Ekalavya Mukherjee has been dining with Hemavati Nair's rivals. Hemavati Nair heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Hemavati Nair and Prashant Thakur back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Hemavati Nair wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Prashant Thakur thinks the newcomer would take Prashant Thakur's place.

relationships.description: Rajesh Kapur and Ishwar Mahajan are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Rajesh Kapur lost the last contract to Ishwar Mahajan by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Rajesh Kapur and Ravi Gupta each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Mamata Bhatt and Yudhisthir Shastri, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Mamata Bhatt took Hemavati Nair in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Hemavati Nair has taken on a client Mamata Bhatt turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Nalini Subramanian learned the work at Mamata Bhatt's side for seven years. Half of Nalini Subramanian's clients first came through Mamata Bhatt's door.
relationships.tension: Mamata Bhatt has taken a new apprentice, and Nalini Subramanian has heard the apprentice is being taught things Nalini Subramanian never was.

relationships.description: What Govind Srinivasan knows would ruin Ram Rao; what Ram Rao holds would finish Govind Srinivasan. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Govind Srinivasan brings the votes and Malati Bose brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Malati Bose voted against Govind Srinivasan on a small matter last week. Govind Srinivasan is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Govind Srinivasan and Nirmala Dutta fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Nirmala Dutta's face.
relationships.tension: Govind Srinivasan has learned that Nirmala Dutta is in debt and could be ruined by one call on a loan.

relationships.description: Ganga Srinivasan and Prashant Thakur compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Ganga Srinivasan sends difficult cases to Yudhisthir Shastri, and Yudhisthir Shastri sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Ganga Srinivasan has learned something about Yudhisthir Shastri's family that Yudhisthir Shastri does not know.

relationships.description: Something happened between Nagendra Yadav and Ram Rao years ago that neither has forgotten. They function professionally. They do not forgive.
relationships.tension: The circumstances that caused the original rupture are repeating. Both of them know it.

relationships.description: Between Nagendra Yadav and Malati Bose stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Ram Rao and Malati Bose were something to each other once (partners, friends, perhaps more), and the wreck of it is the one subject on which both are permanently silent.
relationships.tension: An apology is owed in one direction and expected in the other, and they disagree about which.

relationships.description: Ram Rao and Nirmala Dutta want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Prashant Thakur and Yudhisthir Shastri signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Prashant Thakur and Yudhisthir Shastri both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Rajesh Kapur paid Prashant Thakur's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Prashant Thakur mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Rajesh Kapur has asked Prashant Thakur for a vote against Prashant Thakur's own interests. It is the first payment Rajesh Kapur has asked for.

relationships.description: Ishwar Mahajan and Shobha Iyengar have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Shobha Iyengar has been offered Ishwar Mahajan's post by people who want Ishwar Mahajan gone.

relationships.description: Ishwar Mahajan owes Vishnu Anand a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Ishwar Mahajan has started repaying the debt in coin. Vishnu Anand wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Aditya Jha kept Malati Bose's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Malati Bose has voted with Aditya Jha ever since.
relationships.tension: Aditya Jha has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Malati Bose's partners.

relationships.description: Malati Bose is godparent to Nalini Subramanian's eldest child. The tie was made before their careers set them against each other.
relationships.tension: The family has asked Malati Bose and Nalini Subramanian to end their quarrel before the next feast. Neither will apologise first.

relationships.description: Vasudhara Ahuja nursed Malati Bose through a winter fever when no one else would come. Malati Bose still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Malati Bose has refused Vasudhara Ahuja a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Nalini Subramanian and Vasudhara Ahuja deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Vasudhara Ahuja has recently secured something that makes Nalini Subramanian's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Nalini Subramanian vouched for Nagendra Srinivasan when nobody else would. Nagendra Srinivasan's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Srinivasan corrected Nalini Subramanian in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Every advance Nalini Subramanian makes is answered by Hari Trivedi within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Vasudhara Ahuja and Nagendra Srinivasan are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Srinivasan has asked Vasudhara Ahuja to back a candidate Vasudhara Ahuja distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Vasudhara Ahuja and Lopamudra Ghosh bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Vasudhara Ahuja has hired away Lopamudra Ghosh's best assistant. Lopamudra Ghosh has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Vasudhara Ahuja and Hari Trivedi trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Vasudhara Ahuja or Hari Trivedi can fill it.

relationships.description: Shobha Iyengar and Rajesh Kapur trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Shobha Iyengar has asked Rajesh Kapur for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Vishnu Anand once told the council that Shobha Iyengar was right and Vishnu Anand was wrong. Shobha Iyengar has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Shobha Iyengar has made a mistake that Vishnu Anand is bound to report. Vishnu Anand has not reported it.

relationships.description: Atharva Jha and Lakshmi Nair work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Atharva Jha and Lopamudra Varma consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Atharva Jha and Lopamudra Varma to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Atharva Jha controls a vote Ram Rao needs, and Ram Rao controls a supply Atharva Jha needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Ram Rao has found a new source for what Atharva Jha supplies. Atharva Jha has not been told.

relationships.description: Yudhisthir Shastri trusts Hemavati Nair's word over any written contract. Hemavati Nair has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Hemavati Nair has publicly backed a plan that Yudhisthir Shastri thinks will fail. Yudhisthir Shastri has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Yudhisthir Shastri wants Ekalavya Mukherjee's position, and Ekalavya Mukherjee wants Yudhisthir Shastri's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Ekalavya Mukherjee has been telling clients that Yudhisthir Shastri's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Yudhisthir Shastri.

relationships.description: Vasudhara Ahuja still uses Yudhisthir Shastri's methods and Yudhisthir Shastri's ledger format. Everyone who sees Vasudhara Ahuja's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Yudhisthir Shastri has asked Vasudhara Ahuja for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Every client Damayanti Shrivastava wins is one Radha Varma lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Damayanti Shrivastava and Radha Varma will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Damayanti Shrivastava wants Ram Rao's position, and Ram Rao wants Damayanti Shrivastava's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Ram Rao has been telling clients that Damayanti Shrivastava's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Damayanti Shrivastava.

relationships.description: Damayanti Shrivastava and Nagendra Srinivasan each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Nagendra Srinivasan needs from Damayanti Shrivastava comes up next week, and Damayanti Shrivastava has named a new price.

relationships.description: Every client Nagendra Srinivasan wins is one Hari Trivedi lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Srinivasan and Hari Trivedi will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Nagendra Srinivasan and Lopamudra Ghosh are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Srinivasan lost the last contract to Lopamudra Ghosh by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Nagendra Srinivasan and Rajesh Kapur are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Rajesh Kapur needs Vishnu Anand's seal on certain papers; Vishnu Anand needs Rajesh Kapur's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Vishnu Anand's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Rajesh Kapur holds nothing over Vishnu Anand.

relationships.description: Vishnu Anand and Ravi Gupta bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Vishnu Anand has hired away Ravi Gupta's best assistant. Ravi Gupta has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Ekalavya Mukherjee and Prashant Thakur have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: The alliance between Ekalavya Mukherjee and Ganga Srinivasan was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Ekalavya Mukherjee has taken a precaution against Ganga Srinivasan that Ganga Srinivasan was not meant to discover. Ganga Srinivasan has discovered it.

relationships.description: Ekalavya Mukherjee named Nalini Subramanian as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Nalini Subramanian has begun teaching Ekalavya Mukherjee's methods as Nalini Subramanian's own.

relationships.description: Lakshmi Nair and Lopamudra Varma trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Lakshmi Nair or Lopamudra Varma can fill it.

relationships.description: Lakshmi Nair wants Govind Srinivasan's position, and Govind Srinivasan wants Lakshmi Nair's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Govind Srinivasan has been telling clients that Lakshmi Nair's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Lakshmi Nair.

relationships.description: Every client Aditya Jha wins is one Govind Srinivasan lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Aditya Jha and Govind Srinivasan will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Aditya Jha and Nagendra Yadav disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Aditya Jha and Ram Rao are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Aditya Jha lost the last contract to Ram Rao by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Nirmala Dutta and Nagendra Yadav are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: Nirmala Dutta brings the votes and Malati Bose brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Malati Bose voted against Nirmala Dutta on a small matter last week. Nirmala Dutta is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Nirmala Dutta and Aditya Jha have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Aditya Jha has been offered Nirmala Dutta's post by people who want Nirmala Dutta gone.

relationships.description: Rekha Subramanian and Rohit Hazra sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Rohit Hazra has written down what Rekha Subramanian owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: The quarrel between Rekha Subramanian and Ram Rao is old enough that no one else remembers the cause. They remember. They have simply stopped explaining.
relationships.tension: A newcomer keeps trying to reconcile them, and is about to learn why nobody else does.

relationships.description: Jai Shastri and Rekha Subramanian signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Jai Shastri and Rekha Subramanian both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Jai Shastri and Nagendra Yadav deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Yadav has recently secured something that makes Jai Shastri's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Ravi Gupta and Ishwar Mahajan are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Ishwar Mahajan has asked Ravi Gupta to back a candidate Ravi Gupta distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Nagendra Srinivasan reports to Ravi Gupta on paper and to no one in practice. Ravi Gupta has three letters of complaint unanswered.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Srinivasan arrested a councillor's son without Ravi Gupta's warrant. Ravi Gupta has demanded his release by tomorrow.

relationships.description: Ravi Gupta and Lopamudra Ghosh bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Ravi Gupta has hired away Lopamudra Ghosh's best assistant. Lopamudra Ghosh has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Lopamudra Varma and Govind Srinivasan trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Lopamudra Varma or Govind Srinivasan can fill it.

relationships.description: Lopamudra Varma shaped Malati Bose's career in ways that Malati Bose has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Malati Bose now operates in ways Lopamudra Varma would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Radha Varma and Rajesh Kapur trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Radha Varma has asked Rajesh Kapur for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Radha Varma wants Ram Rao's position, and Ram Rao wants Radha Varma's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Ram Rao has been telling clients that Radha Varma's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Radha Varma.

relationships.description: The alliance between Lopamudra Ghosh and Hari Trivedi was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Lopamudra Ghosh has taken a precaution against Hari Trivedi that Hari Trivedi was not meant to discover. Hari Trivedi has discovered it.

relationships.description: Lopamudra Ghosh and Nagendra Yadav share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Yadav has been dining with Lopamudra Ghosh's rivals. Lopamudra Ghosh heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Lopamudra Ghosh and Vishnu Anand back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Lopamudra Ghosh wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Vishnu Anand thinks the newcomer would take Vishnu Anand's place.

relationships.description: Hari Trivedi wants the watch under civil command; Rajesh Kapur wants the council out of the barracks. They meet monthly and settle nothing.
relationships.tension: Hari Trivedi has asked the capital to replace Rajesh Kapur. Rajesh Kapur has asked the capital to dissolve Hari Trivedi's council.

relationships.description: Hari Trivedi controls a vote Nagendra Yadav needs, and Nagendra Yadav controls a supply Hari Trivedi needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Yadav has found a new source for what Hari Trivedi supplies. Hari Trivedi has not been told.

relationships.description: Every client Rohit Hazra wins is one Jai Shastri lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Rohit Hazra and Jai Shastri will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Blood ties Rohit Hazra to Nagendra Yadav in a way that neither career can afford; they meet at funerals and weddings and pretend the rest of the year does not exist.
relationships.tension: A younger relative has begun trading on the connection both of them refuse to use.

relationships.description: Rohit Hazra testified against Ram Rao in a case ten years ago. Ram Rao lost a fortune and has not spoken to Rohit Hazra since.
relationships.tension: Ram Rao has been appointed to judge a case in which Rohit Hazra is a party.

relationships.description: Ai Li and Narae Zhu fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Narae Zhu's face.

personality.tell: always stands when others sit, or vice versa
personality.speech: Never interrupts, waits out even the longest speaker, then answers the first point only

physical.feature: a sealed letter always tucked in their belt
physical.clothes: clothes that once cost a fortune and now show the miles

goal.short: Identify the leak in their supply chain before it empties the accounts
goal.long: Leverage money into influence: that's where security actually lives

secret.what: Has already committed to supporting a specific claimant in private, while publicly presenting as neutral

plotHooks: A shipment they weren't expecting arrived and is now in their warehouse. They don't know who sent it or what to do.

presentation.impression: Cautious with newcomers. The wariness is professional rather than personal.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

relationships.description: Manouel Iasites answers Tyche Comnenus's summons late and leaves early. Tyche Comnenus now issues them in writing so the delays are on record.
relationships.tension: Manouel Iasites has begun collecting a road toll for the militia. Tyche Comnenus calls it theft from the treasury.

relationships.description: Years ago Christos Alexios did for Tyche Comnenus the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Tyche Comnenus has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Tyche Comnenus has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Christos Alexios does not.

relationships.description: Between Manouel Iasites and Christos Alexios stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Chrysoberge Dalassenos paid Manouel Iasites's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Manouel Iasites mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Chrysoberge Dalassenos has asked Manouel Iasites for a vote against Manouel Iasites's own interests. It is the first payment Chrysoberge Dalassenos has asked for.

relationships.description: Christos Alexios controls a vote Kallistrate Argyros needs, and Kallistrate Argyros controls a supply Christos Alexios needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Kallistrate Argyros has found a new source for what Christos Alexios supplies. Christos Alexios has not been told.

relationships.description: Irini Botaneiates once told the council that Christos Alexios was right and Irini Botaneiates was wrong. Christos Alexios has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Christos Alexios has made a mistake that Irini Botaneiates is bound to report. Irini Botaneiates has not reported it.

relationships.description: Chrysoberge Dalassenos and Kallistrate Argyros each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Kallistrate Argyros needs from Chrysoberge Dalassenos comes up next week, and Chrysoberge Dalassenos has named a new price.

relationships.description: The alliance between Chrysoberge Dalassenos and Christos Alexios was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Chrysoberge Dalassenos has taken a precaution against Christos Alexios that Christos Alexios was not meant to discover. Christos Alexios has discovered it.

relationships.description: Chrysoberge Dalassenos and Irini Botaneiates consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Chrysoberge Dalassenos and Irini Botaneiates to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Irini Botaneiates took Tyche Comnenus in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Tyche Comnenus has taken on a client Irini Botaneiates turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Irini Botaneiates needs Kallistrate Argyros's seal on certain papers; Kallistrate Argyros needs Irini Botaneiates's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Kallistrate Argyros's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Irini Botaneiates holds nothing over Kallistrate Argyros.

relationships.description: Kallistrate Argyros owes Tyche Comnenus a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Kallistrate Argyros has started repaying the debt in coin. Tyche Comnenus wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Xiaoling Xu trusts Hanako Nakamura's word over any written contract. Hanako Nakamura has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Hanako Nakamura has publicly backed a plan that Xiaoling Xu thinks will fail. Xiaoling Xu has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Xiaoling Xu owes Sujin Hayashi a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Xiaoling Xu has started repaying the debt in coin. Sujin Hayashi wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Hanako Nakamura and Sujin Hayashi have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Haruka Wei's people are never searched on Hanako Nakamura's watch. The arrangement is three years old and has never been put in writing.
relationships.tension: One of Haruka Wei's runners was arrested by a patrol Hanako Nakamura did not assign. The runner knows both their names.

relationships.description: Jun Xie kept Hanako Nakamura's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Hanako Nakamura has voted with Jun Xie ever since.
relationships.tension: Jun Xie has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Hanako Nakamura's partners.

relationships.description: Akira Dong and Sujin Hayashi disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: What Xiaoling Xu knows, Akira Dong taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Akira Dong, quietly, whether Xiaoling Xu can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Akira Dong and Rui Ito, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Sujin Hayashi controls a vote Jun Xie needs, and Jun Xie controls a supply Sujin Hayashi needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Jun Xie has found a new source for what Sujin Hayashi supplies. Sujin Hayashi has not been told.

relationships.description: Sujin Hayashi and Satoshi Sato back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Sujin Hayashi wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Satoshi Sato thinks the newcomer would take Satoshi Sato's place.

relationships.description: Haruka Wei nursed Jun Xie through a winter fever when no one else would come. Jun Xie still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Jun Xie has refused Haruka Wei a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Jun Xie borrowed Xiaoling Xu's good name to win a post. Xiaoling Xu has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Xiaoling Xu has fallen on hard times, and the debt Jun Xie owes is now the only asset Xiaoling Xu has.

relationships.description: Lang Inoue brings the votes and Rui Ito brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Rui Ito voted against Lang Inoue on a small matter last week. Lang Inoue is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Lang Inoue sends difficult cases to Haruto Xu, and Haruto Xu sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Lang Inoue has learned something about Haruto Xu's family that Haruto Xu does not know.

relationships.description: Rui Ito and Haruto Xu bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Rui Ito has hired away Haruto Xu's best assistant. Haruto Xu has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Rui Ito and Satoshi Sato trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Rui Ito or Satoshi Sato can fill it.

relationships.description: Haruto Xu owes Satoshi Sato something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Satoshi Sato is about to call it in.

relationships.description: The quarrel between Haruto Xu and Sujin Hayashi is old enough that no one else remembers the cause. They remember. They have simply stopped explaining.
relationships.tension: A newcomer keeps trying to reconcile them, and is about to learn why nobody else does.

relationships.description: Years ago Xiaoling Xu did for Haruto Xu the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Haruto Xu has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Haruto Xu has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Xiaoling Xu does not.

relationships.description: Haruka Wei and Sujin Hayashi have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Sujin Hayashi has been offered Haruka Wei's post by people who want Haruka Wei gone.

relationships.description: Haruka Wei is godparent to Satoshi Sato's eldest child. The tie was made before their careers set them against each other.
relationships.tension: The family has asked Haruka Wei and Satoshi Sato to end their quarrel before the next feast. Neither will apologise first.

relationships.description: Satoshi Sato testified against Lang Inoue in a case ten years ago. Lang Inoue lost a fortune and has not spoken to Satoshi Sato since.
relationships.tension: Lang Inoue has been appointed to judge a case in which Satoshi Sato is a party.

relationships.description: Satoshi Sato and Xiao Huang signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Satoshi Sato and Xiao Huang both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Xiao Huang and Lang Inoue are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: Haruto Xu took the post Xiao Huang had been promised. Xiao Huang has treated Haruto Xu as an enemy from that day.
relationships.tension: Xiao Huang has found the document that proves what Haruto Xu did, and has kept it locked away.

relationships.description: Xiao Huang and Jun Xie are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Jun Xie has asked Xiao Huang to back a candidate Xiao Huang distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

npcs.title: Exarchos

personality.tell: flinches slightly at raised voices even when calm
personality.speech: Ends disagreements by restating the other position, slightly wrong

physical.feature: surprisingly soft hands
physical.clothes: a chain of office worn even off-duty

goal.short: Convert contested authority into stable authority before the contest resolves in someone else's favor.
goal.long: Build a political dynasty (their children will inherit influence, not just money)

secret.what: Diverted the relief meant for the newcomer camp into a private arrangement, and the shortfall is being blamed on the newcomers themselves
secret.stakes: People in the camp are dying of the shortfall. The blame is holding, for now

plotHooks: Someone has been leaving anonymous notes in their office pointing to a colleague's corruption. The notes are accurate.

presentation.impression: Efficient and correct in every interaction. The manner of someone following procedure.
presentation.behaviour: Processes requests quickly. Doesn't ask about things that aren't their business.

relationships.description: Georgios II Phokas and Ioanna Kantakouzenos signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Georgios II Phokas and Ioanna Kantakouzenos both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Georgios II Phokas and Andronikos Skleros are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Andronikos Skleros has asked Georgios II Phokas to back a candidate Georgios II Phokas distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Ioanna Kantakouzenos names the settlement's enemies from the pulpit, and Andronikos Skleros rides against them within the week.
relationships.tension: Ioanna Kantakouzenos wants an armed march against a rival sect. Andronikos Skleros has counted the cost in men and wants to wait a year.

relationships.description: Years ago Angelos Hyaleas did for Ioanna Kantakouzenos the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Ioanna Kantakouzenos has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Ioanna Kantakouzenos has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Angelos Hyaleas does not.

relationships.description: Andronikos Skleros and Angelos Hyaleas hold the settlement between faith and force. The two of them meet after every service to agree the week's orders.
relationships.tension: A soldier under Angelos Hyaleas stands accused of sacrilege. Andronikos Skleros demands a church trial; Angelos Hyaleas wants a court-martial.

relationships.description: Glykeria Kataphloron still uses Andronikos Skleros's methods and Andronikos Skleros's ledger format. Everyone who sees Glykeria Kataphloron's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Andronikos Skleros has asked Glykeria Kataphloron for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Stephanos Bryennios and Chrysostomissa Kalojan compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Stephanos Bryennios named Georgios II Phokas as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Georgios II Phokas has begun teaching Stephanos Bryennios's methods as Georgios II Phokas's own.

relationships.description: Chrysostomissa Kalojan and Basilissa Kataphloron want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Chrysostomissa Kalojan shaped Georgios II Phokas's career in ways that Georgios II Phokas has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Georgios II Phokas now operates in ways Chrysostomissa Kalojan would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Chrysostomissa Kalojan and Glykeria Kataphloron are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: Despoina Niketas stands where Agamemnon Gabalas put them, by a ladder Agamemnon Gabalas built and Despoina Niketas has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Agamemnon Gabalas has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Despoina Niketas knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Agamemnon Gabalas controls a vote Panteleimonissa Bryennios needs, and Panteleimonissa Bryennios controls a supply Agamemnon Gabalas needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Panteleimonissa Bryennios has found a new source for what Agamemnon Gabalas supplies. Agamemnon Gabalas has not been told.

relationships.description: Every advance Agamemnon Gabalas makes is answered by Thodoros Makrembolites within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Basilissa Kataphloron and Stephanos Bryennios each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Stephanos Bryennios needs from Basilissa Kataphloron comes up next week, and Basilissa Kataphloron has named a new price.

relationships.description: Basilissa Kataphloron and Photeine Drimys work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Glykeria Kataphloron carries Angelos Hyaleas's banner on every patrol. Crossing Glykeria Kataphloron is treated as heresy, and heresy is punished by Glykeria Kataphloron.
relationships.tension: Glykeria Kataphloron has started giving orders in the name of the faith without consulting Angelos Hyaleas.

relationships.description: Angelos Hyaleas and Pulcheria Laskaris bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Angelos Hyaleas has hired away Pulcheria Laskaris's best assistant. Pulcheria Laskaris has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Angelos Hyaleas and Theodoros Kurtikios are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Glykeria Kataphloron and Pulcheria Laskaris operate as a unified authority: temporal and spiritual power reinforcing each other. Dissent against one is dissent against both.
relationships.tension: They disagree on a fundamental question of method that neither will put into writing.

relationships.description: Theodoros Kurtikios needs Glykeria Kataphloron's seal on certain papers; Glykeria Kataphloron needs Theodoros Kurtikios's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Glykeria Kataphloron's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Theodoros Kurtikios holds nothing over Glykeria Kataphloron.

relationships.description: Glykeria Kataphloron and Makedonissa Dalassenos sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Makedonissa Dalassenos has written down what Glykeria Kataphloron owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Theodoros Kurtikios and Makedonissa Dalassenos each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Blood ties Theodoros Kurtikios to Stephanos Bryennios in a way that neither career can afford; they meet at funerals and weddings and pretend the rest of the year does not exist.
relationships.tension: A younger relative has begun trading on the connection both of them refuse to use.

relationships.description: Pulcheria Laskaris and Theodoros Kurtikios disagree fundamentally about where civil authority ends and military authority begins. The argument has been running for years and occasionally generates paperwork.
relationships.tension: An incident is coming that will force the issue. Both are positioning for it.

relationships.description: Pulcheria Laskaris and Basilissa Kataphloron trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Pulcheria Laskaris or Basilissa Kataphloron can fill it.

relationships.description: What Makedonissa Dalassenos knows would ruin Stephanos Bryennios; what Stephanos Bryennios holds would finish Makedonissa Dalassenos. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Makedonissa Dalassenos issues orders Angelos Hyaleas regards as suggestions, and Angelos Hyaleas takes actions Makedonissa Dalassenos regards as insubordination; the settlement runs in the gap between.
relationships.tension: A prisoner is currently held by both jurisdictions at once. Neither will release the paperwork first.

relationships.description: Between Despoina Niketas and Alexandros Gabalas stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Despoina Niketas and Panteleimonissa Bryennios, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Agamemnon Gabalas paid Alexandros Gabalas's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Alexandros Gabalas mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Agamemnon Gabalas has asked Alexandros Gabalas for a vote against Alexandros Gabalas's own interests. It is the first payment Agamemnon Gabalas has asked for.

relationships.description: Alexandros Gabalas owes Thodoros Makrembolites a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Alexandros Gabalas has started repaying the debt in coin. Thodoros Makrembolites wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Panteleimonissa Bryennios sends difficult cases to Alexandros Gabalas, and Alexandros Gabalas sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Panteleimonissa Bryennios has learned something about Alexandros Gabalas's family that Alexandros Gabalas does not know.

relationships.description: Panteleimonissa Bryennios and Thodoros Makrembolites have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Thodoros Makrembolites has been offered Panteleimonissa Bryennios's post by people who want Panteleimonissa Bryennios gone.

relationships.description: Stephanos Bryennios kept Photeine Drimys's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Photeine Drimys has voted with Stephanos Bryennios ever since.
relationships.tension: Stephanos Bryennios has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Photeine Drimys's partners.

relationships.description: Photeine Drimys and Chrysostomissa Kalojan deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Chrysostomissa Kalojan has recently secured something that makes Photeine Drimys's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: What Theodoros Kurtikios knows, Photeine Drimys taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Photeine Drimys, quietly, whether Theodoros Kurtikios can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Thodoros Makrembolites wants Despoina Niketas's position, and Despoina Niketas wants Thodoros Makrembolites's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Despoina Niketas has been telling clients that Thodoros Makrembolites's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Thodoros Makrembolites.

relationships.description: The alliance between Thodoros Makrembolites and Stephanos Bryennios was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Thodoros Makrembolites has taken a precaution against Stephanos Bryennios that Stephanos Bryennios was not meant to discover. Stephanos Bryennios has discovered it.
