plotHooks: A merchant they publicly opposed is now publicly supporting them. No explanation offered.
Someone who publicly supports them is being paid by someone who opposes them. They know this.

presentation.impression: Warmer than their office suggests. They have the gift of making people feel briefly important.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Möngke Barlas
members.title: Jarghuchi

personality.tell: carries food or sweets, offers them as social lubricant
personality.speech: Uses softening phrases that make every statement sound like a question

physical.feature: close-cropped hair
physical.clothes: a field coat carrying the insignia of a disbanded company

secret.what: Was present when Bayasgalan Khwarezm did something they've never accounted for publicly. Neither has acknowledged the other was there
secret.stakes: The situation they're both ignoring is becoming relevant again

plotHooks: A recruit they turned away has since joined a different outfit. The different outfit is now paying them to monitor this one.
Three guards have gone missing in the same district on night patrol. The report filed says they deserted.

presentation.impression: Alert. Not hostile, but attentive in a way that doesn't quite switch off.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Bayan Arulad
members.title: Noyan

personality.tell: traces patterns on flat surfaces absentmindedly
personality.speech: Repeats key words for emphasis: 'The contract. The contract is clear'

physical.feature: surprisingly soft hands
physical.clothes: a heavy coat worn indoors, contents unexamined

goal.short: Eliminate the threat before it becomes a bigger threat
goal.long: Build insulation between themselves and consequences

secret.what: Has been funding a forbidden relationship with embezzled money
secret.stakes: Both the relationship and the embezzlement would become public simultaneously

plotHooks: One of their people is talking to the guard. They don't know which one yet. They're watching.
A job went wrong in a way that suggests information was leaked. They have three suspects.

presentation.impression: Friendly, easy, slightly too interested in where you're from.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Kadan Geniges
members.title: Noyan

personality.tell: checks exits in every new room before speaking
personality.speech: Ends disagreements by restating the other position, slightly wrong

physical.feature: a habit of standing very still
physical.clothes: work clothes patched by someone who loved them

secret.what: Has been paying a health official to suppress a finding about their product
secret.stakes: People are being harmed; the official is growing nervous; the finding is documented

plotHooks: They know something small that connects to something much larger. They haven't realised the connection. Yet.
Someone they trust completely has started behaving in ways that don't add up.

presentation.impression: Open. The impression of someone with nothing in particular to hide, or who has decided not to hide it.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Jochi Taichiud
members.title: Noyan

personality.tell: never volunteers information, only answers what is asked
personality.speech: Uses the formal royal 'we' (old habit from a previous station)

physical.feature: unusually long fingers
physical.clothes: work clothes patched by someone who loved them

secret.what: Was ordered to commit an atrocity and complied, and has since risen in the organisation that ordered it
secret.stakes: The order came from someone senior; exposure implicates both of them

plotHooks: Someone left an item in their care and hasn't returned. The item is valuable. The absence is now suspicious.
They've been offered money to not ask questions about something they hadn't even started asking about.

presentation.impression: Ordinary in a way that is itself a kind of presence.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Vangchug Merv
members.title: Shaman

personality.tell: maintains an unnervingly fixed smile during conflict
personality.speech: Wields professional titles with surgical precision. Rank omitted is rank denied

physical.feature: hair prematurely grey for their apparent age
physical.clothes: a formal habit with a travel-stained hem never cleaned

goal.short: Restore a desecrated shrine before the annual festival (quietly, without scandal)
goal.long: Unite the fractious local clergy under a single doctrinal standard

secret.what: Has been covering for a colleague's heretical activities out of personal loyalty
secret.stakes: When the colleague is exposed (and they will be), this secret comes with them

plotHooks: The holy relic in their keeping is not what everyone believes it is. Only they know this.
They know which of the current leadership will be the next to fall from grace. They are waiting.

presentation.impression: Watchful, in a religious way: not suspicious, but as though taking a reading.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Chino-Ujin Kyrgyz
members.title: Ongon Böge

personality.tell: quotes scripture or proverbs in casual conversation
personality.speech: Peppers speech with trade or craft jargon even in unrelated contexts

physical.feature: a cloak clasped with an unusual brooch
physical.clothes: a scholar's gown two institutions out of date

goal.short: Resolve a dispute between two factions of the mages' guild without taking sides
goal.long: Establish a magical institution that outlasts their own life and power

secret.what: Was present when Mönkhzul Ghurid did something they've never accounted for publicly. Neither has acknowledged the other was there
secret.stakes: The situation they're both ignoring is becoming relevant again

plotHooks: They've been approached by someone who knows things about their research that were never made public.

presentation.impression: Elsewhere, mentally. The conversation is happening in the foreground while something else has most of their attention.
presentation.behaviour: Polite but brief; makes clear their time is limited.

members.name: Dorbei Kiyad
members.title: Bakhshi

personality.tell: touches a specific piece of jewellery when stressed
personality.speech: Speaks as if dictating a letter, formal even in crisis

physical.feature: a ring on every finger
physical.clothes: a good coat inherited from a larger relative

goal.short: Find funding to continue research after their patron cut support without explanation
goal.long: Mentor someone who will care about truth more than they care about credit

secret.what: Their identity is fabricated. They fled a different life entirely
secret.stakes: The person they became would be destroyed; the person they were might be wanted

plotHooks: Three different people have asked them the same unusual question. None of them knew each other.
A document they were asked to witness contained a clause they noticed at the time and said nothing about.

presentation.impression: Open. The impression of someone with nothing in particular to hide, or who has decided not to hide it.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Enkhbold Mangghud
members.title: Yarguchi

personality.tell: drums fingers on surfaces when thinking
personality.speech: Says 'as you know' before telling people things they do not know

physical.feature: close-cropped hair
physical.clothes: ceremonial attire worn at all times

goal.short: Obtain the resources needed for a desperately needed charitable project
goal.long: Be worthy of the role they hold, which turns out to be the harder task

secret.what: Owes Dorbei Kiyad a debt from before either of them held their current position: one that Dorbei Kiyad has never formally called in
secret.stakes: The silence feels like patience rather than forgiveness

plotHooks: A novice has the gift. They know what that means for the novice. They're not sure what to do.
A donation was made to the institution under conditions the donor didn't disclose publicly. The conditions are becoming relevant.

presentation.impression: Genuinely glad to see you, or performs it so well the difference doesn't matter at first.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Berke Jirgin
members.title: Boo Mörgöl

personality.tell: keeps meticulous written records of every meeting
personality.speech: Quotes their own past pronouncements as though citing law

physical.feature: laugh lines that run deep
physical.clothes: scholarly robes with heavy pockets

goal.short: Find someone capable enough to not endanger others
goal.long: Leave magic in a better state than they found it

secret.what: Has been falsifying inspection records for a fee
secret.stakes: The next disaster caused by the uninspected goods will be traced back to them

plotHooks: An experiment failed in a way that shouldn't be possible. The results have been sealed. They're still thinking.

presentation.impression: Precise: words chosen carefully, pauses before answering, a slight sense of being assessed.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Unurtsetseg Samarkand
members.title: Owner

personality.tell: deflects personal questions with a counter-question
personality.speech: Speaks in analogies and metaphors, even when clarity would serve better

physical.feature: unusually long fingers
physical.clothes: whatever was available (they don't care about dress)

secret.what: Owes Mönkhzul Ghurid a debt from before either of them held their current position: one that Mönkhzul Ghurid has never formally called in
secret.stakes: The silence feels like patience rather than forgiveness

plotHooks: Something they were told was destroyed is apparently not destroyed.
They found something hidden in a place it shouldn't be. They put it back. They haven't told anyone.

presentation.impression: Ordinary in a way that is itself a kind of presence.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Vandansüren Arulad
members.title: Ortaq

personality.tell: addresses everyone by full name, never shortened
personality.speech: Speaks in short, clipped sentences: every word intentional

physical.feature: an old injury that affects their gait
physical.clothes: clothes that once cost a fortune and now show the miles

goal.short: Identify the leak in their supply chain before it empties the accounts
goal.long: Leverage money into influence: that's where security actually lives

secret.what: Their business partner died of natural causes that weren't entirely natural
secret.stakes: An investigation would find ambiguous evidence: enough to ruin, maybe enough to prosecute

plotHooks: A young trader has been undercutting them in ways that shouldn't be possible on their claimed capital.

presentation.impression: Busy, or presenting as busy. The first impression is of someone who doesn't waste time.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Walun Samarkand
members.title: Noyan

personality.tell: unconsciously mimics the posture of whoever they're speaking to
personality.speech: Speaks quickly when lying, slowly when bargaining. The local traders know the tell

physical.feature: a voice that carries further than intended
physical.clothes: a good coat inherited from a larger relative

secret.what: Has been reading Oyun Barlas's correspondence through an intermediary. Nothing damaging yet. But they keep looking
secret.stakes: The intermediary has recently started asking for more money

plotHooks: They overheard something they shouldn't have and don't know what to do with the information.
A stranger passed through, asked specific questions, and left before they could follow up.

presentation.impression: Tired, but alert. The combination of someone who works hard and pays attention.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Khongorzul Mangghud
members.title: Süin Darugachi

personality.tell: keeps their hands clasped behind their back when displeased
personality.speech: Uses understatement and dry humour as a defence mechanism

physical.feature: a network of small scars on their knuckles
physical.clothes: robes cut for a taller predecessor, never altered

secret.what: Knows their religious order was founded on a historical lie
secret.stakes: The truth would shatter the institution they've dedicated their life to

plotHooks: One of their staff has started asking questions about records from seven years ago. They've been reassigned twice already.

presentation.impression: Tired and ordinary. The manner of someone who is carrying less than they are.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative. Unassuming. Easy to overlook.

members.name: Selmeg Naiman
members.title: Dulat

personality.tell: hums under their breath when concentrating
personality.speech: Prefaces bad news with elaborate courtesy, good news with none

physical.feature: a ring on every finger
physical.clothes: whatever is clean (they move frequently)

secret.what: Knows the settlement's most important legal document was fraudulently created
secret.stakes: Revealing it destabilises everything; not revealing it makes them complicit

plotHooks: Someone tried to rob one of their fronts. The attempt was professional. That's more worrying than amateur.
They're protecting someone from something worse. The someone doesn't know and wouldn't thank them.

presentation.impression: Quiet. They let other people fill the silence.
presentation.behaviour: Polite but brief; makes clear their time is limited.

members.name: Wershi Arulad
members.title: Kheshig

personality.tell: laughs loudly at their own jokes, silently at others'
personality.speech: Trails off mid-sentence when approaching something they regret knowing

physical.feature: a ring on every finger
physical.clothes: dress entirely without signal (deliberately so)

secret.what: Was present when Kadan Geniges did something they've never accounted for publicly. Neither has acknowledged the other was there
secret.stakes: The situation they're both ignoring is becoming relevant again

plotHooks: A regular customer has stopped coming. The reason they've been given doesn't make sense.

presentation.impression: Tired, but alert. The combination of someone who works hard and pays attention.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Khishigbayar Dzungar
members.title: Böge

personality.tell: always stands when others sit, or vice versa
personality.speech: Speaks softly, forcing others to lean in

physical.feature: close-cropped hair
physical.clothes: deceptively plain clothes that crackle faintly with residual energy

secret.what: Has been reading Saikhan Samarkand's correspondence through an intermediary. Nothing damaging yet. But they keep looking
secret.stakes: The intermediary has recently started asking for more money

plotHooks: The magical ward they placed on the vaults was bypassed. Not broken. Bypassed. That requires inside knowledge.

presentation.impression: Polite but removed. Not unfriendly, just operating at a different register.
presentation.behaviour: Polite but brief; makes clear their time is limited.

relationships.description: The alliance between Torghil Zunghar and Mönkhzul Ghurid was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Torghil Zunghar has taken a precaution against Mönkhzul Ghurid that Mönkhzul Ghurid was not meant to discover. Mönkhzul Ghurid has discovered it.

relationships.description: Torghil Zunghar named Chilaun Oirat as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Chilaun Oirat has begun teaching Torghil Zunghar's methods as Chilaun Oirat's own.

relationships.description: Naya Tatar paid Torghil Zunghar's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Torghil Zunghar mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Naya Tatar has asked Torghil Zunghar for a vote against Torghil Zunghar's own interests. It is the first payment Naya Tatar has asked for.

relationships.description: Ibaka Kipchak and Zagdaakhüü Geniges are cousins on opposite sides of the settlement's politics. Their grandmother still seats them together.
relationships.tension: Zagdaakhüü Geniges has gone into business against Ibaka Kipchak's partners, and the family expects Ibaka Kipchak to keep the peace.

relationships.description: Ibaka Kipchak and Chilaun Oirat bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Ibaka Kipchak has hired away Chilaun Oirat's best assistant. Chilaun Oirat has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Ibaka Kipchak hunts Luvsandorj Jirgin's operation street by street, and Luvsandorj Jirgin moves it one street ahead. The chase has lasted two winters.
relationships.tension: Ibaka Kipchak has been ordered to stand down against Luvsandorj Jirgin by someone above Ibaka Kipchak. The order did not say why.

relationships.description: Vangchug Merv and Enkhbold Mangghud trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Vangchug Merv or Enkhbold Mangghud can fill it.

relationships.description: Vangchug Merv testified against Bayasgalan Khwarezm in a case ten years ago. Bayasgalan Khwarezm lost a fortune and has not spoken to Vangchug Merv since.
relationships.tension: Bayasgalan Khwarezm has been appointed to judge a case in which Vangchug Merv is a party.

relationships.description: Vangchug Merv sends difficult cases to Chilaun Oirat, and Chilaun Oirat sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Vangchug Merv has learned something about Chilaun Oirat's family that Chilaun Oirat does not know.

relationships.description: Chino-Ujin Kyrgyz owes Bayasgalan Khwarezm a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Chino-Ujin Kyrgyz has started repaying the debt in coin. Bayasgalan Khwarezm wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Berke Jirgin kept Chino-Ujin Kyrgyz's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Chino-Ujin Kyrgyz has voted with Berke Jirgin ever since.
relationships.tension: Berke Jirgin has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Chino-Ujin Kyrgyz's partners.

relationships.description: Abu Said Jirgin nursed Chino-Ujin Kyrgyz through a winter fever when no one else would come. Chino-Ujin Kyrgyz still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Chino-Ujin Kyrgyz has refused Abu Said Jirgin a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Ergene Tanghud and Abu Said Jirgin deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Abu Said Jirgin has recently secured something that makes Ergene Tanghud's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Ergene Tanghud borrowed Vandansüren Arulad's good name to win a post. Vandansüren Arulad has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Vandansüren Arulad has fallen on hard times, and the debt Ergene Tanghud owes is now the only asset Vandansüren Arulad has.

relationships.description: Abu Said Jirgin and Vandansüren Arulad have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Vandansüren Arulad has been offered Abu Said Jirgin's post by people who want Abu Said Jirgin gone.

relationships.description: Abu Said Jirgin and Oyuntuya Ghaznavid trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Abu Said Jirgin has asked Oyuntuya Ghaznavid for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Chilaun Oirat controls a vote Naya Tatar needs, and Naya Tatar controls a supply Chilaun Oirat needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Naya Tatar has found a new source for what Chilaun Oirat supplies. Chilaun Oirat has not been told.

relationships.description: Chilaun Oirat and Ibaka Cumans share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Ibaka Cumans has been dining with Chilaun Oirat's rivals. Chilaun Oirat heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Zagdaakhüü Geniges and Möngke Barlas each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Möngke Barlas needs from Zagdaakhüü Geniges comes up next week, and Zagdaakhüü Geniges has named a new price.

relationships.description: Zagdaakhüü Geniges has made dismantling Bayan Arulad's operation a personal priority. The feeling is mutual.
relationships.tension: Bayan Arulad has leverage on someone close to Zagdaakhüü Geniges. It hasn't been used yet.

relationships.description: Zagdaakhüü Geniges and Ibaka Cumans back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Zagdaakhüü Geniges wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Ibaka Cumans thinks the newcomer would take Ibaka Cumans's place.

relationships.description: Saikhan Samarkand shaped Dorbei Kiyad's career in ways that Dorbei Kiyad has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Dorbei Kiyad now operates in ways Saikhan Samarkand would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Unurtsetseg Samarkand needs Saikhan Samarkand's seal on certain papers; Saikhan Samarkand needs Unurtsetseg Samarkand's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Saikhan Samarkand's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Unurtsetseg Samarkand holds nothing over Saikhan Samarkand.

relationships.description: Wershi Arulad is Saikhan Samarkand's half-sibling, raised in the same house and left out of the same will.
relationships.tension: A family property must be sold, and Saikhan Samarkand and Wershi Arulad each want the money for a different purpose.

relationships.description: Chilaun Oirat stands where Mönkhzul Ghurid put them, by a ladder Mönkhzul Ghurid built and Chilaun Oirat has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Mönkhzul Ghurid has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Chilaun Oirat knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Mönkhzul Ghurid owes Naya Tatar something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Naya Tatar is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Naya Tatar and Ibaka Cumans sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Ibaka Cumans has written down what Naya Tatar owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Naya Tatar and Khongorzul Mangghud each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: What Bayan Arulad knows would ruin Luvsandorj Jirgin; what Luvsandorj Jirgin holds would finish Bayan Arulad. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Selmeg Naiman took the post Bayan Arulad had been promised. Bayan Arulad has treated Selmeg Naiman as an enemy from that day.
relationships.tension: Bayan Arulad has found the document that proves what Selmeg Naiman did, and has kept it locked away.

relationships.description: Berke Jirgin once told the council that Bayan Arulad was right and Berke Jirgin was wrong. Bayan Arulad has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Bayan Arulad has made a mistake that Berke Jirgin is bound to report. Berke Jirgin has not reported it.

relationships.description: Dorbei Kiyad wants Wershi Arulad's position, and Wershi Arulad wants Dorbei Kiyad's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Wershi Arulad has been telling clients that Dorbei Kiyad's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Dorbei Kiyad.

relationships.description: Dorbei Kiyad and Abu Said Jirgin are in-laws. They are polite at family dinners and avoid each other everywhere else.
relationships.tension: Dorbei Kiyad's rivals have learned that Abu Said Jirgin is family, and have started asking Abu Said Jirgin questions.

relationships.description: What Chilaun Oirat knows, Dorbei Kiyad taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Dorbei Kiyad, quietly, whether Chilaun Oirat can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Selmeg Naiman needs Luvsandorj Jirgin's seal on certain papers; Luvsandorj Jirgin needs Selmeg Naiman's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Luvsandorj Jirgin's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Selmeg Naiman holds nothing over Luvsandorj Jirgin.

relationships.description: Luvsandorj Jirgin and Ergene Tanghud sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Ergene Tanghud has written down what Luvsandorj Jirgin owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Kadan Geniges and Jochi Taichiud were partners until one of them emptied the shared account. Each says it was the other.
relationships.tension: Kadan Geniges and Jochi Taichiud have been placed on the same council committee. The first meeting is next week.

relationships.description: Every client Kadan Geniges wins is one Chilaun Oirat lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Kadan Geniges and Chilaun Oirat will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Bayasgalan Khwarezm brings the votes and Oyun Barlas brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Oyun Barlas voted against Bayasgalan Khwarezm on a small matter last week. Bayasgalan Khwarezm is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Bayasgalan Khwarezm and Ergene Tanghud are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Bayasgalan Khwarezm lost the last contract to Ergene Tanghud by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Ibaka Cumans and Khongorzul Mangghud consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Ibaka Cumans and Khongorzul Mangghud to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Ibaka Cumans and Ibaka Kipchak signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Ibaka Cumans and Ibaka Kipchak both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Enkhbold Mangghud and Chilaun Oirat deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Chilaun Oirat has recently secured something that makes Enkhbold Mangghud's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Enkhbold Mangghud and Berke Jirgin are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Berke Jirgin has asked Enkhbold Mangghud to back a candidate Enkhbold Mangghud distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Enkhbold Mangghud and Khishigbayar Dzungar work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Berke Jirgin and Oyun Barlas compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Berke Jirgin and Khishigbayar Dzungar want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Vandansüren Arulad and Oyuntuya Ghaznavid trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Vandansüren Arulad has asked Oyuntuya Ghaznavid for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Vandansüren Arulad governs on Chilaun Oirat's credit. Every loan renewed adds one more condition to the next.
relationships.tension: Chilaun Oirat has refused credit for the winter grain stores. Vandansüren Arulad must choose between the creditor and the granary.

relationships.description: Every advance Vandansüren Arulad makes is answered by Bayan Arulad within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Jochi Taichiud took Walun Samarkand in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Walun Samarkand has taken on a client Jochi Taichiud turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Jochi Taichiud and Ibaka Kipchak bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Jochi Taichiud has hired away Ibaka Kipchak's best assistant. Ibaka Kipchak has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Years ago Ergene Tanghud did for Jochi Taichiud the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Jochi Taichiud has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Jochi Taichiud has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Ergene Tanghud does not.

relationships.description: Möngke Barlas and Ibaka Kipchak are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Möngke Barlas and Chilaun Oirat signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Möngke Barlas and Chilaun Oirat both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Oyuntuya Ghaznavid and Ergene Tanghud trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Oyuntuya Ghaznavid or Ergene Tanghud can fill it.

relationships.description: The settlement's civic functions run on credit extended by Chilaun Oirat. Oyuntuya Ghaznavid cannot take any action that seriously threatens Chilaun Oirat's interests, and Chilaun Oirat does not let this be forgotten.
relationships.tension: Oyuntuya Ghaznavid has identified an alternative creditor. Chilaun Oirat has heard the same rumour.

relationships.description: Oyun Barlas wants Khishigbayar Dzungar's position, and Khishigbayar Dzungar wants Oyun Barlas's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Khishigbayar Dzungar has been telling clients that Oyun Barlas's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Oyun Barlas.

relationships.description: Oyun Barlas trusts Abu Said Jirgin's word over any written contract. Abu Said Jirgin has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Abu Said Jirgin has publicly backed a plan that Oyun Barlas thinks will fail. Oyun Barlas has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Oyun Barlas controls a vote Luvsandorj Jirgin needs, and Luvsandorj Jirgin controls a supply Oyun Barlas needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Luvsandorj Jirgin has found a new source for what Oyun Barlas supplies. Oyun Barlas has not been told.

relationships.description: Between Walun Samarkand and Kadan Geniges stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Walun Samarkand and Ibaka Kipchak have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Walun Samarkand and Abu Said Jirgin are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Abu Said Jirgin has asked Walun Samarkand to back a candidate Walun Samarkand distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Every client Unurtsetseg Samarkand wins is one Wershi Arulad lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Unurtsetseg Samarkand and Wershi Arulad will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Unurtsetseg Samarkand and Dorbei Kiyad are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Unurtsetseg Samarkand lost the last contract to Dorbei Kiyad by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Unurtsetseg Samarkand borrowed Vandansüren Arulad's good name to win a post. Vandansüren Arulad has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Vandansüren Arulad has fallen on hard times, and the debt Unurtsetseg Samarkand owes is now the only asset Vandansüren Arulad has.

relationships.description: Khongorzul Mangghud and Chilaun Oirat bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Khongorzul Mangghud has hired away Chilaun Oirat's best assistant. Chilaun Oirat has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Ergene Tanghud holds the settlement's debts and therefore, in every way that matters, its agenda; Khongorzul Mangghud governs within the margin Ergene Tanghud allows.
relationships.tension: The interest falls due at midsummer and the treasury will not cover it. Ergene Tanghud has already drafted the terms of the extension.

relationships.description: The alliance between Khongorzul Mangghud and Zagdaakhüü Geniges was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Khongorzul Mangghud has taken a precaution against Zagdaakhüü Geniges that Zagdaakhüü Geniges was not meant to discover. Zagdaakhüü Geniges has discovered it.

relationships.description: Selmeg Naiman keeps a file on Ibaka Kipchak's operation that grows by the week; Ibaka Kipchak keeps one on Selmeg Naiman that is already complete.
relationships.tension: Selmeg Naiman is one warrant away from a raid that would end it. The warrant keeps not being signed.

relationships.description: Years ago Abu Said Jirgin did for Selmeg Naiman the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Selmeg Naiman has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Selmeg Naiman has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Abu Said Jirgin does not.

relationships.description: The war between Selmeg Naiman and Zagdaakhüü Geniges is fought in raids, informants, and paperwork. Neither side counts it as winnable; neither will stop.
relationships.tension: Someone in Selmeg Naiman's command reports to Zagdaakhüü Geniges. The file says so; it does not say who.

relationships.description: Ergene Tanghud paid Wershi Arulad's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Wershi Arulad mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Ergene Tanghud has asked Wershi Arulad for a vote against Wershi Arulad's own interests. It is the first payment Ergene Tanghud has asked for.

relationships.description: Chilaun Oirat learned the work at Wershi Arulad's side for seven years. Half of Chilaun Oirat's clients first came through Wershi Arulad's door.
relationships.tension: Wershi Arulad has taken a new apprentice, and Chilaun Oirat has heard the apprentice is being taught things Chilaun Oirat never was.

relationships.description: Wershi Arulad and Vandansüren Arulad disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Khishigbayar Dzungar vouched for Ergene Tanghud when nobody else would. Ergene Tanghud's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Ergene Tanghud corrected Khishigbayar Dzungar in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Bayan Arulad still uses Khishigbayar Dzungar's methods and Khishigbayar Dzungar's ledger format. Everyone who sees Bayan Arulad's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Khishigbayar Dzungar has asked Bayan Arulad for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Khishigbayar Dzungar blames Vandansüren Arulad for a death in Khishigbayar Dzungar's family. Vandansüren Arulad has never denied it.
relationships.tension: Vandansüren Arulad's child has asked to apprentice with Khishigbayar Dzungar. Khishigbayar Dzungar has not refused.

personality.speech: Drops to a near-whisper when saying something important

physical.feature: eyes that never stop moving
physical.clothes: work clothes patched by someone who loved them

goal.long: Build enough stability that they have choices

personality.speech: Asks rhetorical questions to make points rather than stating them

physical.feature: an old injury that affects their gait
physical.clothes: formal robes of office

goal.long: Build a political dynasty (their children will inherit influence, not just money)

secret.what: Has been feeding the enemy's quartermasters the same false supply figures they feed their own, playing both requisitions for the skim
secret.stakes: When the war ends, both sides will reconcile their books. The discrepancy points one direction

Weapons from the armoury have been disappearing in small quantities for months. The inventory matches, somehow.

relationships.description: Salome Meyer and Theodelinde Klein trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Salome Meyer or Theodelinde Klein can fill it.

relationships.description: Volkera Zimmermann stands where Salome Meyer put them, by a ladder Salome Meyer built and Volkera Zimmermann has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Salome Meyer has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Volkera Zimmermann knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: What Theodelinde Klein knows, Volkera Zimmermann taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Volkera Zimmermann, quietly, whether Theodelinde Klein can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Theodelinde Klein owes Kunigunde Müller something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.

relationships.description: Adel al-Isfahani reports to Hicham al-Masri on paper and to no one in practice. Hicham al-Masri has three letters of complaint unanswered.
relationships.tension: Adel al-Isfahani arrested a councillor's son without Hicham al-Masri's warrant. Hicham al-Masri has demanded his release by tomorrow.

relationships.description: The alliance between Hicham al-Masri and Duha al-Misri was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Hicham al-Masri has taken a precaution against Duha al-Misri that Duha al-Misri was not meant to discover. Duha al-Misri has discovered it.

relationships.description: Between Hicham al-Masri and Sabah al-Rumi stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Adel al-Isfahani controls a vote Duha al-Misri needs, and Duha al-Misri controls a supply Adel al-Isfahani needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Duha al-Misri has found a new source for what Adel al-Isfahani supplies. Adel al-Isfahani has not been told.

relationships.description: Adel al-Isfahani and Sabah al-Rumi have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Samira al-Yamani and Sabah al-Rumi each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Sabah al-Rumi needs from Samira al-Yamani comes up next week, and Samira al-Yamani has named a new price.

relationships.description: Isa al-Rashidi needs Samira al-Yamani's seal on certain papers; Samira al-Yamani needs Isa al-Rashidi's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Samira al-Yamani's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Isa al-Rashidi holds nothing over Samira al-Yamani.

relationships.description: Duha al-Misri wants the watch under civil command; Sabah al-Rumi wants the council out of the barracks. They meet monthly and settle nothing.
relationships.tension: Duha al-Misri has asked the capital to replace Sabah al-Rumi. Sabah al-Rumi has asked the capital to dissolve Duha al-Misri's council.

relationships.description: Adnan al-Misri paid Isa al-Rashidi's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Isa al-Rashidi mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Adnan al-Misri has asked Isa al-Rashidi for a vote against Isa al-Rashidi's own interests. It is the first payment Adnan al-Misri has asked for.

relationships.description: Isa al-Rashidi and Sabah al-Rumi were partners until one of them emptied the shared account. Each says it was the other.
relationships.tension: Isa al-Rashidi and Sabah al-Rumi have been placed on the same council committee. The first meeting is next week.

relationships.description: Adnan al-Misri learned the work at Sabah al-Rumi's side for seven years. Half of Adnan al-Misri's clients first came through Sabah al-Rumi's door.
relationships.tension: Sabah al-Rumi has taken a new apprentice, and Adnan al-Misri has heard the apprentice is being taught things Adnan al-Misri never was.

relationships.description: Adnan al-Misri vouched for Hicham al-Masri when nobody else would. Hicham al-Masri's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Hicham al-Masri corrected Adnan al-Misri in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Adel al-Isfahani still uses Adnan al-Misri's methods and Adnan al-Misri's ledger format. Everyone who sees Adel al-Isfahani's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Adnan al-Misri has asked Adel al-Isfahani for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Peter Hoffmann and Heinrich Pfaff bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Peter Hoffmann has hired away Heinrich Pfaff's best assistant. Heinrich Pfaff has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Peter Hoffmann and Adelheid Becker trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Peter Hoffmann or Adelheid Becker can fill it.

relationships.description: Heinrich Pfaff wants Adelheid Becker's position, and Adelheid Becker wants Heinrich Pfaff's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Adelheid Becker has been telling clients that Heinrich Pfaff's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Heinrich Pfaff.

relationships.description: Paul Bauer still uses Heinrich Pfaff's methods and Heinrich Pfaff's ledger format. Everyone who sees Paul Bauer's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Heinrich Pfaff has asked Paul Bauer for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Heinrich Pfaff borrowed Emmerich Schenk's good name to win a post. Emmerich Schenk has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Emmerich Schenk has fallen on hard times, and the debt Heinrich Pfaff owes is now the only asset Emmerich Schenk has.

relationships.description: Notger Lehmann needs Josefine Ritter's seal on certain papers; Josefine Ritter needs Notger Lehmann's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Josefine Ritter's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Notger Lehmann holds nothing over Josefine Ritter.

relationships.description: Every client Josefine Ritter wins is one Salome Naumann lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Josefine Ritter and Salome Naumann will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Ignatz Fischer and Emmerich Schenk consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Ignatz Fischer and Emmerich Schenk to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Ignatz Fischer and Salome Naumann are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Ignatz Fischer lost the last contract to Salome Naumann by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Ignatz Fischer named Oda Brauer as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Oda Brauer has begun teaching Ignatz Fischer's methods as Oda Brauer's own.

relationships.description: Adelheid Becker shaped Renate Lehmann's career in ways that Renate Lehmann has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Renate Lehmann now operates in ways Adelheid Becker would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Paul Bauer and Ignatz Fischer are in-laws. They are polite at family dinners and avoid each other everywhere else.
relationships.tension: Paul Bauer's rivals have learned that Ignatz Fischer is family, and have started asking Ignatz Fischer questions.

relationships.description: Paul Bauer owes Emmerich Schenk something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Emmerich Schenk is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Emmerich Schenk and Salome Naumann sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Salome Naumann has written down what Emmerich Schenk owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Emmerich Schenk is godparent to Oda Brauer's eldest child. The tie was made before their careers set them against each other.
relationships.tension: The family has asked Emmerich Schenk and Oda Brauer to end their quarrel before the next feast. Neither will apologise first.

relationships.description: Peter Hoffmann stands where Emmerich Schenk put them, by a ladder Emmerich Schenk built and Peter Hoffmann has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Emmerich Schenk has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Peter Hoffmann knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Notger Lehmann and Ignatz Fischer compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: What Emmerich Schenk knows, Notger Lehmann taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Notger Lehmann, quietly, whether Emmerich Schenk can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Salome Naumann and Oda Brauer each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Salome Naumann trusts Vilbirg Walter's word over any written contract. Vilbirg Walter has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Vilbirg Walter has publicly backed a plan that Salome Naumann thinks will fail. Salome Naumann has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Renate Lehmann and Notger Lehmann signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Renate Lehmann and Notger Lehmann both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Renate Lehmann took Heinrich Pfaff in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Heinrich Pfaff has taken on a client Renate Lehmann turned away on principle.

relationships.description: What Renate Lehmann knows would ruin Ignatz Fischer; what Ignatz Fischer holds would finish Renate Lehmann. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Years ago Notger Lehmann did for Oda Brauer the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Oda Brauer has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Oda Brauer has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Notger Lehmann does not.

relationships.description: Oda Brauer and Renate Lehmann want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Vilbirg Walter and Ignatz Fischer are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Ignatz Fischer has asked Vilbirg Walter to back a candidate Vilbirg Walter distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Every advance Vilbirg Walter makes is answered by Paul Bauer within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: What Erasmus Schwarz knows would ruin Egilbert Jäger; what Egilbert Jäger holds would finish Erasmus Schwarz. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Erasmus Schwarz and Beatrix Weis, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Erasmus Schwarz and Bonifaz Theis work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Gregor Licht controls the garrison's pay and Balduin Fuchs controls its swords. Each uses their half to bargain for the other's.
relationships.tension: Gregor Licht has cut the garrison's pay to fund the market repairs. Balduin Fuchs has told the soldiers who signed the order.

relationships.description: Gregor Licht and Xavier Fink compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Walburga Engel reports to Gregor Licht on paper and to no one in practice. Gregor Licht has three letters of complaint unanswered.
relationships.tension: Walburga Engel arrested a councillor's son without Gregor Licht's warrant. Gregor Licht has demanded his release by tomorrow.

relationships.description: Wilhelm Bauer and Andreas Jäger are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: The alliance between Wilhelm Bauer and Erasmus Schwarz was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Wilhelm Bauer has taken a precaution against Erasmus Schwarz that Erasmus Schwarz was not meant to discover. Erasmus Schwarz has discovered it.

relationships.description: Elfriede Graf and Lena Wagner deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Lena Wagner has recently secured something that makes Elfriede Graf's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Elfriede Graf and Wigbert Schmitt trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Elfriede Graf has asked Wigbert Schmitt for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Elfriede Graf sends difficult cases to Balduin Fuchs, and Balduin Fuchs sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Elfriede Graf has learned something about Balduin Fuchs's family that Balduin Fuchs does not know.

relationships.description: Andreas Jäger and Sophia Forster share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Sophia Forster has been dining with Andreas Jäger's rivals. Andreas Jäger heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Konrad Zimmermann is Andreas Jäger's half-sibling, raised in the same house and left out of the same will.
relationships.tension: A family property must be sold, and Andreas Jäger and Konrad Zimmermann each want the money for a different purpose.

relationships.description: Andreas Jäger and Wigbert Schmitt want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Wigbert Schmitt and Frieda Hartmann have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Frieda Hartmann has been offered Wigbert Schmitt's post by people who want Wigbert Schmitt gone.

relationships.description: Wigbert Schmitt controls a vote Balduin Fuchs needs, and Balduin Fuchs controls a supply Wigbert Schmitt needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Balduin Fuchs has found a new source for what Wigbert Schmitt supplies. Wigbert Schmitt has not been told.

relationships.description: Sophia Forster once told the council that Wigbert Schmitt was right and Sophia Forster was wrong. Wigbert Schmitt has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Wigbert Schmitt has made a mistake that Sophia Forster is bound to report. Sophia Forster has not reported it.

relationships.description: Lena Wagner shaped Wigbert Schmitt's career in ways that Wigbert Schmitt has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Wigbert Schmitt now operates in ways Lena Wagner would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Lena Wagner and Xavier Fink consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Lena Wagner and Xavier Fink to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Balduin Fuchs and Xavier Fink each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Xavier Fink needs from Balduin Fuchs comes up next week, and Balduin Fuchs has named a new price.

relationships.description: Walburga Engel needs Balduin Fuchs's seal on certain papers; Balduin Fuchs needs Walburga Engel's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Balduin Fuchs's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Walburga Engel holds nothing over Balduin Fuchs.

relationships.description: Balduin Fuchs and Godela Rosenfeld sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Godela Rosenfeld has written down what Balduin Fuchs owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Beatrix Weis trusts Bonifaz Theis's word over any written contract. Bonifaz Theis has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Bonifaz Theis has publicly backed a plan that Beatrix Weis thinks will fail. Beatrix Weis has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Beatrix Weis and Wilhelm Bauer have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Frieda Hartmann and Balduin Fuchs back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Frieda Hartmann wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Balduin Fuchs thinks the newcomer would take Balduin Fuchs's place.

relationships.description: Every advance Frieda Hartmann makes is answered by Walburga Engel within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Cuno Pfaff brings the votes and Gisela Weis brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Gisela Weis voted against Cuno Pfaff on a small matter last week. Cuno Pfaff is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Cuno Pfaff and Dietmar Müller signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Cuno Pfaff and Dietmar Müller both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Wendelin Müller and Godela Rosenfeld are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Godela Rosenfeld has asked Wendelin Müller to back a candidate Wendelin Müller distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Wendelin Müller and Xantippa Friedmann bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Wendelin Müller has hired away Xantippa Friedmann's best assistant. Xantippa Friedmann has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Sophia Forster and Xantippa Friedmann trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Sophia Forster or Xantippa Friedmann can fill it.

relationships.description: Sophia Forster blames Konrad Zimmermann for a death in Sophia Forster's family. Konrad Zimmermann has never denied it.
relationships.tension: Konrad Zimmermann's child has asked to apprentice with Sophia Forster. Sophia Forster has not refused.

relationships.description: Dorothea Forster stands where Sophia Forster put them, by a ladder Sophia Forster built and Dorothea Forster has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Sophia Forster has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Dorothea Forster knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Xavier Fink wants Walburga Engel's position, and Walburga Engel wants Xavier Fink's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Walburga Engel has been telling clients that Xavier Fink's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Xavier Fink.

relationships.description: Xavier Fink and Wigbert Schmitt each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Xavier Fink and Frieda Hartmann disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Every client Gisela Weis wins is one Dietmar Müller lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Gisela Weis and Dietmar Müller will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Gisela Weis and Volker Krüger are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Gisela Weis lost the last contract to Volker Krüger by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: What Osterhild Fink knows, Gisela Weis taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).

relationships.description: Volker Krüger and Osterhild Fink sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Osterhild Fink has written down what Volker Krüger owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Volker Krüger and Lena Wagner fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Lena Wagner's face.
relationships.tension: Volker Krüger has learned that Lena Wagner is in debt and could be ruined by one call on a loan.

relationships.description: Eckehart Brauer and Burkhard Frank are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Eckehart Brauer lost the last contract to Burkhard Frank by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Eckehart Brauer sends difficult cases to Elfriede Graf, and Elfriede Graf sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Eckehart Brauer has learned something about Elfriede Graf's family that Elfriede Graf does not know.

relationships.description: Burkhard Frank and Barbara Licht bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Burkhard Frank has hired away Barbara Licht's best assistant. Barbara Licht has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Burkhard Frank and Elfriede Graf back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Burkhard Frank wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Elfriede Graf thinks the newcomer would take Elfriede Graf's place.

relationships.description: Burkhard Frank and Lena Wagner have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Lena Wagner has been offered Burkhard Frank's post by people who want Burkhard Frank gone.

relationships.description: Egilbert Jäger and Beatrix Weis deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Beatrix Weis has recently secured something that makes Egilbert Jäger's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Egilbert Jäger and Bonifaz Theis trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Egilbert Jäger or Bonifaz Theis can fill it.

relationships.description: Barbara Licht and Eckehart Brauer trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Barbara Licht has asked Eckehart Brauer for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Gregor Licht's people are never searched on Barbara Licht's watch. The arrangement is three years old and has never been put in writing.
relationships.tension: One of Gregor Licht's runners was arrested by a patrol Barbara Licht did not assign. The runner knows both their names.

relationships.description: Years ago Elfriede Graf did for Barbara Licht the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Barbara Licht has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Barbara Licht has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Elfriede Graf does not.

relationships.description: Something happened between Bonifaz Theis and Wilhelm Bauer years ago that neither has forgotten. They function professionally. They do not forgive.
relationships.tension: The circumstances that caused the original rupture are repeating. Both of them know it.

relationships.description: Between Bonifaz Theis and Andreas Jäger stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Konrad Zimmermann brings the votes and Godela Rosenfeld brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Godela Rosenfeld voted against Konrad Zimmermann on a small matter last week. Konrad Zimmermann is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Konrad Zimmermann and Wendelin Müller are in-laws. They are polite at family dinners and avoid each other everywhere else.
relationships.tension: Konrad Zimmermann's rivals have learned that Wendelin Müller is family, and have started asking Wendelin Müller questions.

relationships.description: Sophia Forster paid Godela Rosenfeld's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Godela Rosenfeld mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Sophia Forster has asked Godela Rosenfeld for a vote against Godela Rosenfeld's own interests. It is the first payment Sophia Forster has asked for.

relationships.description: Godela Rosenfeld wants Wigbert Schmitt's position, and Wigbert Schmitt wants Godela Rosenfeld's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Wigbert Schmitt has been telling clients that Godela Rosenfeld's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Godela Rosenfeld.

relationships.description: Godela Rosenfeld controls a vote Frieda Hartmann needs, and Frieda Hartmann controls a supply Godela Rosenfeld needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Frieda Hartmann has found a new source for what Godela Rosenfeld supplies. Godela Rosenfeld has not been told.

relationships.description: Dietwald Krüger and Erasmus Schwarz signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Dietwald Krüger and Erasmus Schwarz both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Dietwald Krüger took Egilbert Jäger in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Egilbert Jäger has taken on a client Dietwald Krüger turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Osterhild Fink and Cuno Pfaff are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Cuno Pfaff has asked Osterhild Fink to back a candidate Osterhild Fink distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Osterhild Fink and Elfriede Graf each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Elfriede Graf needs from Osterhild Fink comes up next week, and Osterhild Fink has named a new price.

relationships.description: Lena Wagner learned the work at Osterhild Fink's side for seven years. Half of Lena Wagner's clients first came through Osterhild Fink's door.
relationships.tension: Osterhild Fink has taken a new apprentice, and Lena Wagner has heard the apprentice is being taught things Lena Wagner never was.

relationships.description: Every client Theodelinde Prinz wins is one Cuno Pfaff lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Theodelinde Prinz and Cuno Pfaff will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Wigbert Schmitt needs Theodelinde Prinz's seal on certain papers; Theodelinde Prinz needs Wigbert Schmitt's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Theodelinde Prinz's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Wigbert Schmitt holds nothing over Theodelinde Prinz.

relationships.description: Theodelinde Prinz and Lena Wagner were something to each other once (partners, friends, perhaps more), and the wreck of it is the one subject on which both are permanently silent.
relationships.tension: An apology is owed in one direction and expected in the other, and they disagree about which.

relationships.description: The alliance between Dorothea Forster and Xantippa Friedmann was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Dorothea Forster has taken a precaution against Xantippa Friedmann that Xantippa Friedmann was not meant to discover. Xantippa Friedmann has discovered it.

relationships.description: Dorothea Forster is godparent to Konrad Zimmermann's eldest child. The tie was made before their careers set them against each other.
relationships.tension: The family has asked Dorothea Forster and Konrad Zimmermann to end their quarrel before the next feast. Neither will apologise first.

secret.stakes: The information passed was minor. Or seemed minor. They're no longer certain

presentation.impression: Reserved. Not hostile, just private.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

npcs.activeConstraint: Traditional authority in stable conditions is in slow structural decline relative to institutional authority.

plotHooks: Someone they trust completely has started behaving in ways that don't add up.

members.name: Velko Klimov
members.title: Patriarch

personality.tell: unconsciously mimics the posture of whoever they're speaking to
personality.speech: Verbose and elaborate; takes three sentences where one would do

physical.feature: hair prematurely grey for their apparent age
physical.clothes: religious vestments layered over travelling clothes

goal.short: Preserve the institution's position through the transition without either abandoning the congregation or openly defying the new authority
goal.long: Simply keep the community together: feed them, marry them, bury them with dignity

secret.what: Has been feeding strategic intelligence to a rival settlement
secret.stakes: Treason charges; execution or exile in most jurisdictions
