presentation.impression: Interested in you as a person, or at least in what you might need. The attention feels real.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.stressNote: The institution has survived political upheaval before by being indispensable. Whether it can repeat that calculation here is the open question.

members.name: Uljana Kozlov
members.title: Patriarch

personality.tell: pauses for exactly three seconds before answering any question
personality.speech: Pauses mid-sentence to choose words with visible care

physical.feature: teeth that have been replaced with metal
physical.clothes: simple robes of their order

goal.short: Secure the endowments and properties of the old faith before they are lost in the confusion
goal.long: Turn a crisis of belief into a permanent hold on what the belief once owned

secret.what: Knows the conversion was arranged for reasons that had nothing to do with faith (a debt, a marriage, a foreign hand) and holds the correspondence that proves it
secret.stakes: Elder Council would pay to bury it. The other faith would pay more to reveal it

plotHooks: They know which of the current leadership will be the next to fall from grace. They are waiting.
The previous holder of their position left a letter, sealed, to be opened after their death. It wasn't.

presentation.impression: Composed. The particular stillness of someone who has practised being still.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

relationships.description: Every advance Uglješa Egorov makes is answered by Ruslan Ivanov within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: What Velko Klimov knows, Uglješa Egorov taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Uglješa Egorov, quietly, whether Velko Klimov can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Uglješa Egorov and Anna Sidorov have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Anna Sidorov has been offered Uglješa Egorov's post by people who want Uglješa Egorov gone.

relationships.description: Ruslan Ivanov owes Anna Sidorov something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Anna Sidorov is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Velko Klimov took Uljana Kozlov in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Uljana Kozlov has taken on a client Velko Klimov turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Uglješa Egorov learned the work at Evtim Novikov's side for seven years. Half of Uglješa Egorov's clients first came through Evtim Novikov's door.
relationships.tension: Evtim Novikov has taken a new apprentice, and Uglješa Egorov has heard the apprentice is being taught things Uglješa Egorov never was.

relationships.description: Evtim Novikov controls a vote Uljana Kozlov needs, and Uljana Kozlov controls a supply Evtim Novikov needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Uljana Kozlov has found a new source for what Evtim Novikov supplies. Evtim Novikov has not been told.

relationships.description: Evtim Novikov once told the council that Anna Sidorov was right and Evtim Novikov was wrong. Anna Sidorov has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Anna Sidorov has made a mistake that Evtim Novikov is bound to report. Evtim Novikov has not reported it.

relationships.description: Anna Sidorov and Uljana Kozlov are in-laws. They are polite at family dinners and avoid each other everywhere else.
relationships.tension: Anna Sidorov's rivals have learned that Uljana Kozlov is family, and have started asking Uljana Kozlov questions.

relationships.description: Anna Sidorov vouched for Velko Klimov when nobody else would. Velko Klimov's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Velko Klimov corrected Anna Sidorov in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Uglješa Egorov still uses Uljana Kozlov's methods and Uljana Kozlov's ledger format. Everyone who sees Uglješa Egorov's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Uljana Kozlov has asked Uglješa Egorov for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Uljana Kozlov named Ruslan Ivanov as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Ruslan Ivanov has begun teaching Uljana Kozlov's methods as Ruslan Ivanov's own.

goal.long: Build lasting institutional reform that outlives their tenure

secret.stakes: The intermediary has recently started asking for more money

plotHooks: They've been meeting privately with someone from outside the settlement whose identity they won't disclose.
A routine appointment they made three weeks ago has been rescheduled four times. Each time they initiated the change.

presentation.impression: Formally polite. Every sentence is measured before it leaves their mouth.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

relationships.description: Sujin Kobayashi and Oh He share a family and avoid sharing anything else; every professional dealing between them is conducted as though the relation were a rumour.
relationships.tension: The family has taken a side in a dispute between them. It is the wrong side, in both their opinions.

relationships.description: Sujin Kobayashi and Ruihua Tang signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Sujin Kobayashi and Ruihua Tang both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: The line between Ruihua Tang's authority and Hao Li's has been redrawn four times and honoured never. Each keeps the map that favours them.
relationships.tension: Hao Li has begun drilling in the square without asking. Ruihua Tang has begun writing letters to the capital.

relationships.description: Ruihua Tang and Tianhao Hu are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Tianhao Hu has asked Ruihua Tang to back a candidate Ruihua Tang distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Ruihua Tang and Isamu Luo consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Ruihua Tang and Isamu Luo to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Tao Xie and Oh He bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Tao Xie has hired away Oh He's best assistant. Oh He has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Tao Xie named Hao Li as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Hao Li has begun teaching Tao Xie's methods as Hao Li's own.

relationships.description: Tao Xie shaped Tianhao Hu's career in ways that Tianhao Hu has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Tianhao Hu now operates in ways Tao Xie would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Hao Li and Tianhao Hu trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Hao Li has asked Tianhao Hu for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Hao Li and Xia Kobayashi work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Tianhao Hu married into Isamu Luo's family. Isamu Luo opposed the match and still calls Tianhao Hu by surname.
relationships.tension: Tianhao Hu's child wants to marry into Isamu Luo's household. Neither parent has given an answer.

relationships.description: Xia Kobayashi stands where Tianhao Hu put them, by a ladder Tianhao Hu built and Xia Kobayashi has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Tianhao Hu has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Xia Kobayashi knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Every civic project Tianhao Hu announces has first been costed, quietly, in Ryota Yamamoto's counting-room. The public believes the order is the other way around.
relationships.tension: A faction on the council wants the debt repudiated outright. Tianhao Hu has stopped disagreeing in public.

relationships.description: Ryota Yamamoto and Wenhao Huang trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Ryota Yamamoto or Wenhao Huang can fill it.

relationships.description: Ryota Yamamoto's treasury borrowed from Hao Li to cover a bad harvest and has borrowed every year since. The interest is paid before the wages.
relationships.tension: Hao Li has asked for a seat on the council as a condition of the next loan. Ryota Yamamoto has three weeks to answer.

relationships.description: Wenhao Huang wants Isako Suzuki's position, and Isako Suzuki wants Wenhao Huang's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Isako Suzuki has been telling clients that Wenhao Huang's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Wenhao Huang.

relationships.description: Hao Li holds the settlement's tax rolls as security for its loans. Wenhao Huang cannot raise a levy without Hao Li's clerks counting it first.
relationships.tension: Wenhao Huang has proposed a new tax to clear the debt. Hao Li's friends on the council will vote against it.

relationships.description: Isako Suzuki controls a vote Ryota Yamamoto needs, and Ryota Yamamoto controls a supply Isako Suzuki needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Ryota Yamamoto has found a new source for what Isako Suzuki supplies. Isako Suzuki has not been told.

relationships.description: Isako Suzuki owes Hao Li more than the settlement collects in two years of taxes. Hao Li is paid first, every quarter.
relationships.tension: Hao Li is calling in a third of the debt at once. Isako Suzuki has until the next quarter day to find it.

relationships.description: Isamu Luo lends and Isako Suzuki spends. The council's decisions are made in Isako Suzuki's chamber and approved in Isamu Luo's counting-house.
relationships.tension: Isako Suzuki has started borrowing small sums from Isamu Luo's rivals. Isamu Luo's clerks have seen the receipts.

relationships.description: Every client Jae Yamamoto wins is one Hao Li lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Jae Yamamoto and Hao Li will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Jae Yamamoto and Isako Suzuki each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Isako Suzuki needs from Jae Yamamoto comes up next week, and Jae Yamamoto has named a new price.

relationships.description: Hao Li needs Isamu Luo's seal on certain papers; Isamu Luo needs Hao Li's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Isamu Luo's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Hao Li holds nothing over Isamu Luo.

relationships.description: Isamu Luo and Xia Kobayashi are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Isamu Luo lost the last contract to Xia Kobayashi by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Isamu Luo governs on Wenhao Huang's credit. Every loan renewed adds one more condition to the next.
relationships.tension: Wenhao Huang has refused credit for the winter grain stores. Isamu Luo must choose between the creditor and the granary.

relationships.description: Oh He trusts Xia Kobayashi's word over any written contract. Xia Kobayashi has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Xia Kobayashi has publicly backed a plan that Oh He thinks will fail. Oh He has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: What Hao Li knows, Oh He taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Oh He, quietly, whether Hao Li can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: The settlement's civic functions run on credit extended by Ryota Yamamoto. Xia Kobayashi cannot take any action that seriously threatens Ryota Yamamoto's interests, and Ryota Yamamoto does not let this be forgotten.
relationships.tension: Xia Kobayashi has identified an alternative creditor. Ryota Yamamoto has heard the same rumour.

relationships.description: Wenhao Huang holds the settlement's debts and therefore, in every way that matters, its agenda; Xia Kobayashi governs within the margin Wenhao Huang allows.
relationships.tension: The interest falls due at midsummer and the treasury will not cover it. Wenhao Huang has already drafted the terms of the extension.

members.structuralPosition: Commands enforcement in a well-ordered settlement. The role is preventive rather than responsive, and authority derives from institutional legitimacy.
members.activeConstraint: Stable conditions make it harder to justify the resources and authority that would be needed if conditions changed.

goal.long: Establish a legal precedent that constrains what the nobility can do to commoners

secret.stakes: The merchant house used the information publicly. The source will be traced

plotHooks: A merchant they publicly opposed is now publicly supporting them. No explanation offered.

presentation.impression: Warmer than their office suggests. They have the gift of making people feel briefly important.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

relationships.description: Torvald Svensson and Bera Bjarnarson compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Torvald Svensson shaped Vigdis Karason's career in ways that Vigdis Karason has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Vigdis Karason now operates in ways Torvald Svensson would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Torvald Svensson owes Helga Yngvarsson something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Helga Yngvarsson is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Bera Bjarnarson and Ingvar Styrkarsson sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Ingvar Styrkarsson has written down what Bera Bjarnarson owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Bera Bjarnarson and Bjorn Jokullsson each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Years ago Víðr Amlethsson did for Bera Bjarnarson the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Bera Bjarnarson has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Bera Bjarnarson has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Víðr Amlethsson does not.

relationships.description: Leif Karason sends difficult cases to Jokull Ulfsson, and Jokull Ulfsson sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Leif Karason has learned something about Jokull Ulfsson's family that Jokull Ulfsson does not know.

relationships.description: Leif Karason and Bodvar Flokason signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Leif Karason and Bodvar Flokason both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Estrid Bjarnarson and Þrúðr Hrollasson are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: Estrid Bjarnarson and Nerthus Ragnarsson want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Þrúðr Hrollasson and Nerthus Ragnarsson are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Nerthus Ragnarsson has asked Þrúðr Hrollasson to back a candidate Þrúðr Hrollasson distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: What Þrúðr Hrollasson knows would ruin Bodvar Eindriðason; what Bodvar Eindriðason holds would finish Þrúðr Hrollasson. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Nerthus Ragnarsson and Bodvar Eindriðason have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Bodvar Eindriðason has been offered Nerthus Ragnarsson's post by people who want Nerthus Ragnarsson gone.

relationships.description: Between Nerthus Ragnarsson and Jokull Ulfsson stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Every advance Bjorn Jokullsson makes is answered by Ingvar Styrkarsson within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Bjorn Jokullsson and Torvald Svensson work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Víðr Amlethsson paid Bjorn Jokullsson's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Bjorn Jokullsson mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Víðr Amlethsson has asked Bjorn Jokullsson for a vote against Bjorn Jokullsson's own interests. It is the first payment Víðr Amlethsson has asked for.

relationships.description: Bodvar Flokason testified against Magnhild Magnrsson in a case ten years ago. Magnhild Magnrsson lost a fortune and has not spoken to Bodvar Flokason since.
relationships.tension: Magnhild Magnrsson has been appointed to judge a case in which Bodvar Flokason is a party.

relationships.description: Bodvar Flokason owes Þrúðr Hrollasson a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Bodvar Flokason has started repaying the debt in coin. Þrúðr Hrollasson wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Nerthus Ragnarsson stands where Bodvar Flokason put them, by a ladder Bodvar Flokason built and Nerthus Ragnarsson has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Bodvar Flokason has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Nerthus Ragnarsson knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Jokull Ulfsson and Vigdis Karason are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Estrid Bjarnarson once told the council that Jokull Ulfsson was right and Estrid Bjarnarson was wrong. Jokull Ulfsson has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Jokull Ulfsson has made a mistake that Estrid Bjarnarson is bound to report. Estrid Bjarnarson has not reported it.

relationships.description: Jokull Ulfsson and Víðr Amlethsson bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Jokull Ulfsson has hired away Víðr Amlethsson's best assistant. Víðr Amlethsson has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Vigdis Karason and Helga Yngvarsson consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Vigdis Karason and Helga Yngvarsson to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Vigdis Karason and Estrid Bjarnarson trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Vigdis Karason or Estrid Bjarnarson can fill it.

relationships.description: Vigdis Karason trusts Þrúðr Hrollasson's word over any written contract. Þrúðr Hrollasson has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Þrúðr Hrollasson has publicly backed a plan that Vigdis Karason thinks will fail. Vigdis Karason has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Víðr Amlethsson and Vigdis Karason have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: The alliance between Víðr Amlethsson and Helga Yngvarsson was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Víðr Amlethsson has taken a precaution against Helga Yngvarsson that Helga Yngvarsson was not meant to discover. Helga Yngvarsson has discovered it.

relationships.description: Floki Raudsson wants Magnhild Magnrsson's position, and Magnhild Magnrsson wants Floki Raudsson's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Magnhild Magnrsson has been telling clients that Floki Raudsson's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Floki Raudsson.

relationships.description: Floki Raudsson and Vigdis Karason disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Every client Floki Raudsson wins is one Helga Yngvarsson lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Floki Raudsson and Helga Yngvarsson will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Bodvar Eindriðason and Estrid Bjarnarson share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Estrid Bjarnarson has been dining with Bodvar Eindriðason's rivals. Bodvar Eindriðason heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Edda Halfdarson kept Bodvar Eindriðason's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Bodvar Eindriðason has voted with Edda Halfdarson ever since.
relationships.tension: Edda Halfdarson has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Bodvar Eindriðason's partners.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Bodvar Eindriðason and Vigdis Karason, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Jokull Ulfsson took the post Helga Yngvarsson had been promised. Helga Yngvarsson has treated Jokull Ulfsson as an enemy from that day.
relationships.tension: Helga Yngvarsson has found the document that proves what Jokull Ulfsson did, and has kept it locked away.

relationships.description: Estrid Bjarnarson nursed Helga Yngvarsson through a winter fever when no one else would come. Helga Yngvarsson still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Helga Yngvarsson has refused Estrid Bjarnarson a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Helga Yngvarsson and Þrúðr Hrollasson deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Þrúðr Hrollasson has recently secured something that makes Helga Yngvarsson's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Edda Halfdarson and Estrid Bjarnarson were partners until one of them emptied the shared account. Each says it was the other.
relationships.tension: Edda Halfdarson and Estrid Bjarnarson have been placed on the same council committee. The first meeting is next week.

relationships.description: What Þrúðr Hrollasson knows, Edda Halfdarson taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Edda Halfdarson, quietly, whether Þrúðr Hrollasson can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Bera Ulfsson and Estrid Bjarnarson are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Bera Ulfsson lost the last contract to Estrid Bjarnarson by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Bera Ulfsson and Leif Karason trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Bera Ulfsson has asked Leif Karason for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Magnhild Magnrsson controls a vote Estrid Bjarnarson needs, and Estrid Bjarnarson controls a supply Magnhild Magnrsson needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Estrid Bjarnarson has found a new source for what Magnhild Magnrsson supplies. Magnhild Magnrsson has not been told.

relationships.description: Magnhild Magnrsson and Nerthus Ragnarsson consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Magnhild Magnrsson and Nerthus Ragnarsson to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Magnhild Magnrsson blames Jokull Ulfsson for a death in Magnhild Magnrsson's family. Jokull Ulfsson has never denied it.
relationships.tension: Jokull Ulfsson's child has asked to apprentice with Magnhild Magnrsson. Magnhild Magnrsson has not refused.

relationships.description: Torvald Svensson reports to Ingvar Styrkarsson on paper and to no one in practice. Ingvar Styrkarsson has three letters of complaint unanswered.
relationships.tension: Torvald Svensson arrested a councillor's son without Ingvar Styrkarsson's warrant. Ingvar Styrkarsson has demanded his release by tomorrow.

relationships.description: Ingvar Styrkarsson took Víðr Amlethsson in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Víðr Amlethsson has taken on a client Ingvar Styrkarsson turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Ingvar Styrkarsson and Vigdis Karason back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Ingvar Styrkarsson wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Vigdis Karason thinks the newcomer would take Vigdis Karason's place.

goal.short: Maintain operational cohesion and institutional loyalty while the political situation makes the chain of command ambiguous.
goal.long: Stop the killing on both sides, whatever it costs them personally

secret.what: Has been in secret contact with the revolt's leadership, brokering terms the governing faction has refused to authorise
secret.stakes: If the negotiation is discovered they hang as a traitor; if it fails the settlement burns. They have told no one

plotHooks: They've noticed the same group of faces at multiple locations where incidents occurred. No one else has.
A recruit they turned away has since joined a different outfit. The different outfit is now paying them to monitor this one.

presentation.impression: Professionally cordial: the manner of someone who deals with strangers all day and has a system for it.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

npcs.structuralPosition: Commands enforcement capacity where civilian governance is failing. The military's relationship with civilian authority is under pressure.
npcs.activeConstraint: Cannot act unilaterally to fill the governance vacuum without becoming a political actor in ways that compromise the institutional neutrality the role requires.

npcs.name: Lamat Ul
npcs.title: Cuachic

personality.tell: traces patterns on flat surfaces absentmindedly

A weapons cache they were responsible for is smaller than it should be. They haven't reported it yet.

presentation.impression: Affable. The manner of someone for whom friendliness is both genuine and useful.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Xolotl Bacab
members.title: Huey Tlatoani

personality.tell: quotes scripture or proverbs in casual conversation
personality.speech: Defaults to numbers and specifics: 'three days', never 'some days'

physical.feature: unusually long fingers
physical.clothes: good boots and cheap everything else

goal.short: Identify the guard captain who is no longer co-operative, and why
goal.long: Launder enough wealth to fund a legitimate legacy

secret.what: Knows the settlement's most important legal document was fraudulently created
secret.stakes: Revealing it destabilises everything; not revealing it makes them complicit

plotHooks: They are carrying out orders they believe are wrong. They have not yet decided at what point they stop carrying them out.

presentation.impression: Quiet. They let other people fill the silence.
presentation.behaviour: Polite but brief; makes clear their time is limited.

members.name: Akna Quej
members.title: Owner

personality.tell: makes deliberate, theatrical eye contact to assert dominance
personality.speech: Speaks as if dictating a letter, formal even in crisis

physical.feature: eyes that never stop moving
physical.clothes: second-hand fine clothes that don't quite fit

secret.what: Was present at (and did nothing to prevent) an atrocity that is now history
secret.stakes: Complicity charges; the moral weight has been crushing them for years

plotHooks: Someone is paying their soldiers more than their salary. The soldiers aren't saying who.

presentation.impression: Tired, but alert. The combination of someone who works hard and pays attention.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Daniyya Ucan
members.title: Cuachic

personality.tell: laughs loudly at their own jokes, silently at others'
personality.speech: Says 'as you know' before telling people things they do not know

physical.feature: sun-darkened skin that suggests years outdoors
physical.clothes: mismatched armour pieces, each from a different campaign

secret.what: Gave an order during a battle that caused friendly casualties. It was covered up as enemy action
secret.stakes: The families of the dead believe a lie that this person actively maintains

plotHooks: A prisoner in their custody knows something valuable. So does someone with reason to ensure they never speak.

presentation.impression: Professionally cordial: the manner of someone who deals with strangers all day and has a system for it.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Noh Ek Sacapul
members.title: Huehue

personality.tell: cleans or fidgets with their hands constantly
personality.speech: Uses understatement and dry humour as a defence mechanism

physical.feature: a shaved head with old tattoos
physical.clothes: mismatched armour pieces, each from a different campaign

secret.what: Has already arranged to flee with their wealth the moment the revolt breaks through, abandoning the defence they are publicly organising
secret.stakes: Those holding out are doing so partly on faith in this person's leadership. That faith is misplaced

plotHooks: A prisoner in their custody knows something valuable. So does someone with reason to ensure they never speak.

presentation.impression: Warm, a little effusive. The first person to make you feel you've arrived somewhere safe.
presentation.behaviour: Asks good questions about your journey. Remembers the answers.

members.name: Tlacochcalco Acalan
members.title: Calpixqui

personality.tell: drums fingers on surfaces when thinking
personality.speech: Peppers speech with trade or craft jargon even in unrelated contexts

physical.feature: a shaved head with old tattoos
physical.clothes: expensive but conservative merchant dress

goal.short: Find a missing merchant whose taxes haven't been filed in six months
goal.long: Build enough goodwill that the settlement mourns them when they go

secret.what: Has a second family in another settlement that neither family knows about
secret.stakes: Both relationships collapse, along with any claim to moral authority

plotHooks: A routine appointment they made three weeks ago has been rescheduled four times. Each time they initiated the change.
They are carrying out orders they believe are wrong. They have not yet decided at what point they stop carrying them out.

presentation.impression: Tired and ordinary. The manner of someone who is carrying less than they are.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative. Unassuming. Easy to overlook.

members.name: Ek Ramillete
members.title: Yaotequihua

personality.tell: hums under their breath when concentrating
personality.speech: Deflects personal questions with philosophical tangents

physical.feature: a full beard maintained with military precision
physical.clothes: a field coat carrying the insignia of a disbanded company

secret.what: Was present when Zaachila Ul did something they've never accounted for publicly. Neither has acknowledged the other was there
secret.stakes: The situation they're both ignoring is becoming relevant again

plotHooks: A recruit they turned away has since joined a different outfit. The different outfit is now paying them to monitor this one.

presentation.impression: Professionally cordial: the manner of someone who deals with strangers all day and has a system for it.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Tecpatl Xiu
members.title: Huey Pochtecatl

personality.tell: touches a specific piece of jewellery when stressed
personality.speech: Pauses mid-sentence to choose words with visible care

physical.feature: a cloak clasped with an unusual brooch
physical.clothes: whatever is clean (they move frequently)

goal.short: Identify which of their lieutenants is planning to branch out independently
goal.long: Achieve enough legitimate business to step back from direct criminal exposure

secret.what: Ordered what was officially ruled an accident, and sleeps fine about it
secret.stakes: Murder charge, loss of everything, and the victim's family who suspects the truth

plotHooks: They received orders from above that contradict what they know to be right. They haven't acted on either yet.

presentation.impression: Unremarkable, deliberately. The kind of person you would walk past twice.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Zaachila Ul
members.title: Knight

personality.tell: takes written notes during conversations, even casual ones
personality.speech: Repeats key words for emphasis: 'The contract. The contract is clear'

physical.feature: a scar cutting through one eyebrow
physical.clothes: formal robes of office

goal.short: Consolidate their position before rivals can organise
goal.long: Die having made this place meaningfully better

secret.what: Freed and armed a group of the enslaved themselves, quietly, before the revolt began, for reasons they have not disclosed and cannot now defend
secret.stakes: Those they armed are among the revolt's leaders. If it is known who gave them steel, the answer implicates this person entirely

plotHooks: A prisoner in their custody knows something valuable. So does someone with reason to ensure they never speak.
The ambush that killed two of their best people wasn't random. Someone knew the patrol route.

presentation.impression: Efficient, slightly distracted: someone with too many things in their head and a practised way of not showing it.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

relationships.description: Daniyya Kin and Pitao Zam are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Daniyya Kin lost the last contract to Pitao Zam by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Daniyya Kin and Lamat Ul compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Daniyya Kin trusts Ek Ramillete's word over any written contract. Ek Ramillete has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Ek Ramillete has publicly backed a plan that Daniyya Kin thinks will fail. Daniyya Kin has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Chan Ahau owes Xiuhcoatl Hau something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Xiuhcoatl Hau is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Chan Ahau and Daniyya Ucan have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Patli Itzam and Morning Star Kakupacal want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Years ago Daniyya Kin did for Patli Itzam the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Patli Itzam has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Patli Itzam has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Daniyya Kin does not.

relationships.description: Owl Xiu and Cipactli Hau fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Cipactli Hau's face.
relationships.tension: Owl Xiu has learned that Cipactli Hau is in debt and could be ruined by one call on a loan.

relationships.description: Something happened between Owl Xiu and Tlacochcalco Acalan years ago that neither has forgotten. They function professionally. They do not forgive.
relationships.tension: The circumstances that caused the original rupture are repeating. Both of them know it.

relationships.description: Pitao Zam and Lamat Ul deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Lamat Ul has recently secured something that makes Pitao Zam's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Pitao Zam took Yaretzi Kab in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Yaretzi Kab has taken on a client Pitao Zam turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Xiuhcoatl Hau learned the work at Pitao Zam's side for seven years. Half of Xiuhcoatl Hau's clients first came through Pitao Zam's door.
relationships.tension: Pitao Zam has taken a new apprentice, and Xiuhcoatl Hau has heard the apprentice is being taught things Xiuhcoatl Hau never was.

relationships.description: Lamat Ul and Ek Ramillete trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Lamat Ul has asked Ek Ramillete for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Lamat Ul wants Xolotl Bacab in a cell and has said so before the council. Xolotl Bacab has answered by paying two of Lamat Ul's informants.
relationships.tension: Xolotl Bacab has offered Lamat Ul a truce and a purse. Lamat Ul has not answered, which Xolotl Bacab counts as progress.

relationships.description: Cipactli Hau and Tecpatl Xiu signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Cipactli Hau and Tecpatl Xiu both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Cipactli Hau vouched for Tlacochcalco Acalan when nobody else would. Tlacochcalco Acalan's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Tlacochcalco Acalan corrected Cipactli Hau in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Cipactli Hau controls a vote Zaachila Ul needs, and Zaachila Ul controls a supply Cipactli Hau needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Zaachila Ul has found a new source for what Cipactli Hau supplies. Cipactli Hau has not been told.

relationships.description: Hunab Paxbolon and Chan Ahau each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Chan Ahau needs from Hunab Paxbolon comes up next week, and Hunab Paxbolon has named a new price.

relationships.description: Hunab Paxbolon and Yaretzi Kab disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Morning Star Kakupacal needs Hunab Paxbolon's seal on certain papers; Hunab Paxbolon needs Morning Star Kakupacal's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Hunab Paxbolon's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Morning Star Kakupacal holds nothing over Hunab Paxbolon.

relationships.description: Between Yaretzi Kab and Xiuhcoatl Hau stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Every advance Yaretzi Kab makes is answered by Daniyya Ucan within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Chan Ahau still uses Yaretzi Kab's methods and Yaretzi Kab's ledger format. Everyone who sees Chan Ahau's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Yaretzi Kab has asked Chan Ahau for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Morning Star Kakupacal and Tlacochcalco Acalan bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Morning Star Kakupacal has hired away Tlacochcalco Acalan's best assistant. Tlacochcalco Acalan has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Morning Star Kakupacal and Zaachila Ul are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Zaachila Ul has asked Morning Star Kakupacal to back a candidate Morning Star Kakupacal distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Daniyya Kin paid Morning Star Kakupacal's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Morning Star Kakupacal mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Daniyya Kin has asked Morning Star Kakupacal for a vote against Morning Star Kakupacal's own interests. It is the first payment Daniyya Kin has asked for.

relationships.description: Zaachila Ul and Tlacochcalco Acalan trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Zaachila Ul or Tlacochcalco Acalan can fill it.

relationships.description: Zaachila Ul and Patli Itzam were something to each other once (partners, friends, perhaps more), and the wreck of it is the one subject on which both are permanently silent.
relationships.tension: An apology is owed in one direction and expected in the other, and they disagree about which.

relationships.description: Xiuhcoatl Hau owes Daniyya Ucan a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Xiuhcoatl Hau has started repaying the debt in coin. Daniyya Ucan wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Noh Ek Sacapul is Xiuhcoatl Hau's half-sibling, raised in the same house and left out of the same will.
relationships.tension: A family property must be sold, and Xiuhcoatl Hau and Noh Ek Sacapul each want the money for a different purpose.

relationships.description: Xiuhcoatl Hau wants Tlacochcalco Acalan's position, and Tlacochcalco Acalan wants Xiuhcoatl Hau's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Tlacochcalco Acalan has been telling clients that Xiuhcoatl Hau's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Xiuhcoatl Hau.

relationships.description: Yaretzi Kab's people know Tecpatl Xiu's patrol routes by heart, and Tecpatl Xiu's people know which taverns Yaretzi Kab uses. Neither side has made the arrest that counts.
relationships.tension: Tecpatl Xiu's best informant inside Yaretzi Kab's crew has stopped reporting. Nobody has seen the informant for nine days.

relationships.description: Tecpatl Xiu and Xiuhcoatl Hau are open enemies. Every raid Tecpatl Xiu orders costs Xiuhcoatl Hau money, and every month Xiuhcoatl Hau survives costs Tecpatl Xiu standing.
relationships.tension: Xiuhcoatl Hau has hired an advocate to sue Tecpatl Xiu over the last raid. The case comes before the council this season.

relationships.description: Daniyya Ucan and Noh Ek Sacapul sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Noh Ek Sacapul has written down what Daniyya Ucan owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Daniyya Ucan hunts Tecpatl Xiu's operation street by street, and Tecpatl Xiu moves it one street ahead. The chase has lasted two winters.
relationships.tension: Daniyya Ucan has been ordered to stand down against Tecpatl Xiu by someone above Daniyya Ucan. The order did not say why.

relationships.description: The quarrel between Noh Ek Sacapul and Chan Ahau is old enough that no one else remembers the cause. They remember. They have simply stopped explaining.
relationships.tension: A newcomer keeps trying to reconcile them, and is about to learn why nobody else does.

relationships.description: Every client Noh Ek Sacapul wins is one Yaretzi Kab lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Noh Ek Sacapul and Yaretzi Kab will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Pitao Zam kept Ek Ramillete's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Ek Ramillete has voted with Pitao Zam ever since.
relationships.tension: Pitao Zam has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Ek Ramillete's partners.

relationships.description: Ek Ramillete has made dismantling Xolotl Bacab's operation a personal priority. The feeling is mutual.
relationships.tension: Xolotl Bacab has leverage on someone close to Ek Ramillete. It hasn't been used yet.

relationships.description: Ek Ramillete named Yaretzi Kab as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Yaretzi Kab has begun teaching Ek Ramillete's methods as Yaretzi Kab's own.

relationships.description: Xolotl Bacab keeps a file on Pitao Zam's operation that grows by the week; Pitao Zam keeps one on Xolotl Bacab that is already complete.
relationships.tension: Xolotl Bacab is one warrant away from a raid that would end it. The warrant keeps not being signed.

relationships.description: Xolotl Bacab shaped Tecpatl Xiu's career in ways that Tecpatl Xiu has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Tecpatl Xiu now operates in ways Xolotl Bacab would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: The war between Xolotl Bacab and Chan Ahau is fought in raids, informants, and paperwork. Neither side counts it as winnable; neither will stop.
relationships.tension: Someone in Xolotl Bacab's command reports to Chan Ahau. The file says so; it does not say who.

relationships.description: Tlacochcalco Acalan and Chan Ahau work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Tlacochcalco Acalan and Yaretzi Kab are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Akna Quej and Owl Xiu, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Akna Quej and Cipactli Hau are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Akna Quej lost the last contract to Cipactli Hau by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: The alliance between Akna Quej and Tlacochcalco Acalan was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Akna Quej has taken a precaution against Tlacochcalco Acalan that Tlacochcalco Acalan was not meant to discover. Tlacochcalco Acalan has discovered it.

npcs.title: Elder

personality.tell: refuses to sit with their back to a door
personality.speech: Quotes their own past pronouncements as though citing law

physical.feature: a voice that carries further than intended
physical.clothes: work clothes patched by someone who loved them

goal.long: Matter to the people immediately around them: small scale, real

secret.what: Has a second family in another settlement that neither family knows about
secret.stakes: Both relationships collapse, along with any claim to moral authority

plotHooks: There is a building no one talks about, goes into, or mentions. It is clearly maintained. No one will say by whom.
A spy they turned is now being turned back, and feeding information in both directions.

presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

npcs.name: Mongke Jadaran
npcs.title: Shaman

personality.tell: repeats the last word of a sentence spoken to them before responding
personality.speech: Trails off mid-sentence when approaching something they regret knowing

physical.feature: a network of small scars on their knuckles
physical.clothes: ceremonial attire worn at all times

goal.short: Extend the institution's civic role in ways that survive whatever governance reconsolidation follows.
goal.long: Hold the settlement together long enough to be seen as the one who held it

secret.what: Is not who their documents say they are. The real person died years ago and they took the identity
secret.stakes: The real person's family recently moved to the area

plotHooks: Two families who should be feuding are recently, unexpectedly civil. Neither will explain why.
Someone has been leaving offerings at the shrine that shouldn't be possible. The site has been sealed.

presentation.impression: Composed. The particular stillness of someone who has practised being still.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds institutional religious authority in a settlement where civic governance is failing. Religious institutions often absorb civic functions when secular authority contracts.
npcs.activeConstraint: Civic engagement that appears opportunistic risks being reversed by a reconsolidated authority that resents the encroachment.

relationships.description: Oleg Ilyin and Vasyl Orlov are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: What Elica Egorov knows, Oleg Ilyin taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Oleg Ilyin, quietly, whether Elica Egorov can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Vasyl Orlov took Elica Egorov in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Elica Egorov has taken on a client Vasyl Orlov turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Polina Kovalev nursed Vasyl Orlov through a winter fever when no one else would come. Vasyl Orlov still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Vasyl Orlov has refused Polina Kovalev a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Elica Egorov and Agata Kozlov have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Every civic project Agata Kozlov announces has first been costed, quietly, in Oleg Ilyin's counting-room. The public believes the order is the other way around.
relationships.tension: A faction on the council wants the debt repudiated outright. Agata Kozlov has stopped disagreeing in public.

relationships.description: Agata Kozlov and Polina Kovalev disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Jelena Frolov and Agata Kozlov trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Jelena Frolov has asked Agata Kozlov for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Jelena Frolov and Elica Egorov, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Oleg Ilyin learned the work at Polina Kovalev's side for seven years. Half of Oleg Ilyin's clients first came through Polina Kovalev's door.
relationships.tension: Polina Kovalev has taken a new apprentice, and Oleg Ilyin has heard the apprentice is being taught things Oleg Ilyin never was.

relationships.description: Polina Kovalev and Jelena Frolov are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: Gráinne Brennan nursed Declan Doyle through a winter fever when no one else would come. Declan Doyle still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Declan Doyle has refused Gráinne Brennan a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Clothra Kavanagh controls a vote Cairbre MacCarthy needs, and Cairbre MacCarthy controls a supply Clothra Kavanagh needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Cairbre MacCarthy has found a new source for what Clothra Kavanagh supplies. Clothra Kavanagh has not been told.

relationships.description: Clothra Kavanagh and Fiona O'Leary consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Clothra Kavanagh and Fiona O'Leary to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Deirdre O'Dwyer and Nóinín O'Neill fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Nóinín O'Neill's face.
relationships.tension: Deirdre O'Dwyer has learned that Nóinín O'Neill is in debt and could be ruined by one call on a loan.

relationships.description: Deirdre O'Dwyer trusts Credhe Murray's word over any written contract. Credhe Murray has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Credhe Murray has publicly backed a plan that Deirdre O'Dwyer thinks will fail. Deirdre O'Dwyer has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Banbh MacLean borrowed Gráinne Brennan's good name to win a post. Gráinne Brennan has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Gráinne Brennan has fallen on hard times, and the debt Banbh MacLean owes is now the only asset Gráinne Brennan has.

relationships.description: Credhe Murray reports to Banbh MacLean on paper and to no one in practice. Banbh MacLean has three letters of complaint unanswered.
relationships.tension: Credhe Murray arrested a councillor's son without Banbh MacLean's warrant. Banbh MacLean has demanded his release by tomorrow.

relationships.description: Banbh MacLean and Cairbre MacCarthy each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Cairbre MacCarthy needs from Banbh MacLean comes up next week, and Banbh MacLean has named a new price.

relationships.description: Nóinín O'Neill owes Padraig Hayes something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Padraig Hayes is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Nóinín O'Neill and Erin MacEwan are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Credhe Murray needs Padraig Hayes's seal on certain papers; Padraig Hayes needs Credhe Murray's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Padraig Hayes's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Credhe Murray holds nothing over Padraig Hayes.

relationships.description: Padraig Hayes and Deirdre O'Dwyer compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Brigid Ward and Waitling Farrell sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Waitling Farrell has written down what Brigid Ward owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Brigid Ward and Niall Carey want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Every advance Brigid Ward makes is answered by Padraig Hayes within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Cairbre MacCarthy and Fiona O'Leary have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Padraig Hayes learned the work at Cairbre MacCarthy's side for seven years. Half of Padraig Hayes's clients first came through Cairbre MacCarthy's door.
relationships.tension: Cairbre MacCarthy has taken a new apprentice, and Padraig Hayes has heard the apprentice is being taught things Padraig Hayes never was.

relationships.description: Gráinne Brennan and Padraig Hayes disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Gráinne Brennan wants the watch under civil command; Fiona O'Leary wants the council out of the barracks. They meet monthly and settle nothing.
relationships.tension: Gráinne Brennan has asked the capital to replace Fiona O'Leary. Fiona O'Leary has asked the capital to dissolve Gráinne Brennan's council.

relationships.description: Gráinne Brennan vouched for Brigid Ward when nobody else would. Brigid Ward's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Brigid Ward corrected Gráinne Brennan in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Waitling Farrell and Niall Carey each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: What Waitling Farrell knows would ruin Deirdre O'Dwyer; what Deirdre O'Dwyer holds would finish Waitling Farrell. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Waitling Farrell and Nóinín O'Neill deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Nóinín O'Neill has recently secured something that makes Waitling Farrell's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Years ago Laighen O'Leary did for Erin MacEwan the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Erin MacEwan has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Erin MacEwan has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Laighen O'Leary does not.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Erin MacEwan and Eanán MacCulloch, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Erin MacEwan and Deirdre O'Dwyer trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Erin MacEwan has asked Deirdre O'Dwyer for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: The alliance between Credhe Murray and Nóinín O'Neill was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Credhe Murray has taken a precaution against Nóinín O'Neill that Nóinín O'Neill was not meant to discover. Nóinín O'Neill has discovered it.

relationships.description: Credhe Murray and Gráinne Brennan bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Credhe Murray has hired away Gráinne Brennan's best assistant. Gráinne Brennan has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Fiona O'Leary still uses Credhe Murray's methods and Credhe Murray's ledger format. Everyone who sees Fiona O'Leary's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Credhe Murray has asked Fiona O'Leary for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Laighen O'Leary sends difficult cases to Eanán MacCulloch, and Eanán MacCulloch sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Laighen O'Leary has learned something about Eanán MacCulloch's family that Eanán MacCulloch does not know.

relationships.description: Deirdre O'Dwyer is Laighen O'Leary's half-sibling, raised in the same house and left out of the same will.
relationships.tension: A family property must be sold, and Laighen O'Leary and Deirdre O'Dwyer each want the money for a different purpose.

relationships.description: Laighen O'Leary and Nóinín O'Neill have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Nóinín O'Neill has been offered Laighen O'Leary's post by people who want Laighen O'Leary gone.

relationships.description: Niall Carey and Nóinín O'Neill are in-laws. They are polite at family dinners and avoid each other everywhere else.
relationships.tension: Niall Carey's rivals have learned that Nóinín O'Neill is family, and have started asking Nóinín O'Neill questions.

relationships.description: Niall Carey sends difficult cases to Padraig Hayes, and Padraig Hayes sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Niall Carey has learned something about Padraig Hayes's family that Padraig Hayes does not know.

relationships.description: Eanán MacCulloch and Nóinín O'Neill have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Nóinín O'Neill has been offered Eanán MacCulloch's post by people who want Eanán MacCulloch gone.

relationships.description: Eanán MacCulloch named Clothra Kavanagh as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Clothra Kavanagh has begun teaching Eanán MacCulloch's methods as Clothra Kavanagh's own.

relationships.description: Brigid Ward once told the council that Eanán MacCulloch was right and Brigid Ward was wrong. Eanán MacCulloch has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Eanán MacCulloch has made a mistake that Brigid Ward is bound to report. Brigid Ward has not reported it.

goal.long: Fund a trading dynasty that their grandchildren will run

secret.what: Suffering from an illness they expect to kill them within two years
secret.stakes: Rivals would move against them immediately if they knew; dependents would panic
