presentation.impression: Efficient, slightly distracted: someone with too many things in their head and a practised way of not showing it.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

relationships.description: Oljeitu Ilkhan and Yesülün Urgench are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Oljeitu Ilkhan lost the last contract to Yesülün Urgench by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Kuchug Suldus nursed Oljeitu Ilkhan through a winter fever when no one else would come. Oljeitu Ilkhan still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Oljeitu Ilkhan has refused Kuchug Suldus a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Oljeitu Ilkhan and Ughul Kalmyk are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Ughul Kalmyk has asked Oljeitu Ilkhan to back a candidate Oljeitu Ilkhan distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Liqian Qipchaq and Üljeytü Uzbek each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Üljeytü Uzbek needs from Liqian Qipchaq comes up next week, and Liqian Qipchaq has named a new price.

relationships.description: Hulegu Arlat needs Liqian Qipchaq's seal on certain papers; Liqian Qipchaq needs Hulegu Arlat's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Liqian Qipchaq's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Hulegu Arlat holds nothing over Liqian Qipchaq.

relationships.description: Liqian Qipchaq and Enkhjargal Urgench sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Enkhjargal Urgench has written down what Liqian Qipchaq owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Kuchug Suldus and Üljeytü Arulad compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Kuchug Suldus and Qarabek Salji'ud work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Oghul Ghurid trusts Khishigbayar Bashkir's word over any written contract. Khishigbayar Bashkir has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Khishigbayar Bashkir has publicly backed a plan that Oghul Ghurid thinks will fail. Oghul Ghurid has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Oghul Ghurid and Munkhtuya Fergana have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Oghul Ghurid is godparent to Ghazan Samarkand's eldest child. The tie was made before their careers set them against each other.
relationships.tension: The family has asked Oghul Ghurid and Ghazan Samarkand to end their quarrel before the next feast. Neither will apologise first.

relationships.description: Ughul Kalmyk and Naranchuluun Jalayir disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Ughul Kalmyk and Yesülün Urgench, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Ughul Kalmyk borrowed Üljeytü Uzbek's good name to win a post. Üljeytü Uzbek has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Üljeytü Uzbek has fallen on hard times, and the debt Ughul Kalmyk owes is now the only asset Üljeytü Uzbek has.

relationships.description: Abu Said Kiyad and Höelün Zunghar are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Abu Said Kiyad sends difficult cases to Toghan Budaad, and Toghan Budaad sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Abu Said Kiyad has learned something about Toghan Budaad's family that Toghan Budaad does not know.

relationships.description: Khishigbayar Bashkir and Munkhtuya Fergana are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: Ghazan Samarkand stands where Khishigbayar Bashkir put them, by a ladder Khishigbayar Bashkir built and Ghazan Samarkand has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Khishigbayar Bashkir has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Ghazan Samarkand knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Every civic project Khishigbayar Bashkir announces has first been costed, quietly, in Unurtsetseg Naiman's counting-room. The public believes the order is the other way around.
relationships.tension: A faction on the council wants the debt repudiated outright. Khishigbayar Bashkir has stopped disagreeing in public.

relationships.description: Naranchuluun Jalayir and Yesülün Urgench want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: What Liqian Qipchaq knows, Naranchuluun Jalayir taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Naranchuluun Jalayir, quietly, whether Liqian Qipchaq can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Unurtsetseg Naiman and Dokuz Jirgin fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Dokuz Jirgin's face.
relationships.tension: Unurtsetseg Naiman has learned that Dokuz Jirgin is in debt and could be ruined by one call on a loan.

relationships.description: Unurtsetseg Naiman and Chagatai Seljuk each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Every advance Dokuz Jirgin makes is answered by Üljeytü Arulad within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Dokuz Jirgin took Ergene Kipchak in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Ergene Kipchak has taken on a client Dokuz Jirgin turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Höelün Zunghar and Purevdorj Nogai bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Höelün Zunghar has hired away Purevdorj Nogai's best assistant. Purevdorj Nogai has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Höelün Zunghar and Borte Noyakin have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Borte Noyakin has been offered Höelün Zunghar's post by people who want Höelün Zunghar gone.

relationships.description: Höelün Zunghar and Unurtsetseg Naiman trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Höelün Zunghar or Unurtsetseg Naiman can fill it.

relationships.description: What Üljeytü Arulad knows would ruin Unurtsetseg Naiman; what Unurtsetseg Naiman holds would finish Üljeytü Arulad. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Üljeytü Arulad wants Chagatai Seljuk's position, and Chagatai Seljuk wants Üljeytü Arulad's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Chagatai Seljuk has been telling clients that Üljeytü Arulad's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Üljeytü Arulad.

relationships.description: Every client Üljeytü Arulad wins is one Qarabek Salji'ud lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Üljeytü Arulad and Qarabek Salji'ud will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Every client Toghan Budaad wins is one Höelün Zunghar lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Toghan Budaad and Höelün Zunghar will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Blood ties Toghan Budaad to Purevdorj Nogai in a way that neither career can afford; they meet at funerals and weddings and pretend the rest of the year does not exist.
relationships.tension: A younger relative has begun trading on the connection both of them refuse to use.

relationships.description: Toghan Budaad and Borte Noyakin deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Borte Noyakin has recently secured something that makes Toghan Budaad's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Dokuz Jirgin once told the council that Chagatai Seljuk was right and Dokuz Jirgin was wrong. Chagatai Seljuk has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Chagatai Seljuk has made a mistake that Dokuz Jirgin is bound to report. Dokuz Jirgin has not reported it.

relationships.description: The alliance between Chagatai Seljuk and Qarabek Salji'ud was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Chagatai Seljuk has taken a precaution against Qarabek Salji'ud that Qarabek Salji'ud was not meant to discover. Qarabek Salji'ud has discovered it.

relationships.description: Chagatai Seljuk and Ergene Kipchak trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Chagatai Seljuk has asked Ergene Kipchak for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Purevdorj Nogai controls a vote Abu Said Kiyad needs, and Abu Said Kiyad controls a supply Purevdorj Nogai needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Abu Said Kiyad has found a new source for what Purevdorj Nogai supplies. Purevdorj Nogai has not been told.

relationships.description: Purevdorj Nogai and Borte Noyakin consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Purevdorj Nogai and Borte Noyakin to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Something happened between Purevdorj Nogai and Unurtsetseg Naiman years ago that neither has forgotten. They function professionally. They do not forgive.
relationships.tension: The circumstances that caused the original rupture are repeating. Both of them know it.

relationships.description: Munkhtuya Fergana and Ghazan Samarkand are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Munkhtuya Fergana lost the last contract to Ghazan Samarkand by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Munkhtuya Fergana's treasury borrowed from Dokuz Jirgin to cover a bad harvest and has borrowed every year since. The interest is paid before the wages.
relationships.tension: Dokuz Jirgin has asked for a seat on the council as a condition of the next loan. Munkhtuya Fergana has three weeks to answer.

relationships.description: Üljeytü Arulad holds the settlement's tax rolls as security for its loans. Munkhtuya Fergana cannot raise a levy without Üljeytü Arulad's clerks counting it first.
relationships.tension: Munkhtuya Fergana has proposed a new tax to clear the debt. Üljeytü Arulad's friends on the council will vote against it.

relationships.description: Qarabek Salji'ud and Unurtsetseg Naiman share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Unurtsetseg Naiman has been dining with Qarabek Salji'ud's rivals. Qarabek Salji'ud heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Qarabek Salji'ud and Ergene Kipchak each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Ergene Kipchak needs from Qarabek Salji'ud comes up next week, and Qarabek Salji'ud has named a new price.

relationships.description: Borte Noyakin and Abu Said Kiyad bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Borte Noyakin has hired away Abu Said Kiyad's best assistant. Abu Said Kiyad has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Borte Noyakin and Noyans Ongut back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Borte Noyakin wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Noyans Ongut thinks the newcomer would take Noyans Ongut's place.

relationships.description: Hulegu Arlat needs Üljeytü Uzbek's seal on certain papers; Üljeytü Uzbek needs Hulegu Arlat's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Üljeytü Uzbek's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Hulegu Arlat holds nothing over Üljeytü Uzbek.

relationships.description: Enkhjargal Urgench once told the council that Üljeytü Uzbek was right and Enkhjargal Urgench was wrong. Üljeytü Uzbek has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Üljeytü Uzbek has made a mistake that Enkhjargal Urgench is bound to report. Enkhjargal Urgench has not reported it.

relationships.description: Üljeytü Uzbek brings the votes and Unurtsetseg Naiman brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Unurtsetseg Naiman voted against Üljeytü Uzbek on a small matter last week. Üljeytü Uzbek is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Oghul Ghurid learned the work at Jayan Urgench's side for seven years. Half of Oghul Ghurid's clients first came through Jayan Urgench's door.
relationships.tension: Jayan Urgench has taken a new apprentice, and Oghul Ghurid has heard the apprentice is being taught things Oghul Ghurid never was.

relationships.description: Jayan Urgench and Khishigbayar Bashkir sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Khishigbayar Bashkir has written down what Jayan Urgench owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Jayan Urgench and Munkhtuya Fergana deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Munkhtuya Fergana has recently secured something that makes Jayan Urgench's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Hulegu Arlat and Enkhjargal Urgench share a family and avoid sharing anything else; every professional dealing between them is conducted as though the relation were a rumour.
relationships.tension: The family has taken a side in a dispute between them. It is the wrong side, in both their opinions.

relationships.description: The line between Hulegu Arlat's authority and Üljeytü Arulad's has been redrawn four times and honoured never. Each keeps the map that favours them.
relationships.tension: Üljeytü Arulad has begun drilling in the square without asking. Hulegu Arlat has begun writing letters to the capital.

relationships.description: Hulegu Arlat and Chagatai Seljuk signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Hulegu Arlat and Chagatai Seljuk both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Noyans Ongut and Abu Said Kiyad are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Abu Said Kiyad has asked Noyans Ongut to back a candidate Noyans Ongut distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Noyans Ongut and Höelün Zunghar consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Noyans Ongut and Höelün Zunghar to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Noyans Ongut and Toghan Budaad trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Noyans Ongut or Toghan Budaad can fill it.

relationships.description: Ergene Kipchak wants Unurtsetseg Naiman's position, and Unurtsetseg Naiman wants Ergene Kipchak's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Unurtsetseg Naiman has been telling clients that Ergene Kipchak's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Ergene Kipchak.

relationships.description: The alliance between Ergene Kipchak and Üljeytü Arulad was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Ergene Kipchak has taken a precaution against Üljeytü Arulad that Üljeytü Arulad was not meant to discover. Üljeytü Arulad has discovered it.

relationships.description: Ergene Kipchak and Üljeytü Uzbek share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Üljeytü Uzbek has been dining with Ergene Kipchak's rivals. Ergene Kipchak heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Ghazan Samarkand owes Unurtsetseg Naiman more than the settlement collects in two years of taxes. Unurtsetseg Naiman is paid first, every quarter.
relationships.tension: Unurtsetseg Naiman is calling in a third of the debt at once. Ghazan Samarkand has until the next quarter day to find it.

relationships.description: Dokuz Jirgin lends and Ghazan Samarkand spends. The council's decisions are made in Ghazan Samarkand's chamber and approved in Dokuz Jirgin's counting-house.
relationships.tension: Ghazan Samarkand has started borrowing small sums from Dokuz Jirgin's rivals. Dokuz Jirgin's clerks have seen the receipts.

relationships.description: Ghazan Samarkand governs on Qarabek Salji'ud's credit. Every loan renewed adds one more condition to the next.
relationships.tension: Qarabek Salji'ud has refused credit for the winter grain stores. Ghazan Samarkand must choose between the creditor and the granary.

relationships.description: Enkhjargal Timurid and Oghul Ghurid trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Enkhjargal Timurid has asked Oghul Ghurid for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Enkhjargal Timurid married into Khishigbayar Bashkir's family. Khishigbayar Bashkir opposed the match and still calls Enkhjargal Timurid by surname.
relationships.tension: Enkhjargal Timurid's child wants to marry into Khishigbayar Bashkir's household. Neither parent has given an answer.

relationships.description: Enkhjargal Timurid trusts Üljeytü Arulad's word over any written contract. Üljeytü Arulad has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Üljeytü Arulad has publicly backed a plan that Enkhjargal Timurid thinks will fail. Enkhjargal Timurid has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Enkhjargal Urgench and Unurtsetseg Naiman back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Enkhjargal Urgench wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Unurtsetseg Naiman thinks the newcomer would take Unurtsetseg Naiman's place.

relationships.description: Enkhjargal Urgench controls the garrison's pay and Dokuz Jirgin controls its swords. Each uses their half to bargain for the other's.
relationships.tension: Enkhjargal Urgench has cut the garrison's pay to fund the market repairs. Dokuz Jirgin has told the soldiers who signed the order.

relationships.description: Yesülün Urgench owes Unurtsetseg Naiman something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Unurtsetseg Naiman is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Years ago Dokuz Jirgin did for Yesülün Urgench the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Yesülün Urgench has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Yesülün Urgench has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Dokuz Jirgin does not.

relationships.description: Yesülün Urgench vouched for Chagatai Seljuk when nobody else would. Chagatai Seljuk's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Chagatai Seljuk corrected Yesülün Urgench in public last month, and was right.

npcs.name: Ai Wang
npcs.title: Elder

personality.tell: always stands when others sit, or vice versa
personality.speech: Peppers speech with trade or craft jargon even in unrelated contexts

physical.build: slight: smaller than expected for the role
physical.feature: a cloak clasped with an unusual brooch
physical.clothes: travel-worn but well-maintained gear

goal.short: Convert governance instability into a restoration of prerogatives that formal governance had constrained.
goal.long: Matter to the people immediately around them: small scale, real

secret.what: Has been reporting false harvest figures to the regional authority to suppress aid that would undercut their price control
secret.stakes: People have died. The regional inspector arrives in six days

plotHooks: Two families who should be feuding are recently, unexpectedly civil. Neither will explain why.
They found something hidden in a place it shouldn't be. They put it back. They haven't told anyone.

presentation.impression: Reserved. Appropriately cautious with strangers. You would be too, in their position.
presentation.behaviour: Asks reasonable questions. Gives reasonable answers. Nothing out of the ordinary.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds hereditary or traditional status in a settlement where formal governance is under pressure. Traditional authority often gains relative standing when formal authority loses it.
npcs.activeConstraint: Traditional claims that would have been dismissed under stable governance invite more scrutiny under conditions where everyone is watching for illegitimate power grabs.

npcs.name: Üljeytü Merkit
npcs.title: Shaman

personality.tell: traces patterns on flat surfaces absentmindedly
personality.speech: Prefaces bad news with elaborate courtesy, good news with none

physical.feature: an old injury that affects their gait
physical.clothes: ceremonial attire worn at all times

goal.short: Extend the institution's civic role in ways that survive whatever governance reconsolidation follows.
goal.long: Leave a detailed record of the congregation so future priests know who this community was

secret.what: Survived something everyone believes killed them, under a different name
secret.stakes: The original identity, if revealed, carries baggage that would end the current one

plotHooks: The holy relic in their keeping is not what everyone believes it is. Only they know this.
One of their most reliable suppliers has gone dark. The goods are still arriving. Someone else is sending them.

presentation.impression: Genuinely glad to see you, or performs it so well the difference doesn't matter at first.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds institutional religious authority in a settlement where civic governance is failing. Religious institutions often absorb civic functions when secular authority contracts.
npcs.activeConstraint: Civic engagement that appears opportunistic risks being reversed by a reconsolidated authority that resents the encroachment.

npcs.name: Gantögs Barlas
npcs.title: Shaman

personality.tell: checks exits in every new room before speaking
personality.speech: Addresses strangers formally and familiars by diminutives

physical.feature: unusually long fingers
physical.clothes: travel-worn but well-maintained gear

goal.short: Decide who is admitted and who is turned away, and be owed for each choice
goal.long: Become the person every arrival and every old family must go through

secret.what: Is themselves a newcomer, arrived a decade ago under a false history that the current upheaval is threatening to expose
secret.stakes: The people they would rule against for lying are lying no more than they once did

plotHooks: They buried someone last season that they refer to only as 'the traveller'. They will not say more.
There is a building no one talks about, goes into, or mentions. It is clearly maintained. No one will say by whom.

presentation.impression: Tired, but alert. The combination of someone who works hard and pays attention.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

relationships.description: Hadwig Lange brings the votes and Egilbert Köhler brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Egilbert Köhler voted against Hadwig Lange on a small matter last week. Hadwig Lange is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Hadwig Lange sets the curfew and Lena Ritter decides whether to enforce it. The two have not agreed on a curfew in a year.
relationships.tension: A riot is expected on the next market day, and Hadwig Lange and Lena Ritter have issued opposite orders for it.

relationships.description: Lena Ritter and Egilbert Köhler bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Lena Ritter has hired away Egilbert Köhler's best assistant. Egilbert Köhler has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Lena Ritter and Hadwig Krüger have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: What Lena Ritter knows would ruin Eberhard Forster; what Eberhard Forster holds would finish Lena Ritter. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Thecla Zimmermann and Hadwig Lange signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Thecla Zimmermann and Hadwig Lange both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Years ago Egilbert Köhler did for Thecla Zimmermann the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Thecla Zimmermann has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Thecla Zimmermann has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Egilbert Köhler does not.

relationships.description: Veronika Eisenberg and Rainer Moser are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Rainer Moser has asked Veronika Eisenberg to back a candidate Veronika Eisenberg distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Veronika Eisenberg took Werner Lehmann in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Werner Lehmann has taken on a client Veronika Eisenberg turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Eberhard Forster and Oda Eisenberg disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Egilbert Köhler learned the work at Eberhard Forster's side for seven years. Half of Egilbert Köhler's clients first came through Eberhard Forster's door.
relationships.tension: Eberhard Forster has taken a new apprentice, and Egilbert Köhler has heard the apprentice is being taught things Egilbert Köhler never was.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Eberhard Forster and Rainer Moser, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Theotmar Huber and Werner Lehmann deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Werner Lehmann has recently secured something that makes Theotmar Huber's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Theotmar Huber and Hadwig Krüger trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Theotmar Huber has asked Hadwig Krüger for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Theotmar Huber vouched for Thecla Zimmermann when nobody else would. Thecla Zimmermann's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Thecla Zimmermann corrected Theotmar Huber in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Werner Lehmann still uses Egilbert Köhler's methods and Egilbert Köhler's ledger format. Everyone who sees Werner Lehmann's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Egilbert Köhler has asked Werner Lehmann for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Between Egilbert Köhler and Hadwig Krüger stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Rainer Moser named Werner Lehmann as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Werner Lehmann has begun teaching Rainer Moser's methods as Werner Lehmann's own.

relationships.description: Rainer Moser shaped Lena Ritter's career in ways that Lena Ritter has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Lena Ritter now operates in ways Rainer Moser would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Werner Lehmann and Hadwig Krüger work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Hadwig Lange stands where Werner Lehmann put them, by a ladder Werner Lehmann built and Hadwig Lange has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Werner Lehmann has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Hadwig Lange knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Werner Lehmann and Mathias Eisenberg are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Hadwig Krüger and Rainer Moser trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Hadwig Krüger or Rainer Moser can fill it.

relationships.description: Hadwig Krüger sends difficult cases to Veronika Eisenberg, and Veronika Eisenberg sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Hadwig Krüger has learned something about Veronika Eisenberg's family that Veronika Eisenberg does not know.

relationships.description: Mathias Eisenberg and Veronika Eisenberg have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Veronika Eisenberg has been offered Mathias Eisenberg's post by people who want Mathias Eisenberg gone.

relationships.description: The alliance between Mathias Eisenberg and Rainer Moser was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Mathias Eisenberg has taken a precaution against Rainer Moser that Rainer Moser was not meant to discover. Rainer Moser has discovered it.

relationships.description: Oda Eisenberg wants Rainer Moser's position, and Rainer Moser wants Oda Eisenberg's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Rainer Moser has been telling clients that Oda Eisenberg's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Oda Eisenberg.

relationships.description: Werner Lehmann paid Oda Eisenberg's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Oda Eisenberg mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Werner Lehmann has asked Oda Eisenberg for a vote against Oda Eisenberg's own interests. It is the first payment Werner Lehmann has asked for.

relationships.description: Layla ibn Zuhr and Nabila al-Baghdadi signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Layla ibn Zuhr and Nabila al-Baghdadi both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Layla ibn Zuhr and Ghazi al-Tabari consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Layla ibn Zuhr and Ghazi al-Tabari to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Ziyad al-Tusi paid Layla ibn Zuhr's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Layla ibn Zuhr mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Ziyad al-Tusi has asked Layla ibn Zuhr for a vote against Layla ibn Zuhr's own interests. It is the first payment Ziyad al-Tusi has asked for.

relationships.description: Nabila al-Baghdadi named Ghazi al-Tabari as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Ghazi al-Tabari has begun teaching Nabila al-Baghdadi's methods as Ghazi al-Tabari's own.

relationships.description: Nabila al-Baghdadi shaped Nasir ibn Tufayl's career in ways that Nasir ibn Tufayl has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Nasir ibn Tufayl now operates in ways Nabila al-Baghdadi would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Latif al-Karimi stands where Nabila al-Baghdadi put them, by a ladder Nabila al-Baghdadi built and Latif al-Karimi has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Nabila al-Baghdadi has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Latif al-Karimi knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Ziyad al-Tusi owes Ghazi al-Tabari a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Ziyad al-Tusi has started repaying the debt in coin. Ghazi al-Tabari wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Ziyad al-Tusi and Hassan ibn Ali are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Hassan ibn Ali has asked Ziyad al-Tusi to back a candidate Ziyad al-Tusi distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: What Nasir ibn Tufayl knows would ruin Suhad ibn Sina; what Suhad ibn Sina holds would finish Nasir ibn Tufayl. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Nasir ibn Tufayl and Farid al-Wahabi work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: What Layla ibn Zuhr knows, Nasir ibn Tufayl taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Nasir ibn Tufayl, quietly, whether Layla ibn Zuhr can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Latif al-Karimi and Hassan ibn Ali deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Hassan ibn Ali has recently secured something that makes Latif al-Karimi's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Latif al-Karimi and Ghalib al-Nuri bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Latif al-Karimi has hired away Ghalib al-Nuri's best assistant. Ghalib al-Nuri has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Taha al-Basri kept Latif al-Karimi's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Latif al-Karimi has voted with Taha al-Basri ever since.
relationships.tension: Taha al-Basri has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Latif al-Karimi's partners.

relationships.description: Suhad ibn Sina trusts Farid al-Wahabi's word over any written contract. Farid al-Wahabi has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Farid al-Wahabi has publicly backed a plan that Suhad ibn Sina thinks will fail. Suhad ibn Sina has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Suhad ibn Sina took Layla ibn Zuhr in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Layla ibn Zuhr has taken on a client Suhad ibn Sina turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Layla ibn Zuhr nursed Farid al-Wahabi through a winter fever when no one else would come. Farid al-Wahabi still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Farid al-Wahabi has refused Layla ibn Zuhr a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Farid al-Wahabi borrowed Ziyad al-Tusi's good name to win a post. Ziyad al-Tusi has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Ziyad al-Tusi has fallen on hard times, and the debt Farid al-Wahabi owes is now the only asset Ziyad al-Tusi has.

relationships.description: Farid al-Wahabi and Hassan ibn Ali are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: The alliance between Hassan ibn Ali and Ghalib al-Nuri was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Hassan ibn Ali has taken a precaution against Ghalib al-Nuri that Ghalib al-Nuri was not meant to discover. Ghalib al-Nuri has discovered it.

relationships.description: Hassan ibn Ali and Taha al-Basri trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Hassan ibn Ali or Taha al-Basri can fill it.

relationships.description: Ghalib al-Nuri and Taha al-Basri share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Taha al-Basri has been dining with Ghalib al-Nuri's rivals. Ghalib al-Nuri heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Ghalib al-Nuri and Jamila ibn Ahmed have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Taha al-Basri wants Jamila ibn Ahmed's position, and Jamila ibn Ahmed wants Taha al-Basri's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Jamila ibn Ahmed has been telling clients that Taha al-Basri's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Taha al-Basri.

relationships.description: Taha al-Basri and Nasir ibn Tufayl are in-laws. They are polite at family dinners and avoid each other everywhere else.
relationships.tension: Taha al-Basri's rivals have learned that Nasir ibn Tufayl is family, and have started asking Nasir ibn Tufayl questions.

relationships.description: Taha al-Basri and Suhad ibn Sina disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Ghazi al-Tabari owes Nasir ibn Tufayl something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Nasir ibn Tufayl is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Years ago Farid al-Wahabi did for Ghazi al-Tabari the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Ghazi al-Tabari has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Ghazi al-Tabari has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Farid al-Wahabi does not.

relationships.description: Every client Jamila ibn Ahmed wins is one Latif al-Karimi lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Jamila ibn Ahmed and Latif al-Karimi will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Jamila ibn Ahmed and Hassan ibn Ali are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Jamila ibn Ahmed lost the last contract to Hassan ibn Ali by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Messalina Laevinus and Nero Mamercus each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Messalina Laevinus named Varus Plancus as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Varus Plancus has begun teaching Messalina Laevinus's methods as Varus Plancus's own.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Capito Mamercus and Decimus Macer, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Capito Mamercus and Varus Plancus back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Capito Mamercus wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Varus Plancus thinks the newcomer would take Varus Plancus's place.

relationships.description: Capito Mamercus commands the patrols and Volso Merula pays for their routes. The streets Volso Merula uses are the quietest in the settlement.
relationships.tension: An auditor from the garrison is counting Capito Mamercus's arrest records against the coin in Capito Mamercus's house. Volso Merula is watching the count.

relationships.description: Every advance Vipsanius Ursus makes is answered by Gaius Afer within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Vipsanius Ursus brings the votes and Vipsania Moderatus brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Vipsania Moderatus voted against Vipsanius Ursus on a small matter last week. Vipsanius Ursus is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: What Vipsanius Ursus knows would ruin Isidora Macer; what Isidora Macer holds would finish Vipsanius Ursus. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Calvus Ursus sends difficult cases to Titia Aurelius, and Titia Aurelius sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Calvus Ursus has learned something about Titia Aurelius's family that Titia Aurelius does not know.

relationships.description: Calvus Ursus and Cara Plancus signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Calvus Ursus and Cara Plancus both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Calvus Ursus and Decimus Macer deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Decimus Macer has recently secured something that makes Calvus Ursus's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Decimus Macer and Varus Plancus are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Varus Plancus has asked Decimus Macer to back a candidate Decimus Macer distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Decimus Macer and Hortensia Calvus trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Decimus Macer has asked Hortensia Calvus for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Decimus Macer and Plinius Scipio bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Decimus Macer has hired away Plinius Scipio's best assistant. Plinius Scipio has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Varus Plancus controls a vote Hortensia Calvus needs, and Hortensia Calvus controls a supply Varus Plancus needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Hortensia Calvus has found a new source for what Varus Plancus supplies. Varus Plancus has not been told.

relationships.description: Varus Plancus and Plinius Scipio trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Varus Plancus or Plinius Scipio can fill it.

relationships.description: Cara Plancus wants Titia Aurelius's position, and Titia Aurelius wants Cara Plancus's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Titia Aurelius has been telling clients that Cara Plancus's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Cara Plancus.

relationships.description: Cara Plancus and Decimus Macer work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Gaius Afer shaped Vipsania Moderatus's career in ways that Vipsania Moderatus has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Vipsania Moderatus now operates in ways Gaius Afer would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Gaius Afer and Isidora Macer each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Isidora Macer needs from Gaius Afer comes up next week, and Gaius Afer has named a new price.

relationships.description: Decimus Macer needs Gaius Afer's seal on certain papers; Gaius Afer needs Decimus Macer's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Gaius Afer's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Decimus Macer holds nothing over Gaius Afer.

relationships.description: Every client Volso Merula wins is one Tertia Volso lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Volso Merula and Tertia Volso will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Volso Merula and Flavia Strabo are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Vipsania Moderatus and Isidora Macer sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Isidora Macer has written down what Vipsania Moderatus owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Vipsania Moderatus and Decimus Macer deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Decimus Macer has recently secured something that makes Vipsania Moderatus's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Hortensia Calvus and Plinius Scipio trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.

relationships.description: Hortensia Calvus controls a vote Sempronia Gratus needs, and Sempronia Gratus controls a supply Hortensia Calvus needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Sempronia Gratus has found a new source for what Hortensia Calvus supplies. Hortensia Calvus has not been told.

relationships.description: Sempronia Gratus stands where Plinius Scipio put them, by a ladder Plinius Scipio built and Sempronia Gratus has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Plinius Scipio has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Sempronia Gratus knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Between Plinius Scipio and Falco Cordus stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: The alliance between Plotina Volso and Lepidus Laevus was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Plotina Volso has taken a precaution against Lepidus Laevus that Lepidus Laevus was not meant to discover. Lepidus Laevus has discovered it.

relationships.description: Plotina Volso and Macrina Macer share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Macrina Macer has been dining with Plotina Volso's rivals. Plotina Volso heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Lepidus Laevus is godparent to Macrina Macer's eldest child. The tie was made before their careers set them against each other.
relationships.tension: The family has asked Lepidus Laevus and Macrina Macer to end their quarrel before the next feast. Neither will apologise first.

relationships.description: Lepidus Laevus and Decimus Macer are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Lepidus Laevus lost the last contract to Decimus Macer by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: What Plinius Scipio knows, Lepidus Laevus taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Lepidus Laevus, quietly, whether Plinius Scipio can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Sempronia Gratus and Decimus Macer signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Sempronia Gratus and Decimus Macer both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Varus Plancus paid Sempronia Gratus's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Sempronia Gratus mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Varus Plancus has asked Sempronia Gratus for a vote against Sempronia Gratus's own interests. It is the first payment Varus Plancus has asked for.

relationships.description: Sempronia Gratus and Helvia Denter each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Helvia Denter needs from Sempronia Gratus comes up next week, and Sempronia Gratus has named a new price.

relationships.description: Decimus Macer needs Isidora Macer's seal on certain papers; Isidora Macer needs Decimus Macer's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.

relationships.description: Isidora Macer and Helvia Denter deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Helvia Denter has recently secured something that makes Isidora Macer's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Helvia Denter and Decimus Macer compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Helvia Denter and Varus Plancus trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Helvia Denter has asked Varus Plancus for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Scaeva Maximus owes Decimus Macer a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Scaeva Maximus has started repaying the debt in coin. Decimus Macer wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Scaeva Maximus controls a vote Hortensia Calvus needs, and Hortensia Calvus controls a supply Scaeva Maximus needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.

relationships.description: Scaeva Maximus and Plinius Scipio want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Falco Cordus took Decimus Macer in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Decimus Macer has taken on a client Falco Cordus turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Falco Cordus and Varus Plancus are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Varus Plancus has asked Falco Cordus to back a candidate Falco Cordus distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Sempronia Gratus kept Falco Cordus's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Falco Cordus has voted with Sempronia Gratus ever since.
relationships.tension: Sempronia Gratus has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Falco Cordus's partners.

relationships.description: Tertia Volso and Tullia Geminus (Underground Broker) are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: Blood ties Tertia Volso to Flavia Strabo in a way that neither career can afford; they meet at funerals and weddings and pretend the rest of the year does not exist.
relationships.tension: A younger relative has begun trading on the connection both of them refuse to use.

relationships.description: Calvus Ursus learned the work at Macrina Macer's side for seven years. Half of Calvus Ursus's clients first came through Macrina Macer's door.
relationships.tension: Macrina Macer has taken a new apprentice, and Calvus Ursus has heard the apprentice is being taught things Calvus Ursus never was.

relationships.description: Macrina Macer and Decimus Macer have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Decimus Macer has been offered Macrina Macer's post by people who want Macrina Macer gone.

relationships.description: Macrina Macer vouched for Varus Plancus when nobody else would. Varus Plancus's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Varus Plancus corrected Macrina Macer in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Kaninia Cicero and Decimus Macer each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Decimus Macer needs from Kaninia Cicero comes up next week, and Kaninia Cicero has named a new price.

relationships.description: Varus Plancus needs Kaninia Cicero's seal on certain papers; Kaninia Cicero needs Varus Plancus's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Kaninia Cicero's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Varus Plancus holds nothing over Kaninia Cicero.

relationships.description: Tullia Geminus (Underground Broker) and Volso Merula share a family and avoid sharing anything else; every professional dealing between them is conducted as though the relation were a rumour.
relationships.tension: The family has taken a side in a dispute between them. It is the wrong side, in both their opinions.

relationships.description: Flavia Strabo still uses Tullia Geminus (Underground Broker)'s methods and Tullia Geminus (Underground Broker)'s ledger format. Everyone who sees Flavia Strabo's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Tullia Geminus (Underground Broker) has asked Flavia Strabo for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Claudius Dolabella named Decimus Macer as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Decimus Macer has begun teaching Claudius Dolabella's methods as Decimus Macer's own.

relationships.description: Claudius Dolabella and Hortensia Calvus sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Hortensia Calvus has written down what Claudius Dolabella owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Postumia Gallus and Servilia Orestes are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Postumia Gallus lost the last contract to Servilia Orestes by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: The alliance between Postumia Gallus and Vipsanius Ursus was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Postumia Gallus has taken a precaution against Vipsanius Ursus that Vipsanius Ursus was not meant to discover. Vipsanius Ursus has discovered it.

relationships.description: Servilia Orestes shaped Capito Mamercus's career in ways that Capito Mamercus has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Capito Mamercus now operates in ways Servilia Orestes would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Servilia Orestes and Decimus Macer share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Decimus Macer has been dining with Servilia Orestes's rivals. Servilia Orestes heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Varus Plancus once told the council that Servilia Orestes was right and Varus Plancus was wrong. Servilia Orestes has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Servilia Orestes has made a mistake that Varus Plancus is bound to report. Varus Plancus has not reported it.

relationships.description: Decimus Macer stands where Nero Mamercus put them, by a ladder Nero Mamercus built and Decimus Macer has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Nero Mamercus has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Decimus Macer knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: What Sempronia Gratus knows, Nero Mamercus taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Nero Mamercus, quietly, whether Sempronia Gratus can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Nero Mamercus took Helvia Denter in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Helvia Denter has taken on a client Nero Mamercus turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Tullia Geminus (Spymaster) and Decimus Macer consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Tullia Geminus (Spymaster) and Decimus Macer to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Tullia Geminus (Spymaster) trusts Varus Plancus's word over any written contract. Varus Plancus has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Varus Plancus has publicly backed a plan that Tullia Geminus (Spymaster) thinks will fail. Tullia Geminus (Spymaster) has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Tullia Geminus (Spymaster) and Hortensia Calvus deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Hortensia Calvus has recently secured something that makes Tullia Geminus (Spymaster)'s hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Titia Aurelius and Decimus Macer bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Titia Aurelius has hired away Decimus Macer's best assistant. Decimus Macer has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Titia Aurelius married into Varus Plancus's family. Varus Plancus opposed the match and still calls Titia Aurelius by surname.
relationships.tension: Titia Aurelius's child wants to marry into Varus Plancus's household. Neither parent has given an answer.

relationships.description: Volso Merula nursed Titia Aurelius through a winter fever when no one else would come. Titia Aurelius still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Titia Aurelius has refused Volso Merula a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Flavia Strabo receives regular payments from Capito Mamercus's organization in exchange for patrol schedules and advance notice of raids. Both maintain professional courtesy in public.
relationships.tension: A new superior has started asking uncomfortable questions about clearance rates. One of them will have to act before the other does.

relationships.description: Flavia Strabo and Calvus Ursus trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Flavia Strabo or Calvus Ursus can fill it.

npcs.name: Elke Koch
npcs.title: Elder

personality.tell: addresses everyone by full name, never shortened
personality.speech: Speaks in analogies and metaphors, even when clarity would serve better

physical.feature: a voice that carries further than intended
physical.clothes: dress entirely without signal (deliberately so)

goal.short: Convert governance instability into a restoration of prerogatives that formal governance had constrained.
goal.long: Build enough stability that they have choices

secret.what: Passed information about the settlement's water supply to someone in the besieging camp three weeks ago
secret.stakes: People have already died because of it; they've been living with that knowledge

plotHooks: There is a building no one talks about, goes into, or mentions. It is clearly maintained. No one will say by whom.
Someone in the legitimate government is playing both sides. That's useful, until it isn't.

presentation.impression: Ordinary in a way that is itself a kind of presence.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds hereditary or traditional status in a settlement where formal governance is under pressure. Traditional authority often gains relative standing when formal authority loses it.
npcs.activeConstraint: Traditional claims that would have been dismissed under stable governance invite more scrutiny under conditions where everyone is watching for illegitimate power grabs.

npcs.name: Gisela Bauer
npcs.title: Owner

personality.tell: refuses to sit with their back to a door
personality.speech: Uses understatement and dry humour as a defence mechanism

physical.build: slight: smaller than expected for the role
physical.feature: unusually long fingers
physical.clothes: travel-worn but well-maintained gear

goal.short: Figure out what is actually going on before it affects them directly
goal.long: Matter to the people immediately around them: small scale, real

secret.what: Has been rationing their own private food stores while publicly enforcing the communal rationing order
secret.stakes: Two of the people enforcing the rationing know about the stores; they've been paid to look the other way

plotHooks: Someone tried to rob one of their fronts. The attempt was professional. That's more worrying than amateur.
Two families who should be feuding are recently, unexpectedly civil. Neither will explain why.

presentation.impression: Tired, but alert. The combination of someone who works hard and pays attention.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

npcs.name: Luba Bogdanov
npcs.title: Elder

personality.tell: taps their foot in a complex rhythm when bored
personality.speech: Peppers speech with trade or craft jargon even in unrelated contexts

physical.feature: teeth that have been replaced with metal
physical.clothes: clothes practical for their work with one personal flourish

goal.short: Maintain traditional standing within the constraints that stable institutional competition creates.
goal.long: Outlast the occupation and be on the right side when it ends

secret.what: Knows the occupation commander's real orders (not the stated ones), and those orders include a date
secret.stakes: The date is soon. Telling anyone means explaining how they know

plotHooks: Three different people have asked them the same unusual question. None of them knew each other.

presentation.impression: Open. The impression of someone with nothing in particular to hide, or who has decided not to hide it.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds traditional or hereditary status in a stable settlement where institutional competition constrains traditional influence.
npcs.activeConstraint: Traditional authority in stable conditions is in slow structural decline relative to institutional authority.

npcs.name: Ivana Fedorov
npcs.title: Patriarch

personality.tell: checks exits in every new room before speaking
personality.speech: Speaks quickly when lying, slowly when bargaining. The local traders know the tell

physical.feature: a cloak clasped with an unusual brooch
physical.clothes: plain devotional dress with one opulent accessory

goal.short: Preserve institutional resources through the economic pressure without appearing to prosper from conditions that are harming the population.
goal.long: Find the line between pragmatism and betrayal, and stay on the right side of it

secret.what: Possesses a relic that was officially declared destroyed, and kept it because they couldn't face destroying something real
secret.stakes: Possession is heresy; surrender means explaining how they had it

plotHooks: They know which of the current leadership will be the next to fall from grace. They are waiting.

presentation.impression: Genuinely glad to see you, or performs it so well the difference doesn't matter at first.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds religious authority in a settlement under economic pressure. The church's land holdings and endowments are both assets and targets.
npcs.activeConstraint: Any use of institutional resources to protect institutional interests during population-level hardship is visible.
