npcs.name: Ariun Suldus
npcs.title: Elder

personality.tell: cleans or fidgets with their hands constantly
personality.speech: Talks to everyone in the room except the person the answer is for

physical.feature: heavy-lidded eyes that suggest either wisdom or exhaustion
physical.clothes: a good coat inherited from a larger relative

goal.short: Convert governance instability into a restoration of prerogatives that formal governance had constrained.
goal.long: Matter to the people immediately around them: small scale, real

secret.what: Knows something about Khubilai Naiman that Khubilai Naiman believes no one else knows, and has been deciding for months whether to use it
secret.stakes: Khubilai Naiman would move against them immediately if they suspected

plotHooks: They know something small that connects to something much larger. They haven't realised the connection. Yet.

presentation.impression: Reserved. Not hostile, just private.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds hereditary or traditional status in a settlement where formal governance is under pressure. Traditional authority often gains relative standing when formal authority loses it.
npcs.activeConstraint: Traditional claims that would have been dismissed under stable governance invite more scrutiny under conditions where everyone is watching for illegitimate power grabs.

npcs.name: Elchidei Ongut
npcs.title: Darugachi

personality.tell: hums under their breath when concentrating
personality.speech: Trails off mid-sentence when approaching something they regret knowing

physical.feature: eyes that are slightly different colours
physical.clothes: a chain of office worn even off-duty

goal.short: Restore enough perceived legitimacy to make the governing role functional, or identify an exit before the gap between title and authority becomes irreversible.
goal.long: Die in office having kept the peace (legacy matters more than wealth)

secret.what: Authorised an illegal sortie that failed. Five people died and no record was kept
secret.stakes: Qubilai Qonggirad survived it. They know, and they've been drinking heavily ever since

plotHooks: They are carrying out orders they believe are wrong. They have not yet decided at what point they stop carrying them out.
One of their staff has started asking questions about records from seven years ago. They've been reassigned twice already.

presentation.impression: Tired. Not rudely, but visibly. This is a person who has been doing a hard job for a long time.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds nominal governing authority where the legitimacy of that position is in active question. Formal title and real decision-making power are not the same thing.
npcs.activeConstraint: Cannot take the action most likely to restore legitimacy without exposing the informal arrangements that currently keep governance functional.

npcs.name: Khubilai Naiman
npcs.title: Otachi

personality.tell: deflects personal questions with a counter-question
personality.speech: Asks rhetorical questions to make points rather than stating them

physical.feature: a network of small scars on their knuckles
physical.clothes: plain devotional dress with one opulent accessory

goal.short: Extend the institution's civic role in ways that survive whatever governance reconsolidation follows.
goal.long: Survive this: everything else can wait

secret.what: Is in contact with the besieging commander (not as a spy, as a former colleague)
secret.stakes: The relationship predates the siege. They've been using it to buy time, but the council would not accept the distinction

plotHooks: The ambush that killed two of their best people wasn't random. Someone knew the patrol route.

presentation.impression: Interested in you as a person, or at least in what you might need. The attention feels real.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds institutional religious authority in a settlement where civic governance is failing. Religious institutions often absorb civic functions when secular authority contracts.
npcs.activeConstraint: Civic engagement that appears opportunistic risks being reversed by a reconsolidated authority that resents the encroachment.

npcs.name: Altankhuyag Borjigin
npcs.title: Agent

personality.tell: never volunteers information, only answers what is asked
personality.speech: Speaks quickly when lying, slowly when bargaining. The local traders know the tell

physical.feature: a ring on every finger
physical.clothes: clothes practical for their work with one personal flourish

goal.short: Get through this particular difficulty without it becoming a catastrophe
goal.long: Build enough stability that they have choices

secret.what: Secretly negotiating surrender terms with the besieging force, without the council's knowledge
secret.stakes: Treason. The defenders would execute them on the spot if they found out

plotHooks: A regular customer has stopped coming. The reason they've been given doesn't make sense.
A prisoner in their custody knows something valuable. So does someone with reason to ensure they never speak.

presentation.impression: Warm, a little effusive. The first person to make you feel you've arrived somewhere safe.
presentation.behaviour: Asks good questions about your journey. Remembers the answers.

npcs.name: Qubilai Qonggirad
npcs.title: Kheshig

personality.tell: refuses to sit with their back to a door
personality.speech: Uses long pauses as punctuation, sits comfortably in silence

physical.build: slight: smaller than expected for the role
physical.feature: a jaw set permanently as if biting back words
physical.clothes: battle-worn plate they haven't replaced

goal.short: Decide whether to negotiate terms or hold out for relief
goal.long: Keep the settlement intact whatever the cost to themselves

secret.what: Owes Khubilai Naiman a debt from before either of them held their current position: one that Khubilai Naiman has never formally called in
secret.stakes: The silence feels like patience rather than forgiveness

plotHooks: A recruit they turned away has since joined a different outfit. The different outfit is now paying them to monitor this one.
They've noticed the same group of faces at multiple locations where incidents occurred. No one else has.

presentation.impression: Relaxed in a way that reads as confidence rather than carelessness.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

npcs.name: Bochak Mangghud
npcs.title: Noble

personality.tell: drums fingers on surfaces when thinking
personality.speech: Says 'as you know' before telling people things they do not know

physical.feature: eyes that never stop moving
physical.clothes: court attire with discreet personal touches

goal.short: Survive the current political season without a major scandal
goal.long: Build lasting institutional reform that outlives their tenure

secret.what: Knows something about Qubilai Qonggirad that Qubilai Qonggirad believes no one else knows, and has been deciding for months whether to use it
secret.stakes: Qubilai Qonggirad would move against them immediately if they suspected

plotHooks: A merchant they publicly opposed is now publicly supporting them. No explanation offered.

presentation.impression: Efficient, slightly distracted: someone with too many things in their head and a practised way of not showing it.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

npcs.name: Chagatai Arulad
npcs.title: Kheshig

personality.tell: keeps their hands clasped behind their back when displeased
personality.speech: Verbose and elaborate; takes three sentences where one would do

physical.feature: a network of small scars on their knuckles
physical.clothes: soldier's practical dress with officer's insignia

goal.short: Identify the person inside the walls who is communicating with the besiegers
goal.long: End this siege in a way the settlement can recover from

secret.what: Has been skimming from the trade goods reserves to pay a personal debt that predates the siege
secret.stakes: The shortage will be noticed when the final accounting is done. They're hoping they die before that happens

plotHooks: Weapons from the armoury have been disappearing in small quantities for months. The inventory matches, somehow.

presentation.impression: Professionally cordial: the manner of someone who deals with strangers all day and has a system for it.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Qubilai Qonggirad
members.title: Kheshig

personality.tell: refuses to sit with their back to a door
personality.speech: Uses long pauses as punctuation, sits comfortably in silence

physical.build: slight: smaller than expected for the role
physical.feature: a jaw set permanently as if biting back words
physical.clothes: battle-worn plate they haven't replaced

goal.short: Decide whether to negotiate terms or hold out for relief
goal.long: Keep the settlement intact whatever the cost to themselves

secret.what: Owes Khubilai Naiman a debt from before either of them held their current position: one that Khubilai Naiman has never formally called in
secret.stakes: The silence feels like patience rather than forgiveness

plotHooks: A recruit they turned away has since joined a different outfit. The different outfit is now paying them to monitor this one.
They've noticed the same group of faces at multiple locations where incidents occurred. No one else has.

presentation.impression: Relaxed in a way that reads as confidence rather than carelessness.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Chagatai Arulad
members.title: Kheshig

personality.tell: keeps their hands clasped behind their back when displeased
personality.speech: Verbose and elaborate; takes three sentences where one would do

physical.feature: a network of small scars on their knuckles
physical.clothes: soldier's practical dress with officer's insignia

goal.short: Identify the person inside the walls who is communicating with the besiegers
goal.long: End this siege in a way the settlement can recover from

secret.what: Has been skimming from the trade goods reserves to pay a personal debt that predates the siege
secret.stakes: The shortage will be noticed when the final accounting is done. They're hoping they die before that happens

plotHooks: Weapons from the armoury have been disappearing in small quantities for months. The inventory matches, somehow.

presentation.impression: Professionally cordial: the manner of someone who deals with strangers all day and has a system for it.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

relationships.description: Elchidei Ongut and Bochak Mangghud trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Elchidei Ongut or Bochak Mangghud can fill it.

relationships.description: Elchidei Ongut and Qubilai Qonggirad disagree fundamentally about where civil authority ends and military authority begins. The argument has been running for years and occasionally generates paperwork.
relationships.tension: An incident is coming that will force the issue. Both are positioning for it.

relationships.description: Khubilai Naiman stands where Elchidei Ongut put them, by a ladder Elchidei Ongut built and Khubilai Naiman has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Elchidei Ongut has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Khubilai Naiman knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Bochak Mangghud once told the council that Qubilai Qonggirad was right and Bochak Mangghud was wrong. Qubilai Qonggirad has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Qubilai Qonggirad has made a mistake that Bochak Mangghud is bound to report. Bochak Mangghud has not reported it.

relationships.description: What Chagatai Arulad knows, Qubilai Qonggirad taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Qubilai Qonggirad, quietly, whether Chagatai Arulad can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Khubilai Naiman owes Bochak Mangghud something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Bochak Mangghud is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Khubilai Naiman and Altankhuyag Borjigin sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Altankhuyag Borjigin has written down what Khubilai Naiman owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Chagatai Arulad issues orders Elchidei Ongut regards as suggestions, and Elchidei Ongut takes actions Chagatai Arulad regards as insubordination; the settlement runs in the gap between.
relationships.tension: A prisoner is currently held by both jurisdictions at once. Neither will release the paperwork first.

relationships.description: The line between Chagatai Arulad's authority and Bochak Mangghud's has been redrawn four times and honoured never. Each keeps the map that favours them.
relationships.tension: Bochak Mangghud has begun drilling in the square without asking. Chagatai Arulad has begun writing letters to the capital.

relationships.description: Bochak Mangghud took Altankhuyag Borjigin in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Altankhuyag Borjigin has taken on a client Bochak Mangghud turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Ariun Suldus learned the work at Bochak Mangghud's side for seven years. Half of Ariun Suldus's clients first came through Bochak Mangghud's door.
relationships.tension: Bochak Mangghud has taken a new apprentice, and Ariun Suldus has heard the apprentice is being taught things Ariun Suldus never was.

relationships.description: Altankhuyag Borjigin wants Ariun Suldus's position, and Ariun Suldus wants Altankhuyag Borjigin's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Ariun Suldus has been telling clients that Altankhuyag Borjigin's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Altankhuyag Borjigin.

relationships.description: Ariun Suldus vouched for Elchidei Ongut when nobody else would. Elchidei Ongut's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Elchidei Ongut corrected Ariun Suldus in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Every client Ariun Suldus wins is one Khubilai Naiman lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Ariun Suldus and Khubilai Naiman will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

personality.tell: maintains an unnervingly fixed smile during conflict

physical.build: slight: smaller than expected for the role
physical.feature: teeth that have been replaced with metal

goal.long: Write laws that outlast them: real reform, not political theatre

secret.what: Falsified the initial case count to prevent panic, and now the actual count is far higher than the official record
secret.stakes: Corrupt Council is about to do their own independent count as part of a resource audit

plotHooks: A parishioner confessed something to them three months ago. The information is dangerous. They cannot act on it.
They've been quietly buying up property in a district that hasn't been announced as a development site. Yet.

presentation.impression: Warmer than their office suggests. They have the gift of making people feel briefly important.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds nominal governing authority where the legitimacy of that position is in active question. Formal title and real decision-making power are not the same thing.
npcs.activeConstraint: Cannot take the action most likely to restore legitimacy without exposing the informal arrangements that currently keep governance functional.

npcs.name: Lakshmi Deshpande

plotHooks: A novice has the gift. They know what that means for the novice. They're not sure what to do.

personality.tell: speaks of themselves in the third person when angry
personality.speech: Swears colourfully but apologises immediately after

physical.feature: unusually long fingers
physical.clothes: civilian dress worn like a uniform: pressed, squared, joyless

secret.what: Is hoarding medicinal salt that should have been distributed, rationing it for their own use and close associates

relationships.description: Every advance Bharat Patel makes is answered by Rekha Rao within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Bharat Patel took Lakshmi Deshpande in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Lakshmi Deshpande has taken on a client Bharat Patel turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Gayatri Patil paid Bharat Patel's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Bharat Patel mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Gayatri Patil has asked Bharat Patel for a vote against Bharat Patel's own interests. It is the first payment Gayatri Patil has asked for.

relationships.description: Rekha Rao owes Lakshmi Deshpande a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Rekha Rao has started repaying the debt in coin. Lakshmi Deshpande wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Lakshmi Deshpande and Diya Joshi consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Lakshmi Deshpande and Diya Joshi to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Lakshmi Deshpande and Gayatri Patil bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Lakshmi Deshpande has hired away Gayatri Patil's best assistant. Gayatri Patil has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Udayan Pillai kept Lakshmi Deshpande's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Lakshmi Deshpande has voted with Udayan Pillai ever since.
relationships.tension: Udayan Pillai has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Lakshmi Deshpande's partners.

relationships.description: Vijay Ahuja brings the votes and Udayan Pillai brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Udayan Pillai voted against Vijay Ahuja on a small matter last week. Vijay Ahuja is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Vijay Ahuja and Usha Kaur signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Vijay Ahuja and Usha Kaur both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Vijay Ahuja trusts Gayatri Patil's word over any written contract. Gayatri Patil has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Gayatri Patil has publicly backed a plan that Vijay Ahuja thinks will fail. Vijay Ahuja has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Bharat Patel learned the work at Diya Joshi's side for seven years. Half of Bharat Patel's clients first came through Diya Joshi's door.
relationships.tension: Diya Joshi has taken a new apprentice, and Bharat Patel has heard the apprentice is being taught things Bharat Patel never was.

relationships.description: The quarrel between Diya Joshi and Vijay Ahuja is old enough that no one else remembers the cause. They remember. They have simply stopped explaining.
relationships.tension: A newcomer keeps trying to reconcile them, and is about to learn why nobody else does.

relationships.description: Udayan Pillai nursed Gayatri Patil through a winter fever when no one else would come. Gayatri Patil still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Gayatri Patil has refused Udayan Pillai a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Gayatri Patil and Usha Kaur are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Usha Kaur has asked Gayatri Patil to back a candidate Gayatri Patil distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Udayan Pillai borrowed Usha Kaur's good name to win a post. Usha Kaur has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Usha Kaur has fallen on hard times, and the debt Udayan Pillai owes is now the only asset Usha Kaur has.

relationships.description: Udayan Pillai vouched for Bharat Patel when nobody else would. Bharat Patel's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Bharat Patel corrected Udayan Pillai in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Udayan Pillai owes Diya Joshi something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Diya Joshi is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Bharat Patel still uses Usha Kaur's methods and Usha Kaur's ledger format. Everyone who sees Bharat Patel's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Usha Kaur has asked Bharat Patel for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Usha Kaur named Lakshmi Deshpande as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Lakshmi Deshpande has begun teaching Usha Kaur's methods as Lakshmi Deshpande's own.

npcs.title: Exarchos

personality.tell: refuses to sit with their back to a door
personality.speech: Uses softening phrases that make every statement sound like a question

physical.feature: a sealed letter always tucked in their belt
physical.clothes: sombre official black with a jewelled clasp nobody asks about

goal.short: Protect the institutional role by making it indispensable for whatever limited resources remain to be managed.
goal.long: Outlast the occupation and be on the right side when it ends

secret.what: Possesses an original copy of a document that was officially declared destroyed
secret.stakes: The document changes the legitimacy of something very important to very powerful people

plotHooks: Their most trusted advisor hasn't been seen in four days. The official story changes each time it's told.

presentation.impression: Tired. Not rudely, but visibly. This is a person who has been doing a hard job for a long time.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds a civic position in an economically pressured settlement where governance capacity is reduced along with fiscal capacity.
npcs.activeConstraint: Indispensability in a resource-constrained environment means competing with other civic positions for the same shrinking share.

npcs.name: Euphemia Kantakouzenos
npcs.title: Strategos

personality.tell: laughs loudly at their own jokes, silently at others'
personality.speech: Deflects personal questions with philosophical tangents

physical.feature: a ring on every finger
physical.clothes: soldier's practical dress with officer's insignia

goal.short: Keep enforcement visible enough to deter disorder without making the enforcement apparatus the primary civic grievance.
goal.long: Find the line between pragmatism and betrayal, and stay on the right side of it

secret.what: Is smuggling people out, but only those who can pay, and the price has been rising
secret.stakes: Filippos Philanthropenos can't pay. They've been waiting for weeks. The next group leaves in two days

plotHooks: The ambush that killed two of their best people wasn't random. Someone knew the patrol route.

relationships.description: Filippos Philanthropenos controls a vote Alexios II Gregoraios needs, and Alexios II Gregoraios controls a supply Filippos Philanthropenos needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Alexios II Gregoraios has found a new source for what Filippos Philanthropenos supplies. Filippos Philanthropenos has not been told.

relationships.description: Filippos Philanthropenos and Euphemia Kantakouzenos disagree fundamentally about where civil authority ends and military authority begins. The argument has been running for years and occasionally generates paperwork.
relationships.tension: An incident is coming that will force the issue. Both are positioning for it.

relationships.description: Euphemia Kantakouzenos and Alexios II Gregoraios signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Euphemia Kantakouzenos and Alexios II Gregoraios both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: When Manuela Akropolites's crew needs a prisoner released, Euphemia Kantakouzenos signs the order. When Euphemia Kantakouzenos needs an arrest, Manuela Akropolites supplies the culprit.
relationships.tension: Euphemia Kantakouzenos's quarter-day payment from Manuela Akropolites arrived with a name attached: someone Manuela Akropolites wants arrested.

relationships.description: Euphemia Kantakouzenos commands the patrols and Dionysios Hyaleas pays for their routes. The streets Dionysios Hyaleas uses are the quietest in the settlement.
relationships.tension: An auditor from the garrison is counting Euphemia Kantakouzenos's arrest records against the coin in Euphemia Kantakouzenos's house. Dionysios Hyaleas is watching the count.

relationships.description: Years ago Penelope Angelos did for Symeonissa Raoul the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Symeonissa Raoul has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Symeonissa Raoul has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Penelope Angelos does not.

relationships.description: Symeonissa Raoul and Panteleimon Palaiologos each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Panteleimon Palaiologos needs from Symeonissa Raoul comes up next week, and Symeonissa Raoul has named a new price.

relationships.description: Eudokia Choniates and Theophanes Gabalas bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Eudokia Choniates has hired away Theophanes Gabalas's best assistant. Theophanes Gabalas has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Eudokia Choniates trusts Isaakios Chrysoberges's word over any written contract. Isaakios Chrysoberges has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Isaakios Chrysoberges has publicly backed a plan that Eudokia Choniates thinks will fail. Eudokia Choniates has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Manuela Akropolites and Dionysios Hyaleas trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Manuela Akropolites or Dionysios Hyaleas can fill it.

relationships.description: Manuela Akropolites and Isaakios Chrysoberges have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Manuela Akropolites and Melane Doukas disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Theophanes Gabalas and Isaakios Chrysoberges are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Isaakios Chrysoberges has asked Theophanes Gabalas to back a candidate Theophanes Gabalas distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Theophanes Gabalas and Manuela Akropolites, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Melane Doukas needs Christofora Lekapenos's seal on certain papers; Christofora Lekapenos needs Melane Doukas's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Christofora Lekapenos's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Melane Doukas holds nothing over Christofora Lekapenos.

relationships.description: Christofora Lekapenos and Gregorios Glabas work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Melane Doukas sends difficult cases to Gregorios Glabas, and Gregorios Glabas sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Melane Doukas has learned something about Gregorios Glabas's family that Gregorios Glabas does not know.

relationships.description: Melane Doukas wants Eudokia Choniates's position, and Eudokia Choniates wants Melane Doukas's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Eudokia Choniates has been telling clients that Melane Doukas's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Melane Doukas.

relationships.description: Melane Doukas and Theophanes Gabalas are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: The alliance between Christodoulaki Phokas and Filippos Philanthropenos was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Christodoulaki Phokas has taken a precaution against Filippos Philanthropenos that Filippos Philanthropenos was not meant to discover. Filippos Philanthropenos has discovered it.

relationships.description: Between Christodoulaki Phokas and Manuela Akropolites stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Dionysios Hyaleas and Eudokia Choniates share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Eudokia Choniates has been dining with Dionysios Hyaleas's rivals. Dionysios Hyaleas heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Dionysios Hyaleas took Christodoulaki Phokas in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Christodoulaki Phokas has taken on a client Dionysios Hyaleas turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Panteleimon Palaiologos married into Penelope Angelos's family. Penelope Angelos opposed the match and still calls Panteleimon Palaiologos by surname.
relationships.tension: Panteleimon Palaiologos's child wants to marry into Penelope Angelos's household. Neither parent has given an answer.

relationships.description: Every client Panteleimon Palaiologos wins is one Eudokia Choniates lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Panteleimon Palaiologos and Eudokia Choniates will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Panteleimon Palaiologos and Isaakios Chrysoberges sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Isaakios Chrysoberges has written down what Panteleimon Palaiologos owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Christodoulaki Phokas paid Alexios II Gregoraios's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Alexios II Gregoraios mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Christodoulaki Phokas has asked Alexios II Gregoraios for a vote against Alexios II Gregoraios's own interests. It is the first payment Christodoulaki Phokas has asked for.

relationships.description: Alexios II Gregoraios owes Panteleimon Palaiologos a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Alexios II Gregoraios has started repaying the debt in coin. Panteleimon Palaiologos wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Penelope Angelos learned the work at Alexios II Gregoraios's side for seven years. Half of Penelope Angelos's clients first came through Alexios II Gregoraios's door.
relationships.tension: Alexios II Gregoraios has taken a new apprentice, and Penelope Angelos has heard the apprentice is being taught things Penelope Angelos never was.

relationships.description: Gregorios Glabas and Eudokia Choniates each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Gregorios Glabas and Penelope Angelos back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Gregorios Glabas wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Penelope Angelos thinks the newcomer would take Penelope Angelos's place.

relationships.description: Isaakios Chrysoberges and Dionysios Hyaleas have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Dionysios Hyaleas has been offered Isaakios Chrysoberges's post by people who want Isaakios Chrysoberges gone.

relationships.description: Isaakios Chrysoberges and Penelope Angelos are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Isaakios Chrysoberges lost the last contract to Penelope Angelos by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Isaakios Chrysoberges vouched for Christodoulaki Phokas when nobody else would. Christodoulaki Phokas's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Christodoulaki Phokas corrected Isaakios Chrysoberges in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Penelope Angelos and Eudokia Choniates are cousins on opposite sides of the settlement's politics. Their grandmother still seats them together.
relationships.tension: Eudokia Choniates has gone into business against Penelope Angelos's partners, and the family expects Penelope Angelos to keep the peace.

relationships.description: Theophanes Gabalas once told the council that Penelope Angelos was right and Theophanes Gabalas was wrong. Penelope Angelos has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Penelope Angelos has made a mistake that Theophanes Gabalas is bound to report. Theophanes Gabalas has not reported it.

relationships.description: Christofora Lekapenos is Penelope Angelos's half-sibling, raised in the same house and left out of the same will.
relationships.tension: A family property must be sold, and Penelope Angelos and Christofora Lekapenos each want the money for a different purpose.

relationships.description: Tofa Leidolfsson learned the work at Rorik Styrkarsson's side for seven years. Half of Tofa Leidolfsson's clients first came through Rorik Styrkarsson's door.
relationships.tension: Rorik Styrkarsson has taken a new apprentice, and Tofa Leidolfsson has heard the apprentice is being taught things Tofa Leidolfsson never was.

relationships.description: Rorik Styrkarsson vouched for Helgi Gormsson when nobody else would. Helgi Gormsson's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Helgi Gormsson corrected Rorik Styrkarsson in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Birger Dagsson borrowed Ljot Ketilsson's good name to win a post. Ljot Ketilsson has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Ljot Ketilsson has fallen on hard times, and the debt Birger Dagsson owes is now the only asset Ljot Ketilsson has.

relationships.description: Birger Dagsson and Helgi Gormsson have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Helgi Gormsson has been offered Birger Dagsson's post by people who want Birger Dagsson gone.

relationships.description: Birger Dagsson and Snorri Kolbeinsson work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Hildigunn Ketilsson and Rorik Styrkarsson sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Rorik Styrkarsson has written down what Hildigunn Ketilsson owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Hildigunn Ketilsson and Frigg Snorrason each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Nidud Snorrason once told the council that Hildigunn Ketilsson was right and Nidud Snorrason was wrong. Hildigunn Ketilsson has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Hildigunn Ketilsson has made a mistake that Nidud Snorrason is bound to report. Nidud Snorrason has not reported it.

relationships.description: Estrid Eriksson and Böðvildr Eyjolfsson want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Every civic project Estrid Eriksson announces has first been costed, quietly, in Frigg Snorrason's counting-room. The public believes the order is the other way around.
relationships.tension: A faction on the council wants the debt repudiated outright. Estrid Eriksson has stopped disagreeing in public.

relationships.description: Estrid Eriksson's treasury borrowed from Helga Styrkarsson to cover a bad harvest and has borrowed every year since. The interest is paid before the wages.
relationships.tension: Helga Styrkarsson has asked for a seat on the council as a condition of the next loan. Estrid Eriksson has three weeks to answer.

relationships.description: Every advance Helgi Gormsson makes is answered by Snorri Kolbeinsson within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: What Helgi Gormsson knows would ruin Hildigunn Raudsson; what Hildigunn Raudsson holds would finish Helgi Gormsson. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Snorri Kolbeinsson and Frigg Snorrason deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Frigg Snorrason has recently secured something that makes Snorri Kolbeinsson's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Blood ties Snorri Kolbeinsson to Hildigunn Raudsson in a way that neither career can afford; they meet at funerals and weddings and pretend the rest of the year does not exist.
relationships.tension: A younger relative has begun trading on the connection both of them refuse to use.

relationships.description: Böðvildr Eyjolfsson and Hlíf Froðason trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Böðvildr Eyjolfsson has asked Hlíf Froðason for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Hildigunn Raudsson holds the settlement's tax rolls as security for its loans. Böðvildr Eyjolfsson cannot raise a levy without Hildigunn Raudsson's clerks counting it first.
relationships.tension: Böðvildr Eyjolfsson has proposed a new tax to clear the debt. Hildigunn Raudsson's friends on the council will vote against it.

relationships.description: Böðvildr Eyjolfsson owes Helga Styrkarsson more than the settlement collects in two years of taxes. Helga Styrkarsson is paid first, every quarter.
relationships.tension: Helga Styrkarsson is calling in a third of the debt at once. Böðvildr Eyjolfsson has until the next quarter day to find it.

relationships.description: Frigg Snorrason and Helgi Gormsson bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Frigg Snorrason has hired away Helgi Gormsson's best assistant. Helgi Gormsson has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Frigg Snorrason and Hildigunn Raudsson consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Frigg Snorrason and Hildigunn Raudsson to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Frigg Snorrason owes Helga Styrkarsson something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Helga Styrkarsson is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Hildigunn Raudsson and Helga Styrkarsson fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Helga Styrkarsson's face.
relationships.tension: Hildigunn Raudsson has learned that Helga Styrkarsson is in debt and could be ruined by one call on a loan.

relationships.description: Years ago Magnus Ulfsson did for Hildigunn Raudsson the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Hildigunn Raudsson has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Hildigunn Raudsson has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Magnus Ulfsson does not.

relationships.description: Nidud Snorrason still uses Hildigunn Raudsson's methods and Hildigunn Raudsson's ledger format. Everyone who sees Nidud Snorrason's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Hildigunn Raudsson has asked Nidud Snorrason for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Tofa Leidolfsson and Thorstein Drengsson trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Tofa Leidolfsson or Thorstein Drengsson can fill it.

relationships.description: Between Tofa Leidolfsson and Frigg Snorrason stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Ljot Ketilsson trusts Hildigunn Raudsson's word over any written contract. Hildigunn Raudsson has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Hildigunn Raudsson has publicly backed a plan that Ljot Ketilsson thinks will fail. Ljot Ketilsson has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Ljot Ketilsson and Helga Styrkarsson disagree fundamentally about where civil authority ends and military authority begins. The argument has been running for years and occasionally generates paperwork.
relationships.tension: An incident is coming that will force the issue. Both are positioning for it.

relationships.description: Ljot Ketilsson issues orders Snorri Kolbeinsson regards as suggestions, and Snorri Kolbeinsson takes actions Ljot Ketilsson regards as insubordination; the settlement runs in the gap between.
relationships.tension: A prisoner is currently held by both jurisdictions at once. Neither will release the paperwork first.

relationships.description: Helga Styrkarsson wants Helgi Gormsson's position, and Helgi Gormsson wants Helga Styrkarsson's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Helgi Gormsson has been telling clients that Helga Styrkarsson's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Helga Styrkarsson.

relationships.description: Every client Helga Styrkarsson wins is one Magnus Ulfsson lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Helga Styrkarsson and Magnus Ulfsson will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Thorstein Drengsson and Rorik Styrkarsson have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Thorstein Drengsson named Ljot Ketilsson as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Ljot Ketilsson has begun teaching Thorstein Drengsson's methods as Ljot Ketilsson's own.

relationships.description: The line between Thorstein Drengsson's authority and Snorri Kolbeinsson's has been redrawn four times and honoured never. Each keeps the map that favours them.
relationships.tension: Snorri Kolbeinsson has begun drilling in the square without asking. Thorstein Drengsson has begun writing letters to the capital.

relationships.description: Hlíf Froðason and Estrid Eriksson are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Hlíf Froðason lost the last contract to Estrid Eriksson by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Hildigunn Raudsson lends and Hlíf Froðason spends. The council's decisions are made in Hlíf Froðason's chamber and approved in Hildigunn Raudsson's counting-house.
relationships.tension: Hlíf Froðason has started borrowing small sums from Hildigunn Raudsson's rivals. Hildigunn Raudsson's clerks have seen the receipts.

relationships.description: Magnus Ulfsson controls a vote Helgi Gormsson needs, and Helgi Gormsson controls a supply Magnus Ulfsson needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Helgi Gormsson has found a new source for what Magnus Ulfsson supplies. Magnus Ulfsson has not been told.

relationships.description: Magnus Ulfsson and Snorri Kolbeinsson compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Kolbeinn Eindriðason and Myrkjartan Eriksson each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Myrkjartan Eriksson needs from Kolbeinn Eindriðason comes up next week, and Kolbeinn Eindriðason has named a new price.

relationships.description: Kolbeinn Eindriðason and Estrid Eriksson share a family and avoid sharing anything else; every professional dealing between them is conducted as though the relation were a rumour.
relationships.tension: The family has taken a side in a dispute between them. It is the wrong side, in both their opinions.

relationships.description: Kolbeinn Eindriðason and Helgi Gormsson are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Helgi Gormsson needs Nidud Snorrason's seal on certain papers; Nidud Snorrason needs Helgi Gormsson's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Nidud Snorrason's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Helgi Gormsson holds nothing over Nidud Snorrason.

relationships.description: Nidud Snorrason and Snorri Kolbeinsson bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Nidud Snorrason has hired away Snorri Kolbeinsson's best assistant. Snorri Kolbeinsson has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Myrkjartan Eriksson and Hildigunn Raudsson trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Myrkjartan Eriksson has asked Hildigunn Raudsson for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: The alliance between Myrkjartan Eriksson and Helga Styrkarsson was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Myrkjartan Eriksson has taken a precaution against Helga Styrkarsson that Helga Styrkarsson was not meant to discover. Helga Styrkarsson has discovered it.

relationships.description: Myrkjartan Eriksson and Hlíf Froðason share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Hlíf Froðason has been dining with Myrkjartan Eriksson's rivals. Myrkjartan Eriksson heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Between Sanjay Kaur and Damayanti Ahuja stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Rajesh Ghosh and Ashoka Parekh sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Ashoka Parekh has written down what Rajesh Ghosh owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Rajesh Ghosh and Ganesh Ahuja each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Ganesh Ahuja owes Siddharth Reddy more than the settlement collects in two years of taxes. Siddharth Reddy is paid first, every quarter.
relationships.tension: Siddharth Reddy is calling in a third of the debt at once. Ganesh Ahuja has until the next quarter day to find it.

relationships.description: Meena Dixit lends and Ganesh Ahuja spends. The council's decisions are made in Ganesh Ahuja's chamber and approved in Meena Dixit's counting-house.
relationships.tension: Ganesh Ahuja has started borrowing small sums from Meena Dixit's rivals. Meena Dixit's clerks have seen the receipts.

relationships.description: What Damayanti Ahuja knows would ruin Siddharth Reddy; what Siddharth Reddy holds would finish Damayanti Ahuja. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Ekaparnika Jha paid Damayanti Ahuja's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Damayanti Ahuja mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Ekaparnika Jha has asked Damayanti Ahuja for a vote against Damayanti Ahuja's own interests. It is the first payment Ekaparnika Jha has asked for.

relationships.description: Damayanti Ahuja owes Meena Dixit a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Damayanti Ahuja has started repaying the debt in coin. Meena Dixit wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Sona Ghosh reports to Siddharth Reddy on paper and to no one in practice. Siddharth Reddy has three letters of complaint unanswered.
relationships.tension: Sona Ghosh arrested a councillor's son without Siddharth Reddy's warrant. Siddharth Reddy has demanded his release by tomorrow.

relationships.description: The alliance between Siddharth Reddy and Umesh Kaur was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Siddharth Reddy has taken a precaution against Umesh Kaur that Umesh Kaur was not meant to discover. Umesh Kaur has discovered it.

relationships.description: Ekaparnika Jha kept Siddharth Reddy's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Siddharth Reddy has voted with Ekaparnika Jha ever since.
relationships.tension: Ekaparnika Jha has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Siddharth Reddy's partners.

relationships.description: Ashoka Parekh and Ganesh Ahuja deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Ganesh Ahuja has recently secured something that makes Ashoka Parekh's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Ashoka Parekh and Siddharth Reddy trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Ashoka Parekh has asked Siddharth Reddy for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Ashoka Parekh named Meena Dixit as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.

relationships.description: Sona Ghosh wants the watch under civil command; Meena Dixit wants the council out of the barracks. They meet monthly and settle nothing.
relationships.tension: Sona Ghosh has asked the capital to replace Meena Dixit. Meena Dixit has asked the capital to dissolve Sona Ghosh's council.

relationships.description: Sona Ghosh controls a vote Ashoka Parekh needs, and Ashoka Parekh controls a supply Sona Ghosh needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.

relationships.description: Eire Chortasmenos wants Nikephoros Doukas's position, and Nikephoros Doukas wants Eire Chortasmenos's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Nikephoros Doukas has been telling clients that Eire Chortasmenos's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Eire Chortasmenos.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Eire Chortasmenos and Vasileios Kataphloron, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Nikephoros Doukas reports to Vasileios Kataphloron on paper and to no one in practice. Vasileios Kataphloron has three letters of complaint unanswered.
relationships.tension: Nikephoros Doukas arrested a councillor's son without Vasileios Kataphloron's warrant. Vasileios Kataphloron has demanded his release by tomorrow.

relationships.description: Every client Vasileios Kataphloron wins is one Ioasaph Chomatenos lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Vasileios Kataphloron and Ioasaph Chomatenos will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Vasileios Kataphloron's clearance record looks respectable because Tyche Kalojan decides which crimes get cleared. The price of the arrangement is itemised and paid on time.
relationships.tension: The payments have started arriving late. In this trade, late is a message.

relationships.description: Ioanna Kamytzes controls a vote Eire Chortasmenos needs, and Eire Chortasmenos controls a supply Ioanna Kamytzes needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Eire Chortasmenos has found a new source for what Ioanna Kamytzes supplies. Ioanna Kamytzes has not been told.

relationships.description: Ioanna Kamytzes owes Ioasaph Chomatenos something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Ioasaph Chomatenos is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Hierotheos Philanthropenos and Georgia Akropolites were something to each other once (partners, friends, perhaps more), and the wreck of it is the one subject on which both are permanently silent.
relationships.tension: An apology is owed in one direction and expected in the other, and they disagree about which.

relationships.description: Hierotheos Philanthropenos and Ioannes Muzalon each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Ioannes Muzalon needs from Hierotheos Philanthropenos comes up next week, and Hierotheos Philanthropenos has named a new price.

relationships.description: Hierotheos Philanthropenos and Eirene Hyaleas are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Hierotheos Philanthropenos lost the last contract to Eirene Hyaleas by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Katakalon Botaneiates needs Ioasaph Chomatenos's seal on certain papers; Ioasaph Chomatenos needs Katakalon Botaneiates's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Ioasaph Chomatenos's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Katakalon Botaneiates holds nothing over Ioasaph Chomatenos.

relationships.description: Hierotheos Philanthropenos holds the settlement's debts and therefore, in every way that matters, its agenda; Ioasaph Chomatenos governs within the margin Hierotheos Philanthropenos allows.
relationships.tension: The interest falls due at midsummer and the treasury will not cover it. Hierotheos Philanthropenos has already drafted the terms of the extension.

relationships.description: Every civic project Ioasaph Chomatenos announces has first been costed, quietly, in Georgia Akropolites's counting-room. The public believes the order is the other way around.
relationships.tension: A faction on the council wants the debt repudiated outright. Ioasaph Chomatenos has stopped disagreeing in public.

relationships.description: Katakalon Botaneiates's treasury borrowed from Hierotheos Philanthropenos to cover a bad harvest and has borrowed every year since. The interest is paid before the wages.
relationships.tension: Hierotheos Philanthropenos has asked for a seat on the council as a condition of the next loan. Katakalon Botaneiates has three weeks to answer.

relationships.description: Georgia Akropolites holds the settlement's tax rolls as security for its loans. Katakalon Botaneiates cannot raise a levy without Georgia Akropolites's clerks counting it first.
relationships.tension: Katakalon Botaneiates has proposed a new tax to clear the debt. Georgia Akropolites's friends on the council will vote against it.

relationships.description: What Ioannes Muzalon knows, Georgia Akropolites taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Georgia Akropolites, quietly, whether Ioannes Muzalon can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: The quarrel between Georgia Akropolites and Tyche Kalojan is old enough that no one else remembers the cause. They remember. They have simply stopped explaining.
relationships.tension: A newcomer keeps trying to reconcile them, and is about to learn why nobody else does.

relationships.description: Georgia Akropolites and Elias Lekapenos are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Tyche Kalojan and Elias Lekapenos compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Tyche Kalojan and Heracles Skleros want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: The alliance between Elias Lekapenos and Heracles Skleros was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Elias Lekapenos has taken a precaution against Heracles Skleros that Heracles Skleros was not meant to discover. Heracles Skleros has discovered it.

relationships.description: Years ago Theodora Protostrator did for Elias Lekapenos the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Elias Lekapenos has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Elias Lekapenos has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Theodora Protostrator does not.

relationships.description: Nikephoros Doukas and Ioanna Kamytzes share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Ioanna Kamytzes has been dining with Nikephoros Doukas's rivals. Nikephoros Doukas heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Nikephoros Doukas took Ioasaph Chomatenos in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Ioasaph Chomatenos has taken on a client Nikephoros Doukas turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Nikephoros Doukas owes Hierotheos Philanthropenos more than the settlement collects in two years of taxes. Hierotheos Philanthropenos is paid first, every quarter.
relationships.tension: Hierotheos Philanthropenos is calling in a third of the debt at once. Nikephoros Doukas has until the next quarter day to find it.

relationships.description: Ioannes Muzalon and Eirene Hyaleas back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Ioannes Muzalon wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Eirene Hyaleas thinks the newcomer would take Eirene Hyaleas's place.

relationships.description: Katakalon Botaneiates lends and Ioannes Muzalon spends. The council's decisions are made in Ioannes Muzalon's chamber and approved in Katakalon Botaneiates's counting-house.
relationships.tension: Ioannes Muzalon has started borrowing small sums from Katakalon Botaneiates's rivals. Katakalon Botaneiates's clerks have seen the receipts.

relationships.description: Between Pankratios Gregoraios and Euphemia Nikerites stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Pankratios Gregoraios and Hierotheos Philanthropenos sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Hierotheos Philanthropenos has written down what Pankratios Gregoraios owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Pankratios Gregoraios and Ioasaph Chomatenos each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: What Heracles Skleros knows would ruin Hierotheos Philanthropenos; what Hierotheos Philanthropenos holds would finish Heracles Skleros. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Heracles Skleros brings the votes and Ioannes Muzalon brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Ioannes Muzalon voted against Heracles Skleros on a small matter last week. Heracles Skleros is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Heracles Skleros and Eirene Hyaleas signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Heracles Skleros and Eirene Hyaleas both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Eirene Hyaleas and Georgia Akropolites are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Georgia Akropolites has asked Eirene Hyaleas to back a candidate Eirene Hyaleas distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Eirene Hyaleas governs on Ioasaph Chomatenos's credit. Every loan renewed adds one more condition to the next.
relationships.tension: Ioasaph Chomatenos has refused credit for the winter grain stores. Eirene Hyaleas must choose between the creditor and the granary.

relationships.description: Eirene Hyaleas and Tyche Kalojan deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Tyche Kalojan has recently secured something that makes Eirene Hyaleas's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Every advance Theodora Protostrator makes is answered by Aristoteles Melas within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Theodora Protostrator and Hierotheos Philanthropenos bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Theodora Protostrator has hired away Hierotheos Philanthropenos's best assistant. Hierotheos Philanthropenos has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Theodora Protostrator testified against Georgia Akropolites in a case ten years ago. Georgia Akropolites lost a fortune and has not spoken to Theodora Protostrator since.
relationships.tension: Georgia Akropolites has been appointed to judge a case in which Theodora Protostrator is a party.

relationships.description: Euphemia Nikerites and Sebastianos Bryennios trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Euphemia Nikerites has asked Sebastianos Bryennios for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Euphemia Nikerites controls a vote Hierotheos Philanthropenos needs, and Hierotheos Philanthropenos controls a supply Euphemia Nikerites needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Hierotheos Philanthropenos has found a new source for what Euphemia Nikerites supplies. Euphemia Nikerites has not been told.

relationships.description: Sebastianos Bryennios sends difficult cases to Pankratios Gregoraios, and Pankratios Gregoraios sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Sebastianos Bryennios has learned something about Pankratios Gregoraios's family that Pankratios Gregoraios does not know.

relationships.description: Sebastianos Bryennios and Hierotheos Philanthropenos have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Hierotheos Philanthropenos has been offered Sebastianos Bryennios's post by people who want Sebastianos Bryennios gone.

relationships.description: Sebastianos Bryennios and Ioasaph Chomatenos each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Ioasaph Chomatenos needs from Sebastianos Bryennios comes up next week, and Sebastianos Bryennios has named a new price.

relationships.description: Aristoteles Melas and Hierotheos Philanthropenos work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Georgia Akropolites learned the work at Aristoteles Melas's side for seven years. Half of Georgia Akropolites's clients first came through Aristoteles Melas's door.
relationships.tension: Aristoteles Melas has taken a new apprentice, and Georgia Akropolites has heard the apprentice is being taught things Georgia Akropolites never was.

relationships.description: Aristoteles Melas brings the votes and Tyche Kalojan brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Tyche Kalojan voted against Aristoteles Melas on a small matter last week. Aristoteles Melas is waiting to see whether it was small.
