secret.stakes: The family member knows enough to burn them; the payments are leverage

plotHooks: Their predecessor left something behind (in a place where it shouldn't have been), and they haven't reported finding it.
A document they were asked to witness contained a clause they noticed at the time and said nothing about.

presentation.impression: Reserved. Not hostile, just private.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Lesya Ilić
members.title: Master

personality.tell: quotes scripture or proverbs in casual conversation
personality.speech: Speaks softly, forcing others to lean in

physical.feature: a perpetual half-smile
physical.clothes: guard uniform kept immaculate

goal.short: Identify the weak link before the weak link identifies itself in a crisis
goal.long: Achieve enough distinction to be remembered without being mourned too soon

secret.what: Their appointment was secured through forged credentials
secret.stakes: Discovery ends their career and discredits every decision they've made

plotHooks: A recruit they turned away has since joined a different outfit. The different outfit is now paying them to monitor this one.
Weapons from the armoury have been disappearing in small quantities for months. The inventory matches, somehow.

presentation.impression: Professionally cordial: the manner of someone who deals with strangers all day and has a system for it.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Gordanka Kiselev
members.title: Noble

personality.tell: touches a specific piece of jewellery when stressed
personality.speech: Pauses mid-sentence to choose words with visible care

physical.feature: a cloak clasped with an unusual brooch
physical.clothes: official dress one grade above their actual station

goal.short: Survive the current political season without a major scandal
goal.long: Build lasting institutional reform that outlives their tenure

secret.what: Knows that the decisive victory everyone celebrates was won through treachery, not skill
secret.stakes: Several people built careers on that victory; they would not appreciate the truth

plotHooks: A sealed letter arrived for them three weeks ago. They haven't opened it. They won't say why.
A weapons cache they were responsible for is smaller than it should be. They haven't reported it yet.

presentation.impression: Tired and ordinary. The manner of someone who is carrying less than they are.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative. Unassuming. Easy to overlook.

members.name: Uljana Loginov
members.title: Kapitan

personality.tell: keeps a coin or token that they flip when making decisions
personality.speech: Uses understatement and dry humour as a defence mechanism

physical.feature: a cloak clasped with an unusual brooch
physical.clothes: civilian dress worn like a uniform: pressed, squared, joyless

goal.short: Train the next cohort to a standard that might actually keep people alive
goal.long: Build a force that doesn't need them: sustainable, not dependent

secret.what: Has already made personal arrangements to leave before the final assault. Their family left last week
secret.stakes: Teodora Krylov saw them loading the cart. They don't know what Teodora Krylov understood

plotHooks: They are carrying out orders they believe are wrong. They have not yet decided at what point they stop carrying them out.
A weapons cache they were responsible for is smaller than it should be. They haven't reported it yet.

presentation.impression: Direct. They assess you in the first three seconds and their expression tells you they've reached a provisional conclusion.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Zorana Popov
members.title: Kupets

personality.tell: traces patterns on flat surfaces absentmindedly
personality.speech: Speaks in short, clipped sentences: every word intentional

physical.feature: a ring on every finger
physical.clothes: guild colours worn with pride

goal.short: Answer, in secret, to a patron no one is meant to know.
goal.long: Convert wealth into political power: a seat on the council, then more

secret.what: Knows their religious order was founded on a historical lie
secret.stakes: The truth would shatter the institution they've dedicated their life to

plotHooks: A business rival has offered them a partnership with terms so good it must be a trap. They can't find the trap.

presentation.impression: Busy, or presenting as busy. The first impression is of someone who doesn't waste time.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Olivera Karpov
members.title: Gildsmaster of Furrier's district

personality.tell: taps their foot in a complex rhythm when bored
personality.speech: Deflects personal questions with philosophical tangents

physical.feature: a scar cutting through one eyebrow
physical.clothes: last season's fashion maintained with visible determination

goal.short: Place a talented apprentice in a role that increases guild influence
goal.long: Be remembered as the master who expanded the guild into new trades

secret.what: Is in contact with the besieging commander (not as a spy, as a former colleague)
secret.stakes: The relationship predates the siege. They've been using it to buy time, but the council would not accept the distinction

plotHooks: A young trader has been undercutting them in ways that shouldn't be possible on their claimed capital.

presentation.impression: Cautious with newcomers. The wariness is professional rather than personal.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Xeno Lebedev
members.title: Starosta

personality.tell: repeats the last word of a sentence spoken to them before responding
personality.speech: Verbose and elaborate; takes three sentences where one would do

physical.feature: surprisingly soft hands
physical.clothes: weathered gear maintained past the point of economy

goal.short: Get through this particular difficulty without it becoming a catastrophe
goal.long: Build enough stability that they have choices

secret.what: Passed information about the settlement's water supply to someone in the besieging camp three weeks ago
secret.stakes: People have already died because of it; they've been living with that knowledge

plotHooks: Someone is paying their soldiers more than their salary. The soldiers aren't saying who.
A weapons cache they were responsible for is smaller than it should be. They haven't reported it yet.

presentation.impression: Tired, but alert. The combination of someone who works hard and pays attention.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Olia Dmitriev
members.title: Owner

personality.tell: drums fingers on surfaces when thinking
personality.speech: Trails off mid-sentence when approaching something they regret knowing

physical.feature: a ring on every finger
physical.clothes: weathered gear maintained past the point of economy

goal.short: Figure out what is actually going on before it affects them directly
goal.long: Matter to the people immediately around them: small scale, real

secret.what: Has been rationing their own private food stores while publicly enforcing the communal rationing order
secret.stakes: Two of the people enforcing the rationing know about the stores; they've been paid to look the other way

plotHooks: A weapons cache they were responsible for is smaller than it should be. They haven't reported it yet.

presentation.impression: Reserved. Not hostile, just private.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Artem Klimov
members.title: Noble

personality.tell: pauses for exactly three seconds before answering any question
personality.speech: Says 'as you know' before telling people things they do not know

physical.feature: unusually long fingers
physical.clothes: sombre official black with a jewelled clasp nobody asks about

secret.what: Runs a protection scheme targeting the very merchants they're supposed to serve
secret.stakes: Civil and criminal liability; the merchants have been keeping records

plotHooks: A merchant they publicly opposed is now publicly supporting them. No explanation offered.

presentation.impression: Tired. Not rudely, but visibly. This is a person who has been doing a hard job for a long time.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Stoycho Golubev
members.title: Kupets

personality.tell: cleans or fidgets with their hands constantly
personality.speech: Speaks quickly when lying, slowly when bargaining. The local traders know the tell

physical.feature: an old injury that affects their gait
physical.clothes: merchant dress: practical but signalling wealth through material

goal.short: Close the deal that will determine this year's profitability
goal.long: Build something that doesn't need them to keep running

secret.what: Was ordered to commit an atrocity and complied, and has since risen in the organisation that ordered it
secret.stakes: The order came from someone senior; exposure implicates both of them

plotHooks: A contract they signed in difficult times has a clause they didn't fully read. Someone has read it.
They've noticed the same group of faces at multiple locations where incidents occurred. No one else has.

presentation.impression: Affable. The manner of someone for whom friendliness is both genuine and useful.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

relationships.description: The quarrel between Teodora Krylov and Artem Klimov is old enough that no one else remembers the cause. They remember. They have simply stopped explaining.
relationships.tension: A newcomer keeps trying to reconcile them, and is about to learn why nobody else does.

relationships.description: Teodora Krylov wants the watch under civil command; Bozhidar Lukić wants the council out of the barracks. They meet monthly and settle nothing.
relationships.tension: Teodora Krylov has asked the capital to replace Bozhidar Lukić. Bozhidar Lukić has asked the capital to dissolve Teodora Krylov's council.

relationships.description: Teodora Krylov wants Uljana Loginov's position, and Uljana Loginov wants Teodora Krylov's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Uljana Loginov has been telling clients that Teodora Krylov's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Teodora Krylov.

relationships.description: Every client Guido Davydov wins is one Lesya Ilić lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Guido Davydov and Lesya Ilić will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Mirjana Solovyov once told the council that Guido Davydov was right and Mirjana Solovyov was wrong. Guido Davydov has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Guido Davydov has made a mistake that Mirjana Solovyov is bound to report. Mirjana Solovyov has not reported it.

relationships.description: Yelena Janković and Mirjana Solovyov consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Yelena Janković and Mirjana Solovyov to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Yelena Janković and Gordanka Kiselev each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Yelena Janković shaped Teodora Krylov's career in ways that Teodora Krylov has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Teodora Krylov now operates in ways Yelena Janković would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Zorana Popov and Olivera Karpov are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Zorana Popov lost the last contract to Olivera Karpov by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Zorana Popov and Milena Davydov compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Zorana Popov and Mirjana Solovyov want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Bozhidar Lukić and Evgeny Loginov are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Guido Davydov stands where Bozhidar Lukić put them, by a ladder Bozhidar Lukić built and Guido Davydov has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Bozhidar Lukić has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Guido Davydov knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Every advance Evgeny Loginov makes is answered by Uljana Loginov within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Evgeny Loginov sets the curfew and Teodora Krylov decides whether to enforce it. The two have not agreed on a curfew in a year.
relationships.tension: A riot is expected on the next market day, and Evgeny Loginov and Teodora Krylov have issued opposite orders for it.

relationships.description: What Olivera Karpov knows would ruin Stoycho Golubev; what Stoycho Golubev holds would finish Olivera Karpov. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Olivera Karpov and Mirjana Solovyov deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Mirjana Solovyov has recently secured something that makes Olivera Karpov's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Olivera Karpov trusts Gordanka Kiselev's word over any written contract. Gordanka Kiselev has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Gordanka Kiselev has publicly backed a plan that Olivera Karpov thinks will fail. Olivera Karpov has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Gordanka Kiselev answers Lesya Ilić's summons late and leaves early. Lesya Ilić now issues them in writing so the delays are on record.
relationships.tension: Gordanka Kiselev has begun collecting a road toll for the garrison. Lesya Ilić calls it theft from the treasury.

relationships.description: Lesya Ilić receives regular payments from Artem Krylov's organization in exchange for patrol schedules and advance notice of raids. Both maintain professional courtesy in public.
relationships.tension: A new superior has started asking uncomfortable questions about clearance rates. One of them will have to act before the other does.

relationships.description: Milena Davydov's operation runs on a schedule Lesya Ilić provides: patrols that turn a street early, raids announced a day in advance. In public the two exchange formal nods.
relationships.tension: An honest sergeant has been transferred into Lesya Ilić's command. Both parties consider this a problem.

relationships.description: Milena Davydov and Artem Krylov trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Milena Davydov has asked Artem Krylov for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Milena Davydov's clearance record looks respectable because Guido Davydov decides which crimes get cleared. The price of the arrangement is itemised and paid on time.
relationships.tension: The payments have started arriving late. In this trade, late is a message.

relationships.description: Stoycho Golubev controls a vote Zorana Popov needs, and Zorana Popov controls a supply Stoycho Golubev needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Zorana Popov has found a new source for what Stoycho Golubev supplies. Stoycho Golubev has not been told.

relationships.description: Stoycho Golubev and Milena Davydov each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Milena Davydov needs from Stoycho Golubev comes up next week, and Stoycho Golubev has named a new price.

relationships.description: Mirjana Solovyov and Gordanka Kiselev bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Mirjana Solovyov has hired away Gordanka Kiselev's best assistant. Gordanka Kiselev has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Stoycho Golubev needs Mirjana Solovyov's seal on certain papers; Mirjana Solovyov needs Stoycho Golubev's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Mirjana Solovyov's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Stoycho Golubev holds nothing over Mirjana Solovyov.

relationships.description: The alliance between Mirjana Solovyov and Lesya Ilić was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Mirjana Solovyov has taken a precaution against Lesya Ilić that Lesya Ilić was not meant to discover. Lesya Ilić has discovered it.

relationships.description: Xeno Lebedev and Jordanka Frolov sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Jordanka Frolov has written down what Xeno Lebedev owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Xeno Lebedev and Zorana Popov share a family and avoid sharing anything else; every professional dealing between them is conducted as though the relation were a rumour.
relationships.tension: The family has taken a side in a dispute between them. It is the wrong side, in both their opinions.

relationships.description: Xeno Lebedev and Olivera Karpov share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Olivera Karpov has been dining with Xeno Lebedev's rivals. Xeno Lebedev heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Olia Dmitriev owes Zorana Popov a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Olia Dmitriev has started repaying the debt in coin. Zorana Popov wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Olia Dmitriev testified against Olivera Karpov in a case ten years ago. Olivera Karpov lost a fortune and has not spoken to Olia Dmitriev since.
relationships.tension: Olivera Karpov has been appointed to judge a case in which Olia Dmitriev is a party.

relationships.description: Gordanka Kiselev and Guido Davydov back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Gordanka Kiselev wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Guido Davydov thinks the newcomer would take Guido Davydov's place.

relationships.description: Stoycho Golubev needs Gordanka Kiselev's seal on certain papers; Gordanka Kiselev needs Stoycho Golubev's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Gordanka Kiselev's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Stoycho Golubev holds nothing over Gordanka Kiselev.

relationships.description: Artem Krylov and Stoycho Golubev sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Stoycho Golubev has written down what Artem Krylov owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Artem Krylov and Zorana Popov deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Zorana Popov has recently secured something that makes Artem Krylov's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Artem Krylov and Xeno Lebedev trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Artem Krylov has asked Xeno Lebedev for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Artem Klimov brings the votes and Bozhidar Lukić brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Bozhidar Lukić voted against Artem Klimov on a small matter last week. Artem Klimov is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Artem Klimov and Evgeny Loginov signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Artem Klimov and Evgeny Loginov both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Guido Davydov took the post Jordanka Frolov had been promised. Jordanka Frolov has treated Guido Davydov as an enemy from that day.
relationships.tension: Jordanka Frolov has found the document that proves what Guido Davydov did, and has kept it locked away.

relationships.description: Jordanka Frolov and Olivera Karpov are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Olivera Karpov has asked Jordanka Frolov to back a candidate Jordanka Frolov distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Jordanka Frolov married into Lesya Ilić's family. Lesya Ilić opposed the match and still calls Jordanka Frolov by surname.
relationships.tension: Jordanka Frolov's child wants to marry into Lesya Ilić's household. Neither parent has given an answer.

relationships.description: Uljana Loginov and Bozhidar Lukić trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Uljana Loginov or Bozhidar Lukić can fill it.

relationships.description: Uljana Loginov takes Milena Davydov's silver every quarter day and keeps certain doors unwatched in return. Each treats the other as a reliable colleague.
relationships.tension: Uljana Loginov was promoted last month, and Milena Davydov expects the price of silence to stay the same. Uljana Loginov does not.

relationships.description: Artem Krylov's people are never searched on Uljana Loginov's watch. The arrangement is three years old and has never been put in writing.
relationships.tension: One of Artem Krylov's runners was arrested by a patrol Uljana Loginov did not assign. The runner knows both their names.

npcs.name: Jagannath Das
npcs.title: Vaidya

personality.tell: never eats or drinks anything offered by a stranger without watching others first

relationships.description: What Ganga Basu knows, Tukaram Choudhry taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Tukaram Choudhry, quietly, whether Ganga Basu can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Tukaram Choudhry took Vinod Dutta in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Vinod Dutta has taken on a client Tukaram Choudhry turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Naresh Bhat learned the work at Tukaram Choudhry's side for seven years. Half of Naresh Bhat's clients first came through Tukaram Choudhry's door.
relationships.tension: Tukaram Choudhry has taken a new apprentice, and Naresh Bhat has heard the apprentice is being taught things Naresh Bhat never was.

relationships.description: Naresh Bhat once told the council that Jagannath Das was right and Naresh Bhat was wrong. Jagannath Das has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Jagannath Das has made a mistake that Naresh Bhat is bound to report. Naresh Bhat has not reported it.

relationships.description: Jagannath Das and Ganga Basu consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Jagannath Das and Ganga Basu to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Naresh Bhat and Ganga Basu fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Ganga Basu's face.
relationships.tension: Naresh Bhat has learned that Ganga Basu is in debt and could be ruined by one call on a loan.

relationships.description: Naresh Bhat and Vinod Dutta sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Vinod Dutta has written down what Naresh Bhat owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Ganga Basu brings the votes and Supriya Chatterjee brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Supriya Chatterjee voted against Ganga Basu on a small matter last week. Ganga Basu is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Ganga Basu borrowed Vinod Dutta's good name to win a post. Vinod Dutta has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Vinod Dutta has fallen on hard times, and the debt Ganga Basu owes is now the only asset Vinod Dutta has.

relationships.description: Supriya Chatterjee and Vinod Dutta bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Supriya Chatterjee has hired away Vinod Dutta's best assistant. Vinod Dutta has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Supriya Chatterjee and Naresh Bhat share a family and avoid sharing anything else; every professional dealing between them is conducted as though the relation were a rumour.
relationships.tension: The family has taken a side in a dispute between them. It is the wrong side, in both their opinions.

relationships.description: Vinod Dutta vouched for Jagannath Das when nobody else would. Jagannath Das's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Jagannath Das corrected Vinod Dutta in public last month, and was right.

goal.short: Use current stability to address structural vulnerabilities before conditions change.

secret.stakes: It was not nothing. And now they've waited too long to raise it without explaining why they waited

presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds governing authority in a settlement with functional legitimacy. The position is secure enough to act from rather than defend.
npcs.activeConstraint: Stability reduces the sense of urgency that would justify the resources and disruption required to address those vulnerabilities.

personality.tell: traces patterns on flat surfaces absentmindedly

physical.feature: a ring on every finger

secret.stakes: The silence feels like patience rather than forgiveness

npcs.title: Nazir

personality.speech: Prefaces bad news with elaborate courtesy, good news with none

secret.stakes: Possession is heresy; surrender means explaining how they had it

A valuable item came through their network recently. Three different parties have asked about it quietly.

presentation.impression: Cautious with newcomers. The wariness is professional rather than personal.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

relationships.description: Latif ibn Tufayl controls the watch's pay and Lubna ibn Khaldun controls its swords. Each uses their half to bargain for the other's.
relationships.tension: Latif ibn Tufayl has cut the watch's pay to fund the market repairs. Lubna ibn Khaldun has told the watchmen who signed the order.

relationships.description: Aziz ibn Rushd stands where Latif ibn Tufayl put them, by a ladder Latif ibn Tufayl built and Aziz ibn Rushd has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Latif ibn Tufayl has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Aziz ibn Rushd knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: What Safiya ibn Ali knows, Latif ibn Tufayl taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Latif ibn Tufayl, quietly, whether Safiya ibn Ali can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Lubna ibn Khaldun has closed three of Safiya ibn Ali's houses this year. Safiya ibn Ali has opened four.
relationships.tension: Lubna ibn Khaldun has a witness willing to name Safiya ibn Ali before a magistrate. Safiya ibn Ali knows where the witness lives.

relationships.description: Lubna ibn Khaldun wants Taha ibn Rashid in a cell and has said so before the council. Taha ibn Rashid has answered by paying two of Lubna ibn Khaldun's informants.
relationships.tension: Taha ibn Rashid has offered Lubna ibn Khaldun a truce and a purse. Lubna ibn Khaldun has not answered, which Taha ibn Rashid counts as progress.

relationships.description: Yahya al-Rashidi owes Latif ibn Tufayl something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Latif ibn Tufayl is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Yahya al-Rashidi and Tamim al-Wahabi trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Yahya al-Rashidi has asked Tamim al-Wahabi for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: The alliance between Yahya al-Rashidi and Safiya ibn Ali was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Yahya al-Rashidi has taken a precaution against Safiya ibn Ali that Safiya ibn Ali was not meant to discover. Safiya ibn Ali has discovered it.

relationships.description: Every advance Tamim al-Wahabi makes is answered by Aziz ibn Rushd within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Tamim al-Wahabi and Safiya ibn Ali share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Safiya ibn Ali has been dining with Tamim al-Wahabi's rivals. Tamim al-Wahabi heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Years ago Taha ibn Rashid did for Tamim al-Wahabi the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Tamim al-Wahabi has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Tamim al-Wahabi has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Taha ibn Rashid does not.

relationships.description: Aziz ibn Rushd and Safiya ibn Ali back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Aziz ibn Rushd wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Safiya ibn Ali thinks the newcomer would take Safiya ibn Ali's place.

relationships.description: Aziz ibn Rushd and Taha ibn Rashid bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Aziz ibn Rushd has hired away Taha ibn Rashid's best assistant. Taha ibn Rashid has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Safiya ibn Ali and Taha ibn Rashid trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Safiya ibn Ali or Taha ibn Rashid can fill it.

relationships.description: Taha ibn Rashid controls a vote Yahya al-Rashidi needs, and Yahya al-Rashidi controls a supply Taha ibn Rashid needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Yahya al-Rashidi has found a new source for what Taha ibn Rashid supplies. Taha ibn Rashid has not been told.

relationships.description: Damir Vinogradov and Anna Denisov each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Anna Denisov needs from Damir Vinogradov comes up next week, and Damir Vinogradov has named a new price.

relationships.description: Damir Vinogradov and Predojka Lebedev compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Dobroslav Marković and Damir Vinogradov signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Dobroslav Marković and Damir Vinogradov both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Dobroslav Marković and Anna Denisov disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Dobroslav Marković and Predojka Lebedev want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Damir Vinogradov needs Uglješa Andreyev's seal on certain papers; Uglješa Andreyev needs Damir Vinogradov's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Uglješa Andreyev's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Damir Vinogradov holds nothing over Uglješa Andreyev.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Uglješa Andreyev and Cveta Babić, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Every advance Uglješa Andreyev makes is answered by Darya Komarov within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Egor Nikolić and Nikoleta Gusev are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Nikoleta Gusev has asked Egor Nikolić to back a candidate Egor Nikolić distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Egor Nikolić and Gordana Morozov sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Gordana Morozov has written down what Egor Nikolić owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Nikoleta Gusev sends difficult cases to Gordana Morozov, and Gordana Morozov sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Nikoleta Gusev has learned something about Gordana Morozov's family that Gordana Morozov does not know.

relationships.description: Nikoleta Gusev is godparent to Darya Komarov's eldest child. The tie was made before their careers set them against each other.
relationships.tension: The family has asked Nikoleta Gusev and Darya Komarov to end their quarrel before the next feast. Neither will apologise first.

relationships.description: Teodora Fedorov nursed Nikoleta Gusev through a winter fever when no one else would come. Nikoleta Gusev still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Nikoleta Gusev has refused Teodora Fedorov a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Predojka Lebedev and Anna Denisov work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Predojka Lebedev borrowed Darya Komarov's good name to win a post. Darya Komarov has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Darya Komarov has fallen on hard times, and the debt Predojka Lebedev owes is now the only asset Darya Komarov has.

relationships.description: Cveta Babić owes Darya Komarov something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Darya Komarov is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Cveta Babić and Teodora Fedorov are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Cveta Babić and Egor Nikolić bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Cveta Babić has hired away Egor Nikolić's best assistant. Egor Nikolić has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Darya Komarov and Teodora Fedorov each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Darya Komarov and Dobroslav Marković have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Dobroslav Marković has been offered Darya Komarov's post by people who want Darya Komarov gone.

relationships.description: Zdravko Dmitriev once told the council that Boris Ivanov was right and Zdravko Dmitriev was wrong. Boris Ivanov has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Boris Ivanov has made a mistake that Zdravko Dmitriev is bound to report. Zdravko Dmitriev has not reported it.

relationships.description: Boris Ivanov and Danica Lebedev trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Boris Ivanov or Danica Lebedev can fill it.

relationships.description: Zdravko Dmitriev and Danica Lebedev are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: What Zdravko Dmitriev knows would ruin Nikoleta Gusev; what Nikoleta Gusev holds would finish Zdravko Dmitriev. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Zdravko Dmitriev and Ctirad Medvedev deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Ctirad Medvedev has recently secured something that makes Zdravko Dmitriev's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: The alliance between Teodora Fedorov and Egor Nikolić was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Teodora Fedorov has taken a precaution against Egor Nikolić that Egor Nikolić was not meant to discover. Egor Nikolić has discovered it.

relationships.description: Blood ties Teodora Fedorov to Uglješa Andreyev in a way that neither career can afford; they meet at funerals and weddings and pretend the rest of the year does not exist.
relationships.tension: A younger relative has begun trading on the connection both of them refuse to use.

relationships.description: Ctirad Medvedev and Egor Nikolić trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Ctirad Medvedev has asked Egor Nikolić for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Ctirad Medvedev controls a vote Darya Komarov needs, and Darya Komarov controls a supply Ctirad Medvedev needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Darya Komarov has found a new source for what Ctirad Medvedev supplies. Ctirad Medvedev has not been told.

relationships.description: Anna Denisov and Uglješa Andreyev share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Uglješa Andreyev has been dining with Anna Denisov's rivals. Anna Denisov heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Years ago Cveta Babić did for Anna Denisov the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Anna Denisov has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Anna Denisov has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Cveta Babić does not.

relationships.description: Darya Komarov still uses Anna Denisov's methods and Anna Denisov's ledger format. Everyone who sees Darya Komarov's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Anna Denisov has asked Darya Komarov for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Danica Lebedev named Egor Nikolić as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Egor Nikolić has begun teaching Danica Lebedev's methods as Egor Nikolić's own.

relationships.description: Danica Lebedev and Cveta Babić share a family and avoid sharing anything else; every professional dealing between them is conducted as though the relation were a rumour.
relationships.tension: The family has taken a side in a dispute between them. It is the wrong side, in both their opinions.

relationships.description: Gordana Morozov and Cveta Babić trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Gordana Morozov has asked Cveta Babić for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Gordana Morozov controls a vote Ctirad Medvedev needs, and Ctirad Medvedev controls a supply Gordana Morozov needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Ctirad Medvedev has found a new source for what Gordana Morozov supplies. Gordana Morozov has not been told.

presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Muirenn MacTaggart
members.title: Craftmaster

personality.tell: taps their foot in a complex rhythm when bored
personality.speech: Speaks in short, clipped sentences: every word intentional

physical.feature: teeth that have been replaced with metal
physical.clothes: a good coat inherited from a larger relative

goal.short: Figure out what is actually going on before it affects them directly
goal.long: Matter to the people immediately around them: small scale, real

secret.what: Was captured and released under terms they have never disclosed
secret.stakes: The terms may mean they owe something to an enemy that they haven't paid yet

plotHooks: Their predecessor left something behind (in a place where it shouldn't have been), and they haven't reported finding it.
Three different people have asked them the same unusual question. None of them knew each other.

presentation.impression: Reserved. Not hostile, just private.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Aoife Byrne
members.title: Laird

personality.tell: makes deliberate, theatrical eye contact to assert dominance
personality.speech: Tells anecdotes that never quite reach the point

physical.feature: a ring on every finger
physical.clothes: nondescript working clothes chosen specifically to be forgettable

goal.short: Find who betrayed them before they do it again
goal.long: Accumulate enough to make legitimacy a choice rather than an aspiration

secret.what: Has been delaying vital information from reaching the decision-makers
secret.stakes: When the consequences emerge, the delay will be investigated and traced

plotHooks: Someone tried to rob one of their fronts. The attempt was professional. That's more worrying than amateur.
One of their most reliable suppliers has gone dark. The goods are still arriving. Someone else is sending them.

presentation.impression: Unremarkable, deliberately. The kind of person you would walk past twice.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Aoife O'Halloran
members.title: Craftmaster

personality.tell: refuses to sit with their back to a door
personality.speech: Addresses strangers formally and familiars by diminutives

physical.feature: close-cropped hair
physical.clothes: travel-worn but well-maintained gear

plotHooks: They have evidence of price-fixing across the whole market. Publishing it helps their competition as much as their customers.

presentation.impression: Tired, but alert. The combination of someone who works hard and pays attention.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Aisling Roche
members.title: Agent

personality.tell: never eats or drinks anything offered by a stranger without watching others first
personality.speech: Peppers speech with trade or craft jargon even in unrelated contexts

physical.feature: a habit of standing very still
physical.clothes: weathered gear maintained past the point of economy

goal.short: Get through this particular difficulty without it becoming a catastrophe
goal.long: Build enough stability that they have choices

secret.what: On the payroll of the thieves' guild as a silent informant
secret.stakes: Exposure would cost them their post and likely their safety

plotHooks: A valuable cargo was reported lost on the road. The manifest has reappeared in a market two settlements away.

presentation.impression: Reserved. Not hostile, just private.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Eoghan Clifford
members.title: Noble

personality.tell: never makes direct eye contact with inferiors
personality.speech: Speaks softly, forcing others to lean in

physical.feature: a slight accent
physical.clothes: expensive but conservative merchant dress

secret.what: Was directly responsible for a death that was ruled an accident
secret.stakes: Criminal liability and the complete destruction of their reputation

plotHooks: A merchant they publicly opposed is now publicly supporting them. No explanation offered.
One of their staff has started asking questions about records from seven years ago. They've been reassigned twice already.

presentation.impression: Warmer than their office suggests. They have the gift of making people feel briefly important.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Pól MacKenzie
members.title: Elder

personality.tell: laughs loudly at their own jokes, silently at others'
personality.speech: Deflects personal questions with philosophical tangents

physical.feature: close-cropped hair
physical.clothes: court attire with discreet personal touches

goal.short: Expose a colleague's corruption without implicating themselves
goal.long: Champion a reform that future councils will still cite by name

secret.what: Their legitimate business is a front for moving contraband
secret.stakes: Seizure of everything; the legitimacy is thin and investigators are circling

plotHooks: Someone who publicly supports them is being paid by someone who opposes them. They know this.

presentation.impression: Efficient, slightly distracted: someone with too many things in their head and a practised way of not showing it.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Fionnuala MacRae
members.title: Druid

personality.speech: Pauses mid-sentence to choose words with visible care

physical.feature: a prosthetic hand, finely crafted
physical.clothes: simple robes of their order

goal.long: Leave a detailed record of the congregation so future priests know who this community was

secret.what: Has been slowly poisoning a rival with something that looks like natural illness

members.title: Moneykeeper

personality.speech: Trails off mid-sentence when approaching something they regret knowing

presentation.impression: Friendly, easy, slightly too interested in where you're from.

relationships.description: The alliance between Una Thornton and Nóinín Erskine was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Una Thornton has taken a precaution against Nóinín Erskine that Nóinín Erskine was not meant to discover. Nóinín Erskine has discovered it.

relationships.description: Una Thornton trusts Fionnuala MacRae's word over any written contract. Fionnuala MacRae has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Fionnuala MacRae has publicly backed a plan that Una Thornton thinks will fail. Una Thornton has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Years ago Killian Johnston did for Una Thornton the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Una Thornton has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Una Thornton has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Killian Johnston does not.

relationships.description: Moira Lamont and Ciarán Tobin each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: The line between Moira Lamont's authority and Barra Ryan's has been redrawn four times and honoured never. Each keeps the map that favours them.
relationships.tension: Barra Ryan has begun drilling in the square without asking. Moira Lamont has begun writing letters to the capital.

relationships.description: Nóinín Erskine and Fionnuala MacRae share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Fionnuala MacRae has been dining with Nóinín Erskine's rivals. Nóinín Erskine heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Nóinín Erskine is godparent to Cael MacIntyre's eldest child. The tie was made before their careers set them against each other.
relationships.tension: The family has asked Nóinín Erskine and Cael MacIntyre to end their quarrel before the next feast. Neither will apologise first.

relationships.description: Eoghan Clifford stands where Nóinín Erskine put them, by a ladder Nóinín Erskine built and Eoghan Clifford has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Nóinín Erskine has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Eoghan Clifford knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Every advance Fódla Clifford makes is answered by Maolmhuire MacDonald within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: What Fódla Clifford knows would ruin Peig O'Donnell; what Peig O'Donnell holds would finish Fódla Clifford. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Fódla Clifford and Dáirine O'Gorman bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Fódla Clifford has hired away Dáirine O'Gorman's best assistant. Dáirine O'Gorman has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) blames Peig O'Donnell for a death in Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master)'s family. Peig O'Donnell has never denied it.
relationships.tension: Peig O'Donnell's child has asked to apprentice with Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master). Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) has not refused.

relationships.description: Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) and Garbhán Walsh have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Ide MacAlister and Aisling Roche trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Ide MacAlister or Aisling Roche can fill it.

relationships.description: Between Ide MacAlister and Dáirine Gordon stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Maolmhuire MacDonald and Peig O'Donnell are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: Maolmhuire MacDonald wants Dáirine O'Gorman's position, and Dáirine O'Gorman wants Maolmhuire MacDonald's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Dáirine O'Gorman has been telling clients that Maolmhuire MacDonald's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Maolmhuire MacDonald.

relationships.description: Every client Maolmhuire MacDonald wins is one Tadhg Flaherty lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Maolmhuire MacDonald and Tadhg Flaherty will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: What Killian Johnston knows, Barra Ryan taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Barra Ryan, quietly, whether Killian Johnston can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Barra Ryan and Eoghan Clifford back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Barra Ryan wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Eoghan Clifford thinks the newcomer would take Eoghan Clifford's place.

relationships.description: Barra Ryan and Fódla Clifford deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Fódla Clifford has recently secured something that makes Barra Ryan's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Ériu MacAlister controls the garrison's pay and Una Thornton controls its swords. Each uses their half to bargain for the other's.
relationships.tension: Ériu MacAlister has cut the garrison's pay to fund the market repairs. Una Thornton has told the soldiers who signed the order.

relationships.description: Ciarán Tobin paid Ériu MacAlister's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Ériu MacAlister mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Ciarán Tobin has asked Ériu MacAlister for a vote against Ériu MacAlister's own interests. It is the first payment Ciarán Tobin has asked for.

relationships.description: Ériu MacAlister brings the votes and Barra Ryan brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Barra Ryan voted against Ériu MacAlister on a small matter last week. Ériu MacAlister is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Barra Ryan reports to Ciarán Tobin on paper and to no one in practice. Ciarán Tobin has three letters of complaint unanswered.
relationships.tension: Barra Ryan arrested a councillor's son without Ciarán Tobin's warrant. Ciarán Tobin has demanded his release by tomorrow.

relationships.description: Ciarán Tobin has closed three of Aoife Byrne's houses this year. Aoife Byrne has opened four.
relationships.tension: Ciarán Tobin has a witness willing to name Aoife Byrne before a magistrate. Aoife Byrne knows where the witness lives.

relationships.description: Killian Johnston and Eoghan Clifford are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Killian Johnston lost the last contract to Eoghan Clifford by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Killian Johnston and Moira Lamont disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Killian Johnston and Fódla Clifford trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Killian Johnston has asked Fódla Clifford for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Peig O'Donnell and Dáirine O'Gorman fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Dáirine O'Gorman's face.
relationships.tension: Peig O'Donnell has learned that Dáirine O'Gorman is in debt and could be ruined by one call on a loan.

relationships.description: Peig O'Donnell and Garbhán Walsh signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Peig O'Donnell and Garbhán Walsh both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Muirenn MacTaggart controls a vote Moira Lamont needs, and Moira Lamont controls a supply Muirenn MacTaggart needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Moira Lamont has found a new source for what Muirenn MacTaggart supplies. Muirenn MacTaggart has not been told.

relationships.description: Muirenn MacTaggart and Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) has asked Muirenn MacTaggart to back a candidate Muirenn MacTaggart distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Muirenn MacTaggart and Ide MacAlister work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Dáirine O'Gorman and Tadhg Flaherty each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Tadhg Flaherty needs from Dáirine O'Gorman comes up next week, and Dáirine O'Gorman has named a new price.

relationships.description: Dáirine O'Gorman and Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Tadhg Flaherty needs Garbhán Walsh's seal on certain papers; Garbhán Walsh needs Tadhg Flaherty's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Garbhán Walsh's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Tadhg Flaherty holds nothing over Garbhán Walsh.

relationships.description: Garbhán Walsh owes Honor Quinn a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Garbhán Walsh has started repaying the debt in coin. Honor Quinn wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Garbhán Walsh and Fódla Clifford sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Fódla Clifford has written down what Garbhán Walsh owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Cael MacIntyre and Barra Ryan are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Cael MacIntyre and Killian Johnston want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Cael MacIntyre and Pól MacKenzie bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Cael MacIntyre has hired away Pól MacKenzie's best assistant. Pól MacKenzie has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Aoife Byrne and Rónán O'Connor trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Aoife Byrne or Rónán O'Connor can fill it.

relationships.description: Blood ties Aoife Byrne to Teamhair Colquhoun (Assassin Guildmaster) in a way that neither career can afford; they meet at funerals and weddings and pretend the rest of the year does not exist.
relationships.tension: A younger relative has begun trading on the connection both of them refuse to use.

relationships.description: Aoife Byrne wants Moira Lamont in a cell and has said so before the council. Moira Lamont has answered by paying two of Aoife Byrne's informants.
relationships.tension: Moira Lamont has offered Aoife Byrne a truce and a purse. Aoife Byrne has not answered, which Moira Lamont counts as progress.

relationships.description: Rónán O'Connor controls a vote Teamhair Colquhoun (Assassin Guildmaster) needs, and Teamhair Colquhoun (Assassin Guildmaster) controls a supply Rónán O'Connor needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Teamhair Colquhoun (Assassin Guildmaster) has found a new source for what Rónán O'Connor supplies. Rónán O'Connor has not been told.

relationships.description: Rónán O'Connor and Peig O'Donnell each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Peig O'Donnell needs from Rónán O'Connor comes up next week, and Rónán O'Connor has named a new price.

relationships.description: Rónán O'Connor wants Garbhán Walsh's position, and Garbhán Walsh wants Rónán O'Connor's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Garbhán Walsh has been telling clients that Rónán O'Connor's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Rónán O'Connor.

relationships.description: Every client Aisling Roche wins is one Dáirine Gordon lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Aisling Roche and Dáirine Gordon will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Aisling Roche and Aoife O'Halloran are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Aisling Roche lost the last contract to Aoife O'Halloran by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Fódla Clifford needs Tadhg Flaherty's seal on certain papers; Tadhg Flaherty needs Fódla Clifford's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Tadhg Flaherty's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Fódla Clifford holds nothing over Tadhg Flaherty.

relationships.description: Tadhg Flaherty and Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Tadhg Flaherty has hired away Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master)'s best assistant. Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Tadhg Flaherty and Peig O'Donnell signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Tadhg Flaherty and Peig O'Donnell both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Dáirine Gordon and Aoife O'Halloran trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Dáirine Gordon or Aoife O'Halloran can fill it.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Dáirine Gordon and Barra Ryan, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Something happened between Dáirine Gordon and Peig O'Donnell years ago that neither has forgotten. They function professionally. They do not forgive.
relationships.tension: The circumstances that caused the original rupture are repeating. Both of them know it.

relationships.description: Honor Quinn and Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) has written down what Honor Quinn owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Honor Quinn wants Peig O'Donnell's position, and Peig O'Donnell wants Honor Quinn's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Peig O'Donnell has been telling clients that Honor Quinn's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Honor Quinn.

relationships.description: Pól MacKenzie kept Eoghan Clifford's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Eoghan Clifford has voted with Pól MacKenzie ever since.
relationships.tension: Pól MacKenzie has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Eoghan Clifford's partners.

relationships.description: Eoghan Clifford wants the watch under civil command; Moira Lamont wants the council out of the barracks. They meet monthly and settle nothing.
relationships.tension: Eoghan Clifford has asked the capital to replace Moira Lamont. Moira Lamont has asked the capital to dissolve Eoghan Clifford's council.

relationships.description: Eoghan Clifford and Ciarán Tobin are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Ciarán Tobin has asked Eoghan Clifford to back a candidate Eoghan Clifford distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Ériu MacAlister's people know Finnuala Forbes's patrol routes by heart, and Finnuala Forbes's people know which taverns Ériu MacAlister uses. Neither side has made the arrest that counts.
relationships.tension: Finnuala Forbes's best informant inside Ériu MacAlister's crew has stopped reporting. Nobody has seen the informant for nine days.

relationships.description: Aoife Byrne nursed Finnuala Forbes through a winter fever when no one else would come. Finnuala Forbes still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Finnuala Forbes has refused Aoife Byrne a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Finnuala Forbes borrowed Rónán O'Connor's good name to win a post. Rónán O'Connor has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Rónán O'Connor has fallen on hard times, and the debt Finnuala Forbes owes is now the only asset Rónán O'Connor has.

relationships.description: Every client Pól MacKenzie wins is one Barra Ryan lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Pól MacKenzie and Barra Ryan will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.tension: Pól MacKenzie has taken a precaution against Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) that Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) was not meant to discover. Teamhair Colquhoun (Guild Master) has discovered it.

relationships.description: Pól MacKenzie sets the curfew and Ciarán Tobin decides whether to enforce it. The two have not agreed on a curfew in a year.
relationships.tension: A riot is expected on the next market day, and Pól MacKenzie and Ciarán Tobin have issued opposite orders for it.

relationships.description: Fionnuala MacRae and Pól MacKenzie are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Fionnuala MacRae lost the last contract to Pól MacKenzie by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Fionnuala MacRae took Barra Ryan in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Barra Ryan has taken on a client Fionnuala MacRae turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Killian Johnston learned the work at Fionnuala MacRae's side for seven years. Half of Killian Johnston's clients first came through Fionnuala MacRae's door.
relationships.tension: Fionnuala MacRae has taken a new apprentice, and Killian Johnston has heard the apprentice is being taught things Killian Johnston never was.

relationships.description: Teamhair Colquhoun (Assassin Guildmaster) and Moira Lamont are open enemies. Every raid Teamhair Colquhoun (Assassin Guildmaster) orders costs Moira Lamont money, and every month Moira Lamont survives costs Teamhair Colquhoun (Assassin Guildmaster) standing.
relationships.tension: Moira Lamont has hired an advocate to sue Teamhair Colquhoun (Assassin Guildmaster) over the last raid. The case comes before the council this season.

relationships.description: Teamhair Colquhoun (Assassin Guildmaster) and Fódla Clifford deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Fódla Clifford has recently secured something that makes Teamhair Colquhoun (Assassin Guildmaster)'s hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Aoife O'Halloran and Ide MacAlister bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Aoife O'Halloran has hired away Ide MacAlister's best assistant. Ide MacAlister has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Aoife O'Halloran vouched for Barra Ryan when nobody else would. Barra Ryan's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Barra Ryan corrected Aoife O'Halloran in public last month, and was right.

npcs.name: Statius Varro
npcs.title: Elder

personality.tell: never makes direct eye contact with inferiors
personality.speech: Drops to a near-whisper when saying something important

physical.feature: surprisingly soft hands
physical.clothes: work clothes patched by someone who loved them

goal.short: Maintain traditional standing within the constraints that stable institutional competition creates.
goal.long: Come out of this with their office (or a better one) intact

secret.what: Owes Octavius Aurelius a debt from before either of them held their current position: one that Octavius Aurelius has never formally called in

relationships.description: Estrid Ragnarsson and Geira Ljotsson disagree fundamentally about where civil authority ends and military authority begins. The argument has been running for years and occasionally generates paperwork.
relationships.tension: An incident is coming that will force the issue. Both are positioning for it.

relationships.description: Estrid Ragnarsson named Thorkel Andersson as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Thorkel Andersson has begun teaching Estrid Ragnarsson's methods as Thorkel Andersson's own.

relationships.description: Geira Ljotsson and Thorkel Andersson are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Geira Ljotsson lost the last contract to Thorkel Andersson by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Geira Ljotsson shaped Hrolf Haraldsson's career in ways that Hrolf Haraldsson has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Hrolf Haraldsson now operates in ways Geira Ljotsson would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Jörunnaek Gunnarsson trusts Thorkel Andersson's word over any written contract. Thorkel Andersson has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Thorkel Andersson has publicly backed a plan that Jörunnaek Gunnarsson thinks will fail. Jörunnaek Gunnarsson has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Jörunnaek Gunnarsson owes Hrolf Haraldsson something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Hrolf Haraldsson is about to call it in.

relationships.description: The alliance between Thorkel Andersson and Hrolf Haraldsson was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Thorkel Andersson has taken a precaution against Hrolf Haraldsson that Hrolf Haraldsson was not meant to discover. Hrolf Haraldsson has discovered it.

relationships.description: Years ago Estrid Ragnarsson did for Hrolf Haraldsson the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Hrolf Haraldsson has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Hrolf Haraldsson has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Estrid Ragnarsson does not.
