relationships.description: Chrysoberge Chrysoberges and Aikaterine Kataphloron compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Years ago Zournaras Dalassenos did for Chrysoberge Chrysoberges the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Chrysoberge Chrysoberges has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Chrysoberge Chrysoberges has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Zournaras Dalassenos does not.

relationships.description: Between Chrysoberge Chrysoberges and Basilissa Choniates stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Aikaterine Kataphloron and Basileios Gregoraios are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Basileios Gregoraios has asked Aikaterine Kataphloron to back a candidate Aikaterine Kataphloron distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Vranas Makrembolites took the post Aikaterine Kataphloron had been promised. Aikaterine Kataphloron has treated Vranas Makrembolites as an enemy from that day.
relationships.tension: Aikaterine Kataphloron has found the document that proves what Vranas Makrembolites did, and has kept it locked away.

relationships.description: Zournaras Dalassenos and Vranas Makrembolites want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Basileios Gregoraios paid Zournaras Dalassenos's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Zournaras Dalassenos mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Basileios Gregoraios has asked Zournaras Dalassenos for a vote against Zournaras Dalassenos's own interests. It is the first payment Basileios Gregoraios has asked for.

relationships.description: Zournaras Dalassenos owes Aikaterine Kataphloron a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Zournaras Dalassenos has started repaying the debt in coin. Aikaterine Kataphloron wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Vranas Makrembolites and Chrysoberge Chrysoberges deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Chrysoberge Chrysoberges has recently secured something that makes Vranas Makrembolites's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Basileios Gregoraios and Basilissa Choniates trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Basileios Gregoraios has asked Basilissa Choniates for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Vranas Makrembolites kept Basileios Gregoraios's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Basileios Gregoraios has voted with Vranas Makrembolites ever since.
relationships.tension: Vranas Makrembolites has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Basileios Gregoraios's partners.

relationships.description: Basilissa Choniates controls a vote Zournaras Dalassenos needs, and Zournaras Dalassenos controls a supply Basilissa Choniates needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Zournaras Dalassenos has found a new source for what Basilissa Choniates supplies. Basilissa Choniates has not been told.

relationships.description: Basilissa Choniates named Aikaterine Kataphloron as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Aikaterine Kataphloron has begun teaching Basilissa Choniates's methods as Aikaterine Kataphloron's own.

relationships.description: Moritz Krause and Simon Krause deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Simon Krause has recently secured something that makes Moritz Krause's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Moritz Krause and Eadgyth Wirth disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Every client Moritz Krause wins is one Luise Pfeiffer lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Moritz Krause and Luise Pfeiffer will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Wendelin Keller and Moritz Krause, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Wendelin Keller and Simon Krause are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Wendelin Keller lost the last contract to Simon Krause by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Wendelin Keller sends difficult cases to Wicher Wagner, and Wicher Wagner sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Wendelin Keller has learned something about Wicher Wagner's family that Wicher Wagner does not know.

relationships.description: Wendelgard Uhl and Anna Dietrich have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Anna Dietrich has been offered Wendelgard Uhl's post by people who want Wendelgard Uhl gone.

relationships.description: Wendelgard Uhl and Luise Pfeiffer are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: The alliance between Volker Pfaff and Felix Schröder was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Volker Pfaff has taken a precaution against Felix Schröder that Felix Schröder was not meant to discover. Felix Schröder has discovered it.

relationships.description: Volker Pfaff and Ingrid Schwarz trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Volker Pfaff has asked Ingrid Schwarz for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Years ago Gunter Steiner did for Volker Pfaff the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Volker Pfaff has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Volker Pfaff has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Gunter Steiner does not.

relationships.description: Frieda Schubert controls a vote Mathildis Schmitt needs, and Mathildis Schmitt controls a supply Frieda Schubert needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Mathildis Schmitt has found a new source for what Frieda Schubert supplies. Frieda Schubert has not been told.

relationships.description: Radbot Brauer once told the council that Frieda Schubert was right and Radbot Brauer was wrong. Frieda Schubert has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Frieda Schubert has made a mistake that Radbot Brauer is bound to report. Radbot Brauer has not reported it.

relationships.description: Felix Schröder and Konrad Hartmann consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Felix Schröder and Konrad Hartmann to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Felix Schröder and Ingrid Schwarz compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Between Konrad Hartmann and Ingrid Schwarz stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Konrad Hartmann and Wicher Wagner are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: Wicher Wagner trusts Gunter Steiner's word over any written contract. Gunter Steiner has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Gunter Steiner has publicly backed a plan that Wicher Wagner thinks will fail. Wicher Wagner has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Wicher Wagner and Yohan Jäger each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Yohan Jäger needs from Wicher Wagner comes up next week, and Wicher Wagner has named a new price.

relationships.description: Yohan Jäger paid Gunter Steiner's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Gunter Steiner mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Yohan Jäger has asked Gunter Steiner for a vote against Gunter Steiner's own interests. It is the first payment Yohan Jäger has asked for.

relationships.description: Felix Schröder learned the work at Gunter Steiner's side for seven years. Half of Felix Schröder's clients first came through Gunter Steiner's door.
relationships.tension: Gunter Steiner has taken a new apprentice, and Felix Schröder has heard the apprentice is being taught things Felix Schröder never was.

relationships.description: Gunter Steiner vouched for Wendelgard Uhl when nobody else would. Wendelgard Uhl's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Wendelgard Uhl corrected Gunter Steiner in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Simon Krause needs Eadgyth Wirth's seal on certain papers; Eadgyth Wirth needs Simon Krause's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Eadgyth Wirth's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Simon Krause holds nothing over Eadgyth Wirth.

relationships.description: Eadgyth Wirth owes Wendelgard Uhl a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Eadgyth Wirth has started repaying the debt in coin. Wendelgard Uhl wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Luise Pfeiffer still uses Eadgyth Wirth's methods and Eadgyth Wirth's ledger format. Everyone who sees Luise Pfeiffer's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Eadgyth Wirth has asked Luise Pfeiffer for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Mathildis Schmitt and Radbot Brauer want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Mathildis Schmitt and Volker Pfaff have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Mathildis Schmitt and Konrad Hartmann sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Konrad Hartmann has written down what Mathildis Schmitt owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Luise Pfeiffer and Anna Dietrich share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Anna Dietrich has been dining with Luise Pfeiffer's rivals. Luise Pfeiffer heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Luise Pfeiffer and Simon Krause each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Yohan Jäger and Volker Pfaff consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Yohan Jäger and Volker Pfaff to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Yohan Jäger and Felix Schröder back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Yohan Jäger wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Felix Schröder thinks the newcomer would take Felix Schröder's place.

relationships.description: Berta Wirth kept Radbot Brauer's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Radbot Brauer has voted with Berta Wirth ever since.
relationships.tension: Berta Wirth has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Radbot Brauer's partners.

relationships.description: Every advance Radbot Brauer makes is answered by Konrad Hartmann within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Blood ties Radbot Brauer to Wicher Wagner in a way that neither career can afford; they meet at funerals and weddings and pretend the rest of the year does not exist.
relationships.tension: A younger relative has begun trading on the connection both of them refuse to use.

relationships.description: Wicher Wagner nursed Simon Krause through a winter fever when no one else would come. Simon Krause still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Simon Krause has refused Wicher Wagner a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Simon Krause named Gunter Steiner as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Gunter Steiner has begun teaching Simon Krause's methods as Gunter Steiner's own.

relationships.description: Simon Krause shaped Felix Schröder's career in ways that Felix Schröder has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Felix Schröder now operates in ways Simon Krause would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Berta Wirth and Frieda Schubert bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.

relationships.description: Irini Lekapenos and Athanasia Strategopoulos are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Irini Lekapenos lost the last contract to Athanasia Strategopoulos by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Irini Lekapenos took Katakalon Kontostephanos in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Katakalon Kontostephanos has taken on a client Irini Lekapenos turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Xenophon Chomatenos learned the work at Irini Lekapenos's side for seven years. Half of Xenophon Chomatenos's clients first came through Irini Lekapenos's door.
relationships.tension: Irini Lekapenos has taken a new apprentice, and Xenophon Chomatenos has heard the apprentice is being taught things Xenophon Chomatenos never was.

relationships.description: Raoul Kamytzes warns Kassandra Xiphilinos before every raid and arrests the competitors Kassandra Xiphilinos names. The watch reports show a fine record of arrests.
relationships.tension: Kassandra Xiphilinos has asked Raoul Kamytzes to lose a piece of evidence that three other officers have already seen.

relationships.description: Raoul Kamytzes sends difficult cases to Eirenaion Kurtikios, and Eirenaion Kurtikios sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Raoul Kamytzes has learned something about Eirenaion Kurtikios's family that Eirenaion Kurtikios does not know.

relationships.description: Sarantenos Alexios and Barbara Angelos compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Sarantenos Alexios and Dionysios Tornikios each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Dionysios Tornikios needs from Sarantenos Alexios comes up next week, and Sarantenos Alexios has named a new price.

relationships.description: Sarantenos Alexios owes Eirenaion Kurtikios something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Eirenaion Kurtikios is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Komnenissa Kantakouzenos needs Dionysios Synadenos's seal on certain papers; Dionysios Synadenos needs Komnenissa Kantakouzenos's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Dionysios Synadenos's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Komnenissa Kantakouzenos holds nothing over Dionysios Synadenos.

relationships.description: Dionysios Synadenos vouched for Kassandra Xiphilinos when nobody else would. Kassandra Xiphilinos's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Kassandra Xiphilinos corrected Dionysios Synadenos in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Kassandra Xiphilinos and Eudoxia Vryennios want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: The alliance between Kassandra Xiphilinos and Basilissa Gregoraios was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Kassandra Xiphilinos has taken a precaution against Basilissa Gregoraios that Basilissa Gregoraios was not meant to discover. Basilissa Gregoraios has discovered it.

relationships.description: Kassandra Xiphilinos and Palaiologissa Melas sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Palaiologissa Melas has written down what Kassandra Xiphilinos owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Komnenissa Kantakouzenos and Loudovika Hyaleas have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Loudovika Hyaleas has been offered Komnenissa Kantakouzenos's post by people who want Komnenissa Kantakouzenos gone.

relationships.description: Barbara Angelos once told the council that Komnenissa Kantakouzenos was right and Barbara Angelos was wrong. Komnenissa Kantakouzenos has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Komnenissa Kantakouzenos has made a mistake that Barbara Angelos is bound to report. Barbara Angelos has not reported it.

relationships.description: Years ago Achilles Hexamilites did for Sebastiane Makrembolites the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Sebastiane Makrembolites has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Sebastiane Makrembolites has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Achilles Hexamilites does not.

relationships.description: Every advance Sebastiane Makrembolites makes is answered by Basilissa Gregoraios within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Sebastiane Makrembolites and Xenophon Chomatenos consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Sebastiane Makrembolites and Xenophon Chomatenos to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Between Alexandros Nikerites and Xristos Xiphilinos stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Alexandros Nikerites trusts Kyriake Limniotes's word over any written contract. Kyriake Limniotes has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Kyriake Limniotes has publicly backed a plan that Alexandros Nikerites thinks will fail. Alexandros Nikerites has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Alexandros Nikerites and Philippos Palaiologos share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Philippos Palaiologos has been dining with Alexandros Nikerites's rivals. Alexandros Nikerites heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Achilles Hexamilites and Raoul Kamytzes have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: Achilles Hexamilites and Dionysios Synadenos disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Achilles Hexamilites and Alexandros Nikerites, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Sebastiane Zotikos and Katakalon Kontostephanos each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: Sebastiane Zotikos and Xenophon Chomatenos are cousins on opposite sides of the settlement's politics. Their grandmother still seats them together.
relationships.tension: Xenophon Chomatenos has gone into business against Sebastiane Zotikos's partners, and the family expects Sebastiane Zotikos to keep the peace.

relationships.description: Symeon Photeinopoulos still uses Sebastiane Zotikos's methods and Sebastiane Zotikos's ledger format. Everyone who sees Symeon Photeinopoulos's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Sebastiane Zotikos has asked Symeon Photeinopoulos for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: What Katakalon Kontostephanos knows would ruin Eirenaion Kurtikios; what Eirenaion Kurtikios holds would finish Katakalon Kontostephanos. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Katakalon Kontostephanos and Xenophon Chomatenos bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Katakalon Kontostephanos has hired away Xenophon Chomatenos's best assistant. Xenophon Chomatenos has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Barbara Angelos and Eirenaion Kurtikios back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Barbara Angelos wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Eirenaion Kurtikios thinks the newcomer would take Eirenaion Kurtikios's place.

relationships.description: Barbara Angelos brings the votes and Sofokles Phokas brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Sofokles Phokas voted against Barbara Angelos on a small matter last week. Barbara Angelos is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Athanasia Strategopoulos and Dionysios Tornikios have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Dionysios Tornikios has been offered Athanasia Strategopoulos's post by people who want Athanasia Strategopoulos gone.

relationships.description: Sebastiane Zotikos paid Athanasia Strategopoulos's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Athanasia Strategopoulos mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Sebastiane Zotikos has asked Athanasia Strategopoulos for a vote against Athanasia Strategopoulos's own interests. It is the first payment Sebastiane Zotikos has asked for.

relationships.description: Eudoxia Vryennios and Basilissa Gregoraios trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Eudoxia Vryennios or Basilissa Gregoraios can fill it.

relationships.description: When Raoul Kamytzes's crew needs a prisoner released, Eudoxia Vryennios signs the order. When Eudoxia Vryennios needs an arrest, Raoul Kamytzes supplies the culprit.
relationships.tension: Eudoxia Vryennios's quarter-day payment from Raoul Kamytzes arrived with a name attached: someone Raoul Kamytzes wants arrested.

relationships.description: Dionysios Tornikios named Irini Lekapenos as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Irini Lekapenos has begun teaching Dionysios Tornikios's methods as Irini Lekapenos's own.

relationships.description: Dionysios Tornikios owes Katakalon Kontostephanos a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Dionysios Tornikios has started repaying the debt in coin. Katakalon Kontostephanos wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Isaakios Melas kept Basilissa Gregoraios's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Basilissa Gregoraios has voted with Isaakios Melas ever since.
relationships.tension: Isaakios Melas has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Basilissa Gregoraios's partners.

relationships.description: Basilissa Gregoraios and Palaiologissa Melas signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Basilissa Gregoraios and Palaiologissa Melas both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Sophia Oinaios and Sebastiane Zotikos deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Sebastiane Zotikos has recently secured something that makes Sophia Oinaios's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Sophia Oinaios wants Eirenaion Kurtikios's position, and Eirenaion Kurtikios wants Sophia Oinaios's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Eirenaion Kurtikios has been telling clients that Sophia Oinaios's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Sophia Oinaios.

relationships.description: Eirenaion Kurtikios and Sebastiane Zotikos trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Eirenaion Kurtikios has asked Sebastiane Zotikos for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Eirenaion Kurtikios and Xenophon Chomatenos are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Xenophon Chomatenos has asked Eirenaion Kurtikios to back a candidate Eirenaion Kurtikios distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Sofokles Phokas nursed Eirenaion Kurtikios through a winter fever when no one else would come. Eirenaion Kurtikios still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Eirenaion Kurtikios has refused Sofokles Phokas a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Every client Xenophon Chomatenos wins is one Sofokles Phokas lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Xenophon Chomatenos and Sofokles Phokas will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Xenophon Chomatenos shaped Symeon Photeinopoulos's career in ways that Symeon Photeinopoulos has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Symeon Photeinopoulos now operates in ways Xenophon Chomatenos would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Every client Isaakios Melas wins is one Palaiologissa Melas lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Isaakios Melas and Palaiologissa Melas will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Isaakios Melas controls a vote Kassandra Xiphilinos needs, and Kassandra Xiphilinos controls a supply Isaakios Melas needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Kassandra Xiphilinos has found a new source for what Isaakios Melas supplies. Isaakios Melas has not been told.

relationships.description: Isaakios Melas and Loudovika Hyaleas work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Sofokles Phokas and Sebastiane Zotikos are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Sofokles Phokas lost the last contract to Sebastiane Zotikos by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Sofokles Phokas borrowed Katakalon Kontostephanos's good name to win a post. Katakalon Kontostephanos has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Katakalon Kontostephanos has fallen on hard times, and the debt Sofokles Phokas owes is now the only asset Katakalon Kontostephanos has.

relationships.description: Eudoxia Vryennios nursed Palaiologissa Melas through a winter fever when no one else would come. Palaiologissa Melas still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Palaiologissa Melas has refused Eudoxia Vryennios a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Palaiologissa Melas and Loudovika Hyaleas bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Palaiologissa Melas has hired away Loudovika Hyaleas's best assistant. Loudovika Hyaleas has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Xristos Xiphilinos and Kyriake Limniotes trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Xristos Xiphilinos or Kyriake Limniotes can fill it.

relationships.description: Xristos Xiphilinos and Philippos Palaiologos each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Philippos Palaiologos needs from Xristos Xiphilinos comes up next week, and Xristos Xiphilinos has named a new price.

relationships.description: Apokaukos Niketas needs Xristos Xiphilinos's seal on certain papers; Xristos Xiphilinos needs Apokaukos Niketas's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Xristos Xiphilinos's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Apokaukos Niketas holds nothing over Xristos Xiphilinos.

relationships.description: Katakalon Kontostephanos stands where Symeon Photeinopoulos put them, by a ladder Symeon Photeinopoulos built and Katakalon Kontostephanos has since pulled up. Both remember it differently.
relationships.tension: Symeon Photeinopoulos has one favour left to call in, and is saving it. Katakalon Kontostephanos knows, and is watching for it.

relationships.description: Eirenaion Kurtikios is Symeon Photeinopoulos's half-sibling, raised in the same house and left out of the same will.
relationships.tension: A family property must be sold, and Symeon Photeinopoulos and Eirenaion Kurtikios each want the money for a different purpose.

relationships.description: Apokaukos Niketas and Alexandros Nikerites are in-laws. They are polite at family dinners and avoid each other everywhere else.
relationships.tension: Apokaukos Niketas's rivals have learned that Alexandros Nikerites is family, and have started asking Alexandros Nikerites questions.

relationships.description: Apokaukos Niketas and Kyriake Limniotes are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Melissenos Choniates wants Sebastiane Zotikos's position, and Sebastiane Zotikos wants Melissenos Choniates's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Sebastiane Zotikos has been telling clients that Melissenos Choniates's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Melissenos Choniates.

relationships.description: Melissenos Choniates and Katakalon Kontostephanos sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Katakalon Kontostephanos has written down what Melissenos Choniates owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Melissenos Choniates is godparent to Sofokles Phokas's eldest child. The tie was made before their careers set them against each other.
relationships.tension: The family has asked Melissenos Choniates and Sofokles Phokas to end their quarrel before the next feast. Neither will apologise first.

relationships.description: Dionysios Synadenos once told the council that Loudovika Hyaleas was right and Dionysios Synadenos was wrong. Loudovika Hyaleas has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Loudovika Hyaleas has made a mistake that Dionysios Synadenos is bound to report. Dionysios Synadenos has not reported it.

relationships.description: Loudovika Hyaleas and Basilissa Gregoraios consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Loudovika Hyaleas and Basilissa Gregoraios to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Loudovika Hyaleas and Eirenaion Kurtikios are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: Every client Kyriake Limniotes wins is one Philippos Palaiologos lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Kyriake Limniotes and Philippos Palaiologos will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Kyriake Limniotes and Dionysios Synadenos signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Kyriake Limniotes and Dionysios Synadenos both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Kyriake Limniotes trusts Komnenissa Kantakouzenos's word over any written contract. Komnenissa Kantakouzenos has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Komnenissa Kantakouzenos has publicly backed a plan that Kyriake Limniotes thinks will fail. Kyriake Limniotes has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Philippos Palaiologos and Apokaukos Niketas deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Apokaukos Niketas has recently secured something that makes Philippos Palaiologos's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Philippos Palaiologos and Dionysios Synadenos are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Dionysios Synadenos has asked Philippos Palaiologos to back a candidate Philippos Palaiologos distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: What Komnenissa Kantakouzenos knows, Philippos Palaiologos taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Philippos Palaiologos, quietly, whether Komnenissa Kantakouzenos can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Melissenos Melas borrowed Kassandra Xiphilinos's good name to win a post. Kassandra Xiphilinos has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Kassandra Xiphilinos has fallen on hard times, and the debt Melissenos Melas owes is now the only asset Kassandra Xiphilinos has.

relationships.description: Melissenos Melas took Eudoxia Vryennios in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Eudoxia Vryennios has taken on a client Melissenos Melas turned away on principle.

npcs.title: Elder

personality.tell: checks exits in every new room before speaking
personality.speech: Uses long pauses as punctuation, sits comfortably in silence

physical.feature: ink-stained fingers
physical.clothes: work clothes patched by someone who loved them

goal.short: Convert governance instability into a restoration of prerogatives that formal governance had constrained.
goal.long: Become the person every arrival and every old family must go through

secret.what: Owes Walpurga Corvinus a debt from before either of them held their current position: one that Walpurga Corvinus has never formally called in
secret.stakes: The silence feels like patience rather than forgiveness

plotHooks: A child has been asking questions about a person no one has heard of, insisting this person lived here recently.
Something is left at the crossroads each new moon. No one admits to leaving it. It is always gone by morning.

presentation.impression: Open. The impression of someone with nothing in particular to hide, or who has decided not to hide it.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

npcs.stressNote: The governing faction is caught between two constituencies that want incompatible things, and both know it.
npcs.structuralPosition: Holds hereditary or traditional status in a settlement where formal governance is under pressure. Traditional authority often gains relative standing when formal authority loses it.
npcs.activeConstraint: Traditional claims that would have been dismissed under stable governance invite more scrutiny under conditions where everyone is watching for illegitimate power grabs.

npcs.title: Agent

physical.feature: heavy-lidded eyes that suggest either wisdom or exhaustion

goal.short: Absorb the new arrivals into the labour market before resentment turns to violence
goal.long: Make the changed settlement work rather than merely survive the change

secret.what: Knows something about Incitatus Varro that Incitatus Varro believes no one else knows, and has been deciding for months whether to use it
secret.stakes: Incitatus Varro would move against them immediately if they suspected

npcs.title: Godi

personality.speech: Verbose and elaborate; takes three sentences where one would do

physical.build: slight: smaller than expected for the role
physical.feature: a prosthetic hand, finely crafted
physical.clothes: simple robes of their order

goal.short: Extend the institution's civic role in ways that survive whatever governance reconsolidation follows.
goal.long: Stop the killing on both sides, whatever it costs them personally

secret.what: One of their children is not theirs biologically, and they know it
secret.stakes: Every inheritance, every decision, made differently if this becomes known

plotHooks: A parishioner confessed something to them three months ago. The information is dangerous. They cannot act on it.
The well gives good water. The spring above it dried up three years ago. No one mentions this.

presentation.impression: Watchful, in a religious way: not suspicious, but as though taking a reading.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

npcs.structuralPosition: Holds institutional religious authority in a settlement where civic governance is failing. Religious institutions often absorb civic functions when secular authority contracts.
npcs.activeConstraint: Civic engagement that appears opportunistic risks being reversed by a reconsolidated authority that resents the encroachment.

npcs.name: Estrid Olafsson
npcs.title: Meistari

personality.tell: maintains an unnervingly fixed smile during conflict
personality.speech: Speaks in analogies and metaphors, even when clarity would serve better

physical.feature: a cough they suppress with visible effort
physical.clothes: clothes practical for their work with one personal flourish

goal.short: End the revolt without a suppression the settlement cannot recover from
goal.long: Preserve the settlement, and, if possible, their own soul along with it

secret.what: Ordered what was officially ruled an accident, and sleeps fine about it
secret.stakes: Murder charge, loss of everything, and the victim's family who suspects the truth

plotHooks: Three guards have gone missing in the same district on night patrol. The report filed says they deserted.

presentation.impression: Reserved. Not hostile, just private.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

relationships.description: What Uijah Balam knows, Cuauhtli Chuc taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Cuauhtli Chuc, quietly, whether Uijah Balam can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Cuauhtli Chuc took Citlali Nah in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Citlali Nah has taken on a client Cuauhtli Chuc turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Yohualli Kin owes Citlali Nah something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Citlali Nah is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Uijah Balam and Water Lily Ek are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Yohualli Kin needs Uijah Balam's seal on certain papers; Uijah Balam needs Yohualli Kin's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Uijah Balam's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Yohualli Kin holds nothing over Uijah Balam.

relationships.description: Uijah Balam wants Metztli Balam's position, and Metztli Balam wants Uijah Balam's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Metztli Balam has been telling clients that Uijah Balam's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Uijah Balam.

relationships.description: Years ago Metztli Balam did for Atl Itza the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Atl Itza has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Atl Itza has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Metztli Balam does not.

relationships.description: Atl Itza and Uijah Balam fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Uijah Balam's face.
relationships.tension: Atl Itza has learned that Uijah Balam is in debt and could be ruined by one call on a loan.

relationships.description: Water Lily Ek learned the work at Metztli Balam's side for seven years. Half of Water Lily Ek's clients first came through Metztli Balam's door.
relationships.tension: Metztli Balam has taken a new apprentice, and Water Lily Ek has heard the apprentice is being taught things Water Lily Ek never was.

relationships.description: Metztli Balam vouched for Yohualli Kin when nobody else would. Yohualli Kin's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Yohualli Kin corrected Metztli Balam in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: The alliance between Citlali Nah and Uijah Balam was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Citlali Nah has taken a precaution against Uijah Balam that Uijah Balam was not meant to discover. Uijah Balam has discovered it.

relationships.description: Citlali Nah and Water Lily Ek sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Water Lily Ek has written down what Citlali Nah owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: Citlali Nah and Metztli Balam share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Metztli Balam has been dining with Citlali Nah's rivals. Citlali Nah heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Yohualli Kin still uses Water Lily Ek's methods and Water Lily Ek's ledger format. Everyone who sees Yohualli Kin's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Water Lily Ek has asked Yohualli Kin for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Between Water Lily Ek and Cuauhtli Chuc stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

personality.tell: refuses to sit with their back to a door

relationships.description: Dalila al-Jazari brings the votes and Lubna ibn Rushd brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Lubna ibn Rushd voted against Dalila al-Jazari on a small matter last week. Dalila al-Jazari is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Lubna ibn Rushd borrowed Zaid ibn Khalid's good name to win a post. Zaid ibn Khalid has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Zaid ibn Khalid has fallen on hard times, and the debt Lubna ibn Rushd owes is now the only asset Zaid ibn Khalid has.

relationships.description: Lubna ibn Rushd owes Yusuf al-Mawsili something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Yusuf al-Mawsili is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Years ago Dalila al-Jazari did for Zaid ibn Khalid the kind of favour that cannot be repaid, only serviced. Zaid ibn Khalid has been servicing it ever since.
relationships.tension: Zaid ibn Khalid has begun to act like someone who considers the debt paid. Dalila al-Jazari does not.

relationships.description: What Ghulam al-Hakim knows, Zaid ibn Khalid taught (including, inconveniently, how to outmanoeuvre a teacher).
relationships.tension: A third party has asked Zaid ibn Khalid, quietly, whether Ghulam al-Hakim can be trusted. The answer took too long.

relationships.description: Yusuf al-Mawsili took Ghulam al-Hakim in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Ghulam al-Hakim has taken on a client Yusuf al-Mawsili turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Every client Yusuf al-Mawsili wins is one Faris ibn Jubayr lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Yusuf al-Mawsili and Faris ibn Jubayr will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Ghulam al-Hakim and Faris ibn Jubayr are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Ghulam al-Hakim lost the last contract to Faris ibn Jubayr by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Dalila al-Jazari learned the work at Ghulam al-Hakim's side for seven years. Half of Dalila al-Jazari's clients first came through Ghulam al-Hakim's door.
relationships.tension: Ghulam al-Hakim has taken a new apprentice, and Dalila al-Jazari has heard the apprentice is being taught things Dalila al-Jazari never was.

relationships.description: Faris ibn Jubayr vouched for Dalila al-Jazari when nobody else would. Dalila al-Jazari's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Dalila al-Jazari corrected Faris ibn Jubayr in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Pacuvius Salinator reports to Albinus Plancus on paper and to no one in practice. Albinus Plancus has three letters of complaint unanswered.
relationships.tension: Pacuvius Salinator arrested a councillor's son without Albinus Plancus's warrant. Albinus Plancus has demanded his release by tomorrow.

relationships.description: Albinus Plancus wants the watch under civil command; Cara Moderatus wants the council out of the barracks. They meet monthly and settle nothing.
relationships.tension: Albinus Plancus has asked the capital to replace Cara Moderatus. Cara Moderatus has asked the capital to dissolve Albinus Plancus's council.

relationships.description: Albinus Plancus sets the curfew and Flavia Severus decides whether to enforce it. The two have not agreed on a curfew in a year.
relationships.tension: A riot is expected on the next market day, and Albinus Plancus and Flavia Severus have issued opposite orders for it.

relationships.description: Cara Moderatus and Flavia Severus are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Between Cara Moderatus and Pacuvius Salinator stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Laelia Cicero paid Cara Moderatus's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Cara Moderatus mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Laelia Cicero has asked Cara Moderatus for a vote against Cara Moderatus's own interests. It is the first payment Laelia Cicero has asked for.

relationships.description: Cato Maximus owes Albinus Plancus a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Cato Maximus has started repaying the debt in coin. Albinus Plancus wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Vita Nerva learned the work at Zenobia Ursus's side for seven years. Half of Vita Nerva's clients first came through Zenobia Ursus's door.
relationships.tension: Zenobia Ursus has taken a new apprentice, and Vita Nerva has heard the apprentice is being taught things Vita Nerva never was.

relationships.description: Clodia Aurelius kept Zenobia Ursus's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Zenobia Ursus has voted with Clodia Aurelius ever since.
relationships.tension: Clodia Aurelius has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Zenobia Ursus's partners.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Flavia Severus and Pacuvius Salinator, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Laelia Cicero nursed Flavia Severus through a winter fever when no one else would come. Flavia Severus still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Flavia Severus has refused Laelia Cicero a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: What Clodia Aurelius knows would ruin Livia Ravilla; what Livia Ravilla holds would finish Clodia Aurelius. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Clodia Aurelius and Sulpicia Capito want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Clodia Aurelius borrowed Albinus Plancus's good name to win a post. Albinus Plancus has never asked for it back.
relationships.tension: Albinus Plancus has fallen on hard times, and the debt Clodia Aurelius owes is now the only asset Albinus Plancus has.

relationships.description: Vita Nerva vouched for Albinus Plancus when nobody else would. Albinus Plancus's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Albinus Plancus corrected Vita Nerva in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Drusus Volso is Vita Nerva's half-sibling, raised in the same house and left out of the same will.
relationships.tension: A family property must be sold, and Vita Nerva and Drusus Volso each want the money for a different purpose.

relationships.description: Pacuvius Salinator still uses Laelia Cicero's methods and Laelia Cicero's ledger format. Everyone who sees Pacuvius Salinator's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Laelia Cicero has asked Pacuvius Salinator for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Laelia Cicero sends difficult cases to Albinus Plancus, and Albinus Plancus sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Laelia Cicero has learned something about Albinus Plancus's family that Albinus Plancus does not know.

relationships.description: The alliance between Sulpicia Capito and Livia Ravilla was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Sulpicia Capito has taken a precaution against Livia Ravilla that Livia Ravilla was not meant to discover. Livia Ravilla has discovered it.

relationships.description: Sulpicia Capito and Drusus Volso are in-laws. They are polite at family dinners and avoid each other everywhere else.
relationships.tension: Sulpicia Capito's rivals have learned that Drusus Volso is family, and have started asking Drusus Volso questions.

relationships.description: Pacuvius Salinator and Cato Maximus have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Cato Maximus has been offered Pacuvius Salinator's post by people who want Pacuvius Salinator gone.

relationships.description: Pacuvius Salinator named Zenobia Ursus as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Zenobia Ursus has begun teaching Pacuvius Salinator's methods as Zenobia Ursus's own.

relationships.description: Livia Ravilla and Drusus Volso deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Drusus Volso has recently secured something that makes Livia Ravilla's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Livia Ravilla owes Zenobia Ursus something significant: a favour, a secret kept, a crisis managed. The debt has never been formally acknowledged. It doesn't need to be.
relationships.tension: Zenobia Ursus is about to call it in.

relationships.description: Every advance Drusus Volso makes is answered by Clodia Aurelius within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Drusus Volso and Zenobia Ursus share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Zenobia Ursus has been dining with Drusus Volso's rivals. Drusus Volso heard about it from a servant.
