plotHooks: A recruit they turned away has since joined a different outfit. The different outfit is now paying them to monitor this one.
One of their people is talking to the guard. They don't know which one yet. They're watching.

presentation.impression: Quiet. They let other people fill the silence.
presentation.behaviour: Polite but brief; makes clear their time is limited.

members.name: Nirmala Dutta
members.title: Sreshi

personality.tell: keeps meticulous written records of every meeting
personality.speech: Prefaces bad news with elaborate courtesy, good news with none

physical.feature: a network of small scars on their knuckles
physical.clothes: guild colours worn with pride

goal.short: Collect on a large overdue debt from a borrower who has suddenly disappeared
goal.long: Accumulate enough leverage over enough people to be untouchable

secret.what: Has been quietly shorting investments they publicly recommend, profiting from collapse
secret.stakes: Civil fraud liability and the permanent destruction of a reputation built over decades

plotHooks: They've noticed the same group of faces at multiple locations where incidents occurred. No one else has.

presentation.impression: Busy, or presenting as busy. The first impression is of someone who doesn't waste time.
presentation.behaviour: Cooperative within clear limits; every exchange has an implicit value.

members.name: Jai Shastri
members.title: Purohit

personality.tell: never eats or drinks anything offered by a stranger without watching others first
personality.speech: Speaks in analogies and metaphors, even when clarity would serve better

physical.feature: a perpetual half-smile
physical.clothes: dress entirely without signal (deliberately so)

secret.what: Their identity is fabricated. They fled a different life entirely
secret.stakes: The person they became would be destroyed; the person they were might be wanted

plotHooks: A document they were asked to witness contained a clause they noticed at the time and said nothing about.

presentation.impression: Open. The impression of someone with nothing in particular to hide, or who has decided not to hide it.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Ravi Gupta
members.title: Acharya

personality.tell: taps their foot in a complex rhythm when bored
personality.speech: Speaks in short, clipped sentences: every word intentional

physical.feature: a perpetual half-smile
physical.clothes: guard uniform kept immaculate

secret.what: Has been reading Nalini Subramanian's correspondence through an intermediary. Nothing damaging yet. But they keep looking
secret.stakes: The intermediary has recently started asking for more money

plotHooks: They are carrying out orders they believe are wrong. They have not yet decided at what point they stop carrying them out.

presentation.impression: Direct. They assess you in the first three seconds and their expression tells you they've reached a provisional conclusion.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Lopamudra Ghosh
members.title: Knight

personality.tell: refuses to sit with their back to a door
personality.speech: Trails off mid-sentence when approaching something they regret knowing

physical.feature: laugh lines that run deep
physical.clothes: court attire with discreet personal touches

secret.what: Was present when Ekalavya Mukherjee did something they've never accounted for publicly. Neither has acknowledged the other was there
secret.stakes: The situation they're both ignoring is becoming relevant again

plotHooks: A recruit they turned away has since joined a different outfit. The different outfit is now paying them to monitor this one.

presentation.impression: Warmer than their office suggests. They have the gift of making people feel briefly important.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Ekalavya Mukherjee
members.title: Noble

personality.tell: quotes scripture or proverbs in casual conversation
personality.speech: Speaks quickly when lying, slowly when bargaining. The local traders know the tell

physical.feature: a jaw set permanently as if biting back words
physical.clothes: formal robes of office

secret.what: Has been skimming from military supply budgets for years through a trusted subordinate
secret.stakes: The subordinate now knows enough to destroy them, and is becoming expensive

plotHooks: They know who committed a crime the guard is currently investigating. They're not telling the guard.
They've been quietly buying up property in a district that hasn't been announced as a development site. Yet.

presentation.impression: Formally polite. Every sentence is measured before it leaves their mouth.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions without volunteering; watches who you talk to next.

members.name: Aditya Jha
members.title: Shreshtha

personality.tell: pauses for exactly three seconds before answering any question
personality.speech: Tells anecdotes that never quite reach the point

physical.feature: eyes that are slightly different colours
physical.clothes: foreign-cut clothes from a market they want to be asked about

goal.short: Identify the leak in their supply chain before it empties the accounts
goal.long: Leverage money into influence: that's where security actually lives

secret.what: Knows that the decisive victory everyone celebrates was won through treachery, not skill
secret.stakes: Several people built careers on that victory; they would not appreciate the truth

plotHooks: Three guards have gone missing in the same district on night patrol. The report filed says they deserted.
A shipment they weren't expecting arrived and is now in their warehouse. They don't know who sent it or what to do.

presentation.impression: Quick to smile, quick to calculate. Both things are happening simultaneously.
presentation.behaviour: Offers information freely; asks questions that seem like interest rather than interrogation.

members.name: Rohit Hazra
members.title: Acharya

personality.tell: makes deliberate, theatrical eye contact to assert dominance
personality.speech: Pauses mid-sentence to choose words with visible care

physical.feature: a full beard maintained with military precision
physical.clothes: a good coat inherited from a larger relative

secret.what: Knows something about Rajesh Kapur that Rajesh Kapur believes no one else knows, and has been deciding for months whether to use it
secret.stakes: Rajesh Kapur would move against them immediately if they suspected

plotHooks: They found something hidden in a place it shouldn't be. They put it back. They haven't told anyone.
The ambush that killed two of their best people wasn't random. Someone knew the patrol route.

presentation.impression: Unremarkable. The particular invisible quality of someone who has spent years not being noticed.
presentation.behaviour: Answers questions. Asks nothing. Remembers more than they show.

relationships.description: Hemavati Nair and Ekalavya Mukherjee share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Ekalavya Mukherjee has been dining with Hemavati Nair's rivals. Hemavati Nair heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Hemavati Nair and Prashant Thakur back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Hemavati Nair wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Prashant Thakur thinks the newcomer would take Prashant Thakur's place.

relationships.description: Rajesh Kapur and Ishwar Mahajan are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Rajesh Kapur lost the last contract to Ishwar Mahajan by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Rajesh Kapur and Ravi Gupta each hold information or resources the other needs. They cooperate efficiently and neither trusts the other at all.
relationships.tension: The balance of leverage has recently shifted. One party has noticed; the other hasn't yet.

relationships.description: There is no arrangement between Mamata Bhatt and Yudhisthir Shastri, only a long record of kept words; in this settlement that makes them remarkable.
relationships.tension: The respect is real and the interests are diverging. Both can read a map.

relationships.description: Mamata Bhatt took Hemavati Nair in as an apprentice and taught them the trade, the clients, and the names worth knowing.
relationships.tension: Hemavati Nair has taken on a client Mamata Bhatt turned away on principle.

relationships.description: Nalini Subramanian learned the work at Mamata Bhatt's side for seven years. Half of Nalini Subramanian's clients first came through Mamata Bhatt's door.
relationships.tension: Mamata Bhatt has taken a new apprentice, and Nalini Subramanian has heard the apprentice is being taught things Nalini Subramanian never was.

relationships.description: What Govind Srinivasan knows would ruin Ram Rao; what Ram Rao holds would finish Govind Srinivasan. On this foundation they have built an excellent working relationship.
relationships.tension: A document each believed only they possessed has surfaced in a third set of hands.

relationships.description: Govind Srinivasan brings the votes and Malati Bose brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Malati Bose voted against Govind Srinivasan on a small matter last week. Govind Srinivasan is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Govind Srinivasan and Nirmala Dutta fought a duel in their youth. Both survived, and the scar is on Nirmala Dutta's face.
relationships.tension: Govind Srinivasan has learned that Nirmala Dutta is in debt and could be ruined by one call on a loan.

relationships.description: Ganga Srinivasan and Prashant Thakur compete for the same resource, position, or reputation. The competition is vigorous but bounded. Neither has crossed the line into genuine enmity. Yet.
relationships.tension: A decision coming in the next season will advantage one significantly. The other knows this.

relationships.description: Ganga Srinivasan sends difficult cases to Yudhisthir Shastri, and Yudhisthir Shastri sends them back solved. Neither has ever charged the other a fee.
relationships.tension: Ganga Srinivasan has learned something about Yudhisthir Shastri's family that Yudhisthir Shastri does not know.

relationships.description: Something happened between Nagendra Yadav and Ram Rao years ago that neither has forgotten. They function professionally. They do not forgive.
relationships.tension: The circumstances that caused the original rupture are repeating. Both of them know it.

relationships.description: Between Nagendra Yadav and Malati Bose stands an old kindness with the structure of a mortgage. Neither names it; both know the balance to the penny.
relationships.tension: A third party has learned what the original favour was. The debt just changed hands.

relationships.description: Ram Rao and Malati Bose were something to each other once (partners, friends, perhaps more), and the wreck of it is the one subject on which both are permanently silent.
relationships.tension: An apology is owed in one direction and expected in the other, and they disagree about which.

relationships.description: Ram Rao and Nirmala Dutta want the same thing and cannot both have it. The contest is conducted with scrupulous courtesy and total commitment.
relationships.tension: A mutual patron has let it be known there is room for only one of them at the next table.

relationships.description: Prashant Thakur and Yudhisthir Shastri signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Prashant Thakur and Yudhisthir Shastri both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Rajesh Kapur paid Prashant Thakur's bail eleven years ago and has never mentioned it. Prashant Thakur mentions it to no one.
relationships.tension: Rajesh Kapur has asked Prashant Thakur for a vote against Prashant Thakur's own interests. It is the first payment Rajesh Kapur has asked for.

relationships.description: Ishwar Mahajan and Shobha Iyengar have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Shobha Iyengar has been offered Ishwar Mahajan's post by people who want Ishwar Mahajan gone.

relationships.description: Ishwar Mahajan owes Vishnu Anand a large sum in coin, borrowed in a bad year and repaid in small amounts ever since.
relationships.tension: Ishwar Mahajan has started repaying the debt in coin. Vishnu Anand wants it repaid in favours.

relationships.description: Aditya Jha kept Malati Bose's name out of a scandal that ruined two others. Malati Bose has voted with Aditya Jha ever since.
relationships.tension: Aditya Jha has mentioned the debt aloud, at a dinner, in front of Malati Bose's partners.

relationships.description: Malati Bose is godparent to Nalini Subramanian's eldest child. The tie was made before their careers set them against each other.
relationships.tension: The family has asked Malati Bose and Nalini Subramanian to end their quarrel before the next feast. Neither will apologise first.

relationships.description: Vasudhara Ahuja nursed Malati Bose through a winter fever when no one else would come. Malati Bose still owes the debt and still knows it.
relationships.tension: Malati Bose has refused Vasudhara Ahuja a small favour for the first time in years.

relationships.description: Nalini Subramanian and Vasudhara Ahuja deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Vasudhara Ahuja has recently secured something that makes Nalini Subramanian's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Nalini Subramanian vouched for Nagendra Srinivasan when nobody else would. Nagendra Srinivasan's first post came from that word.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Srinivasan corrected Nalini Subramanian in public last month, and was right.

relationships.description: Every advance Nalini Subramanian makes is answered by Hari Trivedi within the season; the rivalry has become its own institution, with rules neither wrote and both obey.
relationships.tension: One of them has recently broken an unwritten rule of the contest. The other is deciding what that permits.

relationships.description: Vasudhara Ahuja and Nagendra Srinivasan are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Srinivasan has asked Vasudhara Ahuja to back a candidate Vasudhara Ahuja distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Vasudhara Ahuja and Lopamudra Ghosh bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Vasudhara Ahuja has hired away Lopamudra Ghosh's best assistant. Lopamudra Ghosh has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Vasudhara Ahuja and Hari Trivedi trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Vasudhara Ahuja or Hari Trivedi can fill it.

relationships.description: Shobha Iyengar and Rajesh Kapur trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Shobha Iyengar has asked Rajesh Kapur for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Vishnu Anand once told the council that Shobha Iyengar was right and Vishnu Anand was wrong. Shobha Iyengar has not forgotten it.
relationships.tension: Shobha Iyengar has made a mistake that Vishnu Anand is bound to report. Vishnu Anand has not reported it.

relationships.description: Atharva Jha and Lakshmi Nair work together because the alternative (working against each other) is worse for both. The alliance holds as long as the calculation holds.
relationships.tension: A third party is actively working to change that calculation.

relationships.description: Atharva Jha and Lopamudra Varma consult each other before any decision that matters. The advice is honest and is always taken seriously.
relationships.tension: The council has asked Atharva Jha and Lopamudra Varma to audit each other's accounts. Both agreed, and neither is comfortable.

relationships.description: Atharva Jha controls a vote Ram Rao needs, and Ram Rao controls a supply Atharva Jha needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Ram Rao has found a new source for what Atharva Jha supplies. Atharva Jha has not been told.

relationships.description: Yudhisthir Shastri trusts Hemavati Nair's word over any written contract. Hemavati Nair has never given a reason to regret it.
relationships.tension: Hemavati Nair has publicly backed a plan that Yudhisthir Shastri thinks will fail. Yudhisthir Shastri has said so once, in private.

relationships.description: Yudhisthir Shastri wants Ekalavya Mukherjee's position, and Ekalavya Mukherjee wants Yudhisthir Shastri's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Ekalavya Mukherjee has been telling clients that Yudhisthir Shastri's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Yudhisthir Shastri.

relationships.description: Vasudhara Ahuja still uses Yudhisthir Shastri's methods and Yudhisthir Shastri's ledger format. Everyone who sees Vasudhara Ahuja's work recognises the teacher.
relationships.tension: Yudhisthir Shastri has asked Vasudhara Ahuja for a loan. It is the first time a debt between teacher and student has run that way.

relationships.description: Every client Damayanti Shrivastava wins is one Radha Varma lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Damayanti Shrivastava and Radha Varma will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Damayanti Shrivastava wants Ram Rao's position, and Ram Rao wants Damayanti Shrivastava's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Ram Rao has been telling clients that Damayanti Shrivastava's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Damayanti Shrivastava.

relationships.description: Damayanti Shrivastava and Nagendra Srinivasan each have something to trade and nothing to give away. They meet in private, bargain hard, and keep every bargain.
relationships.tension: The vote Nagendra Srinivasan needs from Damayanti Shrivastava comes up next week, and Damayanti Shrivastava has named a new price.

relationships.description: Every client Nagendra Srinivasan wins is one Hari Trivedi lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Srinivasan and Hari Trivedi will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Nagendra Srinivasan and Lopamudra Ghosh are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Srinivasan lost the last contract to Lopamudra Ghosh by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Nagendra Srinivasan and Rajesh Kapur are allies by arithmetic: each has counted the cost of the other as an enemy and found it too high. The friendship is warm, public, and entirely conditional.
relationships.tension: The threat that made the alliance necessary is gone. Neither has said so aloud.

relationships.description: Rajesh Kapur needs Vishnu Anand's seal on certain papers; Vishnu Anand needs Rajesh Kapur's silence about certain others. Neither has asked for more than the other could pay.
relationships.tension: Vishnu Anand's secret is about to come out by other means. Once it does, Rajesh Kapur holds nothing over Vishnu Anand.

relationships.description: Vishnu Anand and Ravi Gupta bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Vishnu Anand has hired away Ravi Gupta's best assistant. Ravi Gupta has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Ekalavya Mukherjee and Prashant Thakur have earned each other's regard through demonstrated competence. They don't agree on everything but they trust each other's judgment within their respective domains.
relationships.tension: They are about to be on opposite sides of a significant decision.

relationships.description: The alliance between Ekalavya Mukherjee and Ganga Srinivasan was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Ekalavya Mukherjee has taken a precaution against Ganga Srinivasan that Ganga Srinivasan was not meant to discover. Ganga Srinivasan has discovered it.

relationships.description: Ekalavya Mukherjee named Nalini Subramanian as successor in front of witnesses. The formal handover has not happened.
relationships.tension: Nalini Subramanian has begun teaching Ekalavya Mukherjee's methods as Nalini Subramanian's own.

relationships.description: Lakshmi Nair and Lopamudra Varma trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Lakshmi Nair or Lopamudra Varma can fill it.

relationships.description: Lakshmi Nair wants Govind Srinivasan's position, and Govind Srinivasan wants Lakshmi Nair's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Govind Srinivasan has been telling clients that Lakshmi Nair's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Lakshmi Nair.

relationships.description: Every client Aditya Jha wins is one Govind Srinivasan lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Aditya Jha and Govind Srinivasan will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Aditya Jha and Nagendra Yadav disagree often and trust completely. Each has watched the other be right at cost, and neither forgets it.
relationships.tension: One of them is being pressured to act against the other, and has not yet mentioned it.

relationships.description: Aditya Jha and Ram Rao are rivals for the same patron's favour. Each has spent the year trying to be first through the patron's door.
relationships.tension: Aditya Jha lost the last contract to Ram Rao by a single vote, and has learned who cast it.

relationships.description: Nirmala Dutta and Nagendra Yadav are connected by blood or marriage in a way that neither finds professionally convenient. The connection is known; its implications are not discussed.
relationships.tension: An inheritance, title, or secret is about to make the connection impossible to ignore.

relationships.description: Nirmala Dutta brings the votes and Malati Bose brings the money. The alliance is three years old and has won every vote it needed.
relationships.tension: Malati Bose voted against Nirmala Dutta on a small matter last week. Nirmala Dutta is waiting to see whether it was small.

relationships.description: Nirmala Dutta and Aditya Jha have stood on opposite sides of three disputes and praised each other after every one.
relationships.tension: Aditya Jha has been offered Nirmala Dutta's post by people who want Nirmala Dutta gone.

relationships.description: Rekha Subramanian and Rohit Hazra sit on opposite sides of most questions and vote together on the few that touch their shared interests.
relationships.tension: Rohit Hazra has written down what Rekha Subramanian owes and left a copy with a notary.

relationships.description: The quarrel between Rekha Subramanian and Ram Rao is old enough that no one else remembers the cause. They remember. They have simply stopped explaining.
relationships.tension: A newcomer keeps trying to reconcile them, and is about to learn why nobody else does.

relationships.description: Jai Shastri and Rekha Subramanian signed a pact after their last quarrel cost them both. They keep to its terms exactly.
relationships.tension: Jai Shastri and Rekha Subramanian both want the same office, and the alliance cannot survive one of them winning it.

relationships.description: Jai Shastri and Nagendra Yadav deal with each other like men carrying lit lanterns in a powder store, carefully, and with great mutual politeness.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Yadav has recently secured something that makes Jai Shastri's hold obsolete. The politeness continues, for now.

relationships.description: Ravi Gupta and Ishwar Mahajan are allies with separate interests. They meet to coordinate and leave by different doors.
relationships.tension: Ishwar Mahajan has asked Ravi Gupta to back a candidate Ravi Gupta distrusts. Refusing would cost the alliance its majority.

relationships.description: Nagendra Srinivasan reports to Ravi Gupta on paper and to no one in practice. Ravi Gupta has three letters of complaint unanswered.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Srinivasan arrested a councillor's son without Ravi Gupta's warrant. Ravi Gupta has demanded his release by tomorrow.

relationships.description: Ravi Gupta and Lopamudra Ghosh bid for the same contracts and sit at the same tables. Each counts the other's wins more carefully than their own.
relationships.tension: Ravi Gupta has hired away Lopamudra Ghosh's best assistant. Lopamudra Ghosh has said nothing about it, to anyone.

relationships.description: Lopamudra Varma and Govind Srinivasan trained together and have competed ever since. The settlement keeps score, and so do they.
relationships.tension: A post opens at midsummer, and only Lopamudra Varma or Govind Srinivasan can fill it.

relationships.description: Lopamudra Varma shaped Malati Bose's career in ways that Malati Bose has not fully acknowledged. The debt is real; the gratitude is complicated.
relationships.tension: Malati Bose now operates in ways Lopamudra Varma would not approve of. Neither discusses the divergence directly.

relationships.description: Radha Varma and Rajesh Kapur trade favours on a strict count. Neither has ever been more than one favour ahead.
relationships.tension: Radha Varma has asked Rajesh Kapur for a second favour before repaying the first.

relationships.description: Radha Varma wants Ram Rao's position, and Ram Rao wants Radha Varma's reputation. They are civil in public and unforgiving in private.
relationships.tension: Ram Rao has been telling clients that Radha Varma's work is slipping. Two of the clients have repeated it to Radha Varma.

relationships.description: The alliance between Lopamudra Ghosh and Hari Trivedi was born of a shared threat and has outlived it; both are quietly recalculating what it is now for.
relationships.tension: Lopamudra Ghosh has taken a precaution against Hari Trivedi that Hari Trivedi was not meant to discover. Hari Trivedi has discovered it.

relationships.description: Lopamudra Ghosh and Nagendra Yadav share a council bloc and a list of enemies. They do not share their plans.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Yadav has been dining with Lopamudra Ghosh's rivals. Lopamudra Ghosh heard about it from a servant.

relationships.description: Lopamudra Ghosh and Vishnu Anand back each other in public and check each other's work in private.
relationships.tension: Lopamudra Ghosh wants to bring a third member into the alliance. Vishnu Anand thinks the newcomer would take Vishnu Anand's place.

relationships.description: Hari Trivedi wants the watch under civil command; Rajesh Kapur wants the council out of the barracks. They meet monthly and settle nothing.
relationships.tension: Hari Trivedi has asked the capital to replace Rajesh Kapur. Rajesh Kapur has asked the capital to dissolve Hari Trivedi's council.

relationships.description: Hari Trivedi controls a vote Nagendra Yadav needs, and Nagendra Yadav controls a supply Hari Trivedi needs. Their meetings are short and their bargains hold.
relationships.tension: Nagendra Yadav has found a new source for what Hari Trivedi supplies. Hari Trivedi has not been told.

relationships.description: Every client Rohit Hazra wins is one Jai Shastri lost, and the reverse. The two keep a polite distance and an exact tally.
relationships.tension: Rohit Hazra and Jai Shastri will both present proposals at the next council session. Only one will be accepted.

relationships.description: Blood ties Rohit Hazra to Nagendra Yadav in a way that neither career can afford; they meet at funerals and weddings and pretend the rest of the year does not exist.
relationships.tension: A younger relative has begun trading on the connection both of them refuse to use.

relationships.description: Rohit Hazra testified against Ram Rao in a case ten years ago. Ram Rao lost a fortune and has not spoken to Rohit Hazra since.
relationships.tension: Ram Rao has been appointed to judge a case in which Rohit Hazra is a party.
